ainsi que l’infrastructure de backup et de stockage associée.* Traiter les demandes et tickets liés aux sauvegardes et assurer le suivi des opérations quotidiennes.* Superviser les sauvegardes, analyser les incidents et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives nécessaires.* Optimiser les performances, les politiques de rétention et l’utilisation des ressources de sauvegarde et de stockage.* Analyser l’architecture existante et proposer des améliorations en matière de fiabilité, de disponibilité et de capacité.* Participer au renouvellement des serveurs et des équipements de stockage, ainsi qu’à la refonte de l’architecture de sauvegarde.* Contribuer au renforcement de la cyberrésilience et à l’amélioration des capacités de restauration et de reprise de l’infrastructure.* Réaliser des tests de restauration et de récupération afin de vérifier l’efficacité des dispositifs en place.* Développer et améliorer l’automatisation des opérations de sauvegarde, de contrôle et de restauration.* Collaborer avec les équipes systèmes, infrastructure et datacenter pour garantir la disponibilité et la fiabilité des données sauvegardées.**Nous recherchons un profil respectant les critères suivants:*** Minimum 3 ans d’expérience dans l’administration de sauvegardes, de systèmes ou d’infrastructures IT, avec une expérience significative sur Commvault.* Maîtrise approfondie de Commvault et de ses mécanismes : architecture, sauvegarde, restauration, déduplication et gestion des rétentions.* Solides compétences en administration Unix/Linux.* Expérience en administration d’environnements de stockage, avec de bonnes connaissances des infrastructures SAN.* Capacité à analyser une infrastructure dans son ensemble et à contribuer à son optimisation et à son évolution.* Bonne compréhension des enjeux de cyberrésilience et des mécanismes de restauration et de reprise.* Compétences en scripting et en automatisation des tâches d’exploitation.* Expérience dans la gestion des incidents, des demandes et des problèmes de performance liés aux sauvegardes.* Esprit d’analyse, autonomie, rigueur et aptitude à travailler au sein d’une équipe.* Anglais professionnel requis.* Stage – Achats opérationnels \& Supply Chain (H/F)
=====================================================

**Rejoignez un acteur de la transition énergétique**

 

Vous souhaitez acquérir une expérience concrète dans les achats, la supply chain et la gestion des approvisionnements au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance ?

Solexis SA, filiale suisse du Groupe Ecostal, est spécialisée dans la distribution de solutions photovoltaïques et d'énergies renouvelables. Nous accompagnons chaque jour nos clients professionnels dans le développement de projets contribuant à la transition énergétique.

Afin de renforcer notre équipe Achats \& Supply Chain, nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire motivé(e) souhaitant développer ses compétences dans un environnement international, dynamique et orienté résultats.

 

**Votre mission :**

Intégré(e) à notre équipe Achats \& Supply Chain et accompagné(e) au quotidien, vous participerez notamment aux activités suivantes :

 

**Achats et approvisionnements**

* Participer à la création et au suivi des commandes fournisseurs.
* Suivre les délais de livraison, effectuer les relances et contribuer à la résolution des éventuels litiges.
* Collaborer avec les équipes commerciales et logistiques afin d'anticiper les besoins et d'optimiser les approvisionnements.


 

**Gestion et suivi des fournisseurs**

* Contribuer au suivi de la performance des fournisseurs (délais, qualité, coûts).
* Participer à la recherche de nouveaux fournisseurs et à la préparation des négociations.
* Découvrir les enjeux de la relation fournisseurs dans un environnement international.


 

**Analyse et pilotage de l'activité**

* Participer à la mise à jour et à la fiabilisation des données produits dans notre ERP.
* Contribuer au suivi des stocks, à l'analyse des besoins et à la planification des approvisionnements.
* Participer à l'élaboration et à l'amélioration des tableaux de bord et indicateurs de performance.


 

**Projets et amélioration continue**

* Apporter votre soutien à des projets transversaux, notamment lors de lancements de produits ou d'initiatives d'optimisation.
* Proposer des améliorations pour simplifier et fiabiliser les processus et outils de suivi.


 

**Votre profil :**

* Vous suivez une formation supérieure (HES, ES, Université ou équivalent) en gestion, achats, logistique ou Supply Chain.
* Un parcours technique (CFC ou équivalent), associé à un intérêt pour les achats et les approvisionnements, peut également correspondre au poste.
* Vous êtes à l’aise avec Excel ou d’autres logiciels et avez un intérêt pour l’analyse de données, la modélisation et l’optimisation des processus.
* Vous maîtrisez le français et disposez d'un très bon niveau d'anglais professionnel (B2 minimum)
* Vous êtes organisé(e), rigoureux(se), curieux(se) et appréciez le travail en équipe.
* Vous avez un intérêt pour les produits techniques et les énergies renouvelables.


 

**Ce que nous vous proposons**

* Une expérience concrète et enrichissante au cœur des achats et de la Supply Chain, dans un secteur d'avenir.
* Un accompagnement personnalisé pour développer vos compétences, gagner en autonomie et prendre progressivement des responsabilités.
* L'opportunité de contribuer activement à des projets d'optimisation et d'amélioration continue, avec un réel impact sur nos activités.

Financial Analyst \& AI Engineer
================================

**Merion Swiss Partners SA**

Geneva, Switzerland

### **About us**

Founded in Geneva in 2019, Merion is an independent, FINMA\-regulated wealth management firm. We provide bespoke portfolio management built on independence, transparency, collaboration, and stability.

We are seeking a high\-potential, entry\-level / junior professional to design and implement next\-generation automated management tools within our existing framework, as well as to contribute to financial and investment analysis, research, and the development of the Company’s internal analytical tools.

### **Innovation \& Artificial Intelligence**

* Privacy\-First Local AI Engine: A 100% offline, local AI assistant that securely parses PDFs, conducts smart searches across internal files, and summarizes news sentiment without data leaks.
* Internet mitigation tool: develop a KYC AI tool that groups internet and AI searches in various languages and alphabets (Latin and Cyrillic).
* Contribute to the adoption of AI and automation capabilities across research workflows.
* Company’s visibility via AI: improve the Company’s visibility in the field of Wealth and Investment Management on Google and via AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude.


### **Research Tools \& Analytics**

**Proprietary solution for Equities and Bonds**

* Create an Analysis and Research Proprietary Database that automates pipeline tracking from multiple sources within the Company’s internal investment universe.
* Build a screening and data solution based on the database that returns data such as daily prices, stops and targets based on technical analysis and/or sentiment, news, descriptions (EN/FR), investment or disinvestment rationales, ratings, and default risks.
* Automate data collection to support financial research activities.
* Transform the solution into an end\-user interface technology.
* Work closely with end users to understand their needs and continuously improve the solution.


**Proprietary solution for Structured Products**

* Create an Analysis and Research Proprietary Database for Structured Products and their underlyings.
* Screen underlyings and return a live one\-page format with key information, P\&L, probabilities of autocall or an unfavorable scenario, and issuer default risk.


### **Financial Analyst**

* Analyze and challenge the data resulting from the Analysis Database, especially in relation to purchase and sale signals or recommendations, and potentially mitigate associated risks. Ensure data quality, integrity, governance, and accessibility across the research platform.
* Investment research: evaluate emerging technologies relevant to financial research and data analysis.
* Modular Portfolio Dashboard: an interactive desktop interface (Streamlit) to build portfolio profiles, enforce rules, brackets, currencies, markets, etc., and run backtests based on the Company’s universe.
* Support the assessment of investment opportunities through fundamental and quantitative analysis, including financial ratios, historical performance, risk factors and market data.
* Use Python, SQL, Excel and other analytical tools to automate financial analysis, reporting and recurring investment\-monitoring processes.
* Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the Company’s internal financial research methodologies, analytical models and investment\-monitoring framework.


### **Office Support**

* Translation of internal and sensitive documents from EN to RU.
* Support to the Company’s Business Introducers via KYCs, KYTs and FINMA standards (RU / FR / EN).
* Possibility to develop the Company’s clientele.
* Handle the Company’s website.


### **Your profile**

**Financial \& Investment Analysis**

* Ability to combine financial reasoning with quantitative and data\-driven approaches and to translate analytical results into clear conclusions for investment professionals.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to work with financial and market data from multiple sources.


**Data \& Programming**

* Financial Scraping \& Data Retrieval: proven experience in financial web scraping (Beautiful Soup, Selenium) and automated daily data parsing into local Excel/SQL environments.
* Tool Implementation \& Interfaces: hands\-on experience implementing functional desktop control panels and UI analytics tools using Python (Pandas, NumPy) and frameworks such as Streamlit.
* Quant Modeling: constrained portfolio optimization, multi\-currency conversions, and historical backtesting metrics, including Sharpe ratio and volatility. Prior experience supporting quantitative asset pricing or empirical risk factor research is highly valued.
* Local AI/NLP: implementation of secure, offline LLMs via LangChain or LlamaIndex to process data entirely on\-site. Specific exposure to building custom text preprocessing, PDF extraction tools, and news sentiment scoring engines is ideal.


**Education**

Master’s degree in Finance or Quantitative Finance (completed or in progress).

**Languages**

Fluent English and Russian.

Good knowledge of French — minimum B1\.

**Job Offer**

Attractive environment.

Home office and flexibility.

Full time.

Immediate entry date or to be discussed.

Chef de rang
============

**CHEF DE RANG**

Le chef de rang se trouve hiérarchiquement sous l’assistant maître d’hôtel.

 

Description des tâches du chef de rang

* Mise en place et préparation des livraisons,
* Livraisons effectuée seul ou avec un apprenti en formation ou un autre formateur.
* Débarrassage des livraisons, nettoyage, retour en plonge et débarrassage des chariots.
* Remise en place pour le soir ou le jour suivant.
* Lorsqu’un banquet ou autre évènement est organisé dans les locaux du Birdhouse, participer à la mise en place, au planning des équipes, à la mise en œuvre de l’évènement avec le soutien d’un ou plusieurs formateurs,
* Former et accompagner les apprentis tout au long de leur formation,
* Il/elle assiste et appuie l’assistant maître d’hôtel et la responsable de salle pour des tâches demandées (ouverture/fermeture espaces de restauration, nettoyages et mise en place des espaces),
* Participe au bon respect des règles de l’entreprise ainsi qu’au respect du matériel de l’établissement.
* En charge du suivi strict et de la mise en application du plan de nettoyage pour la partie du service.
* Respect des règles d’hygiène en vigueur.


Profil :

* Flexible dans les horaires,
* Pédagogue,
* Patient,
* Qui aime enseigner,
* Bienveillant,
* Formation CFC ou BEP obligatoire,
* Parle l’anglais couramment,
* A l’écoute,
* Minimum 2 à 4 ans d’expérience dans le service (livraison et banquets)


Spécificités :

* Les horaires sont en travail continu en journée cependant vous êtes amené à travailler le soir et les weekends lorsqu’il y a des évènements.
* Vous pouvez être amené à effectuer d’autres tâches.
* Les repas sont offerts.
* Attestation de formateur d’apprentis un plus.

jobs.title: Software Engineer – Industrial HMI, Control & Infrastructure
jobs.description: ---base:  /meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0--- Software Engineer – Industrial HMI, Control \& Infrastructure ( /NixOS) (m/w/d)=================================================================================About The Role--------------ZEEN Tech AG is an award\-winning Swiss startup revolutionizing the food industry with our next\-generation, water\-based frying and drying technology, which we export worldwide. As we grow rapidly, we're looking for passionate individuals to join us.Instead of relying on legacy, closed\-source PLC software, we build our machines' Human\-Machine Interface (HMI) and control systems ourselves: a modern stack running on a hardened NixOS base. From the control engine up to the operating system, the entire platform is built on free and open\-source software: deliberately so. No vendor lock\-in, no black boxes, and full control over every layer of the machine.We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our team and work alongside our existing Software Engineer. This is a hands\-on role: you will take over well\-defined parts of the control backend, the HMI, our NixOS machine fleet, and our internal server infrastructure, and progressively take on more ownership as you settle in. You will report to our Software Engineer, who owns the software architecture and will be your mentor. You will also collaborate closely with our mechanical and electrical engineers, the Production Team, and our Culinary Development team, who put the machines through real cooking tests.Key Responsibilities--------------------* **Backend \& Control ( ):** Help develop and maintain the machine's core "engine" written in . jobs.title: Spécialiste de la transformation numérique 80 - 100 %
jobs.description: Qui sommes\\-nous ? Le projet Justitia oeuvre, sur mandat des directrices et directeurs de justice ainsi que de la Conférence de la justice (tribunaux), à la numérisation de la justice suisse. À cette fin, il développe la plateforme pour la communication électronique dans le domaine judiciaire et la consultation des dossiers, ainsi que l'application dossier judiciaire (ADJ) pour le traitement et la gestion des dossiers numériques. Le projet soutient les autorités judiciaires dans leur transformation numérique au moyen de conseils et d'outils et les accompagne lors des phases pilotes, puis du déploiement. Tu interviens comme personne de contact pour les autorités judiciaires cantonales et fédérales ainsi que pour les associations cantonales d'avocats. Au sein de notre équipe et dans notre collaboration avec nos parties prenantes, différentes cultures et différents domaines de travail se côtoient (informatique, gestion du changement, communication, droit, autorités judiciaires). C'est pourquoi la confiance, la transparence, la collégialité, une culture de l'erreur orientée solutions ainsi que des relations fondées sur l'estime et le respect sont très importants pour nous. Spécialiste de la transformation numérique 80 \\- 100 % Voici tes tâches : Nous recherchons une personnalité engagée et communicative qui, grâce à ses compétences professionnelles et à sa capacité de mise en oeuvre, soutient les organisations judiciaires dans l'introduction de nouveaux systèmes numériques. Dans cette double fonction passionnante, tu assures d'une part des conseils spécialisés et des formations et, d'autre part, tu accompagnes les autorités judiciaires, dans le cadre de la loi fédérale sur les plateformes de communication électronique dans le domaine judiciaire (\[LPCJ\](\< \>)), de la phase pilote au déploiement de la plateforme et de l'application dossier judiciaire. Tu es la personne de contact centrale pour les autorités judiciaires cantonales et fédérales ainsi que pour les associations d'avocats, tu es proche des utilisatrices et utilisateurs et sais rendre des sujets complexes compréhensibles. \* \*\*Accompagnement des autorités judiciaires :\*\* Tu es la personne de contact centrale pour les autorités judiciaires cantonales ou fédérales ainsi que pour les associations d'avocats qui te sont attribuées. Tu établis des relations de confiance et les accompagnes à toutes les étapes de la transformation numérique. \* \*\*Formations \\\& ateliers :\*\* Tu organises et animes de manière autonome des formations, des présentations et des ateliers et transmets de façon pratique et compréhensible les avantages de nos solutions. \* \*\*Coordination \\\& communication :\*\* Tu collabores étroitement avec les équipes de projet, assures la coordination interne et fais activement remonter les besoins des autorités. \* \*\*Gestion des connaissances :\*\* Tu tiens à jour les coordonnées, la documentation et les activités dans Phonemos et contribues à notre base de connaissances interne. \* \*\*Soutien administratif :\*\* Tu soutiens l'équipe Transformation dans les tâches administratives, les retours, le controlling et l'assurance qualité, dans le but d'optimiser en continu l'ensemble du processus. Ce que tu apportes : \* \*\*Formation \\\& connaissances spécialisées :\*\* Tu disposes d'une formation en économie d'entreprise ou dans un domaine technique (au minimum un diplôme HES), complétée par des formations continues en gestion de projet, communication ou gestion du changement, ainsi que de plusieurs années d'expérience dans l'administration publique. \* \*\*Expérience professionnelle \\\& affinité avec l'informatique :\*\* \* Tu as de l'expérience dans le conseil à la clientèle, l'accompagnement de projets ou la formation dans un environnement numérique, idéalement dans le domaine judiciaire ou le secteur public. Les processus métier soutenus par l'informatique et les projets de changement t'intéressent. \* \*\*Communication \\\& aisance relationnelle :\*\* \* Tu disposes de bonnes compétences sociales, convaincs par ton assurance et évolues avec aisance dans les échanges avec différents groupes de parties prenantes. \* \*\*Connaissances linguistiques :\*\* Ta langue maternelle est l'allemand ou le français et tu disposes de très bonnes connaissances de l'autre langue, à l'écrit comme à l'oral ; des connaissances d'italien constituent un atout. \* \*\*Méthode de travail \\\& attitude :\*\* Tu travailles de manière autonome et précise, tu es fiable et respectes les délais. Tu as envie de t'engager chaque jour avec passion pour la transformation numérique et recherches des solutions créatives et axées sur les besoins. \*

jobs.title: Responsable administratif·ve et financier·ère
jobs.description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Responsable administratif·ve et financier·ère (H/F) --- Responsable administratif·ve et financier·ère (H/F) ====================================================== ### Introduction Pyramide 11 Echafaudages Sàrl recherche un·e \*\*Responsable administratif·ve et financier·ère (H/F)\*\* afin de prendre en charge et de structurer la gestion administrative et financière de nos entreprises familiales. Située à Bulle et Romont, Pyramide 11 Echafaudages est une entreprise spécialisée dans le montage, le démontage et la location d'échafaudages en Suisse romande. Avec plus de 10 ans d'expérience, elle a réalisé avec succès plus de 300 projets, couvrant une surface totale de 70 000 m² d'échafaudages. Notre organisation se compose actuellement de deux entreprises familiales. L'entreprise principale, \*\*Pyramide 11 Echafaudages Sàrl\*\*, traverse actuellement une phase de restructuration. Cette étape représente une réelle opportunité de remettre à plat et de réorganiser l'ensemble des processus administratifs et financiers, de mettre en place des procédures fiables et efficaces et de garantir une gestion saine et structurée. Nous souhaitons ainsi renforcer notre organisation en recrutant une personne capable de prendre les choses en main, d'apporter une vision globale et de devenir un véritable pilier dans la gestion administrative et financière. ### Responsabilités \*\*Gestion administrative et RH\*\* \* Reprendre en main et organiser l'ensemble de l'administration. \* Mettre en place et optimiser les procédures administratives internes. \* Structurer le classement, le suivi documentaire et la gestion des dossiers. \* Assurer le suivi des contrats, assurances, sinistres, fournisseurs et partenaires. \* Etablir des devis. \* Gérer les tâches RH (salaires, suivi des cas de maladie/accident, déclaration des salaires, etc.) \*\*Gestion financière et comptable\*\* \* Gérer la comptabilité générale et assurer le suivi financier des entreprises. \* Etablir les décomptes TVA chaque trimestre. \* Superviser les bouclements annuels, en collaboration avec la fiduciaire. \* Gérer les factures fournisseurs et clients ainsi que le suivi des paiements. \* Assurer le suivi de la trésorerie et des liquidités. \* Mettre en place des outils de contrôle et de reporting financier. \*\*Restructuration et organisation\*\* \* Organiser la restructuration administrative et financière de l'entreprise. \* Identifier les dysfonctionnements et proposer des solutions concrètes. \* Reprendre les processus existants, les clarifier et les améliorer. \* Mettre en place une organisation administrative et financière solide et durable. ### Qualifications Nous recherchons une personne autonome, organisée et rigoureuse, qui apprécie les environnements en évolution et les défis liés à la structuration d'une organisation. Vous disposez idéalement : \* Formation supérieure en comptabilité, gestion financière, administration ou titre jugé équivalent. \* Expérience confirmée dans une fonction similaire, idéalement en Suisse. \* Bonne maîtrise de la comptabilité suisse et des outils de gestion financière. \* Très bonnes compétences avec les outils informatiques usuels, notamment Excel. \* D'une capacité à structurer, prioriser et gérer plusieurs dossiers simultanément \* Autonomie, esprit d'analyse et aptitude à proposer des solutions concrètes. \* Excellentes capacités de communication et aisance dans les échanges avec différents interlocuteurs. \* Discrétion, fiabilité, organisation et sens élevé des responsabilités. \* La connaissance du secteur de la construction ou des échafaudages, constitue un atout. \* Très bonne maîtrise du français; la connaissance de l'allemand représente un avantage. ### Avantages \* Un poste à responsabilités au sein d'une entreprise en développement. \* Un poste stratégique avec de réelles responsabilités. \* La possibilité de construire et de structurer un département administratif et financier. \* Une implication directe dans la restructuration. \* Une grande autonomie dans l'organisation de votre travail. \* 5 semaines de vacances par année. \* Un 13e salaire. \* Une place de parc prise en charge par l'employeur. \* Un café offert chaque jour :) ### Application information \*\*Vous aimez les défis, la structuration et souhaitez jouer un rôle central dans le développement d'entreprises ? Nous serions ravis de faire votre connaissance !\*\* Nous vous invitons à transmettre votre candidature complète, de préférence par e\\-mail. Le poste est à pourvoir dès que possible, selon entente. !\[Pyramide 11 Echafaudages Sàrl\]( ) \* Pyramide 11 Echafaudages Sàrl Rte de la Glâne 5 1680 Romont \* \[ \](\< \>) jpidefc94fbjm jpit1145jm jpiy26jm

jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Expert Platform &amp; Systems Engineer---Expert Platform \& Systems Engineer=================================== **About**  METTLER TOLEDO is a global leader in precision instruments and services. We are renowned for innovation and quality across laboratory, process analytics, industrial, product inspection, and retailing applications. Our sales and service network is one of the most extensive in the industry. Our products are sold in more than 140 countries, and we have a direct presence in approximately 40 countries. For more information, please visit .     **Our Opening and Your Responsibilities**Within the AutoChem Business Unit, we build software that powers automated lab reactors used in scientific and industrial research around the world. Our systems help chemists and engineers design, execute, monitor, and analyze experiments with greater precision, safety, and efficiency. Our ecosystem and platform include a hardware abstraction layer, instrument terminal software, mature desktop software for instrument control, and locally deployed, cloud\-ready applications for data orchestration and management, field service, and production assembly work at the intersection of hardware and software, where engineering quality has a direct impact on product reliability and customer trust.To strengthen the team and to take our platform to the next level, we are looking for an experienced Expert Platform \& Systems Engineer (all genders) 100%. You will provide hands\-on technical leadership for our cloud\-ready application platform and DevOps foundations. Working with our architects and engineering teams, you will turn platform direction into implemented, adopted, and supported capabilities, while contributing system\-level expertise where hardware and software meet.In this role you will take on the following tasks:* You own and evolve the shared platform behind our locally deployed, cloud\-ready applications for data orchestration, instrument control, field service, and production assembly.* You implement reusable foundations for hosting, identity, configuration, data, messaging, integration, observability, security, and application lifecycle management.* You own DevOps across the software suite, including environments, build tooling, Azure DevOps pipelines, deployment automation, Terraform, packages, artifacts, security controls, and release traceability.* You define reliable installation, upgrade, rollback, diagnostics, and support for customer deployments while preserving future connected and SaaS options.* You lead system\-level hardware/software integration decisions covering capabilities, protocols, diagnostics, interfaces, and future software needs.* You lead through implementation, prototypes, reviews, mentoring, and practical enablement; you partner with architects and drive adoption without becoming a bottleneck. **What You Need to Succeed**We expect the following qualifications:* Extensive software engineering experience, typically 12\+ years, with demonstrated expert\-level ownership and hands\-on technical leadership across multiple products, systems, or engineering teams.* Deep hands\-on experience with C\# / .NET and modern backend or web development, and in implementing shared platforms, distributed systems, reusable services, and stable interfaces.* Strong Azure DevOps and CI/CD experience across build, test, security, packaging, and deployment, as well as hands\-on infrastructure\-as\-code experience, particularly Terraform, and repeatable environment provisioning.* Experience with cloud platforms, containers, orchestration, identity, messaging, and observability, and knowledge of software supply\-chain security, dependencies, secrets, signing, and release provenance.* Ability to prepare locally deployed products for future cloud and SaaS options pragmatically, and to modernize established systems incrementally while protecting reliability and compatibility.* Experience across hardware, firmware, protocols, device software, and application boundaries.* Ability to influence architects and engineering teams through expertise, collaboration, and delivery, with strong ownership, autonomy, communication, and mentoring skills in distributed teams.* You are a hands\-on expert engineer who combines platform, cloud, DevOps, and systems depth with pragmatic product judgment. You create clear direction, implement the foundations behind it, and balance today's deployments with future possibilities.* You lead through expertise, delivery, mentoring, and constructive influence. You care about secure, repeatable delivery, supportability, developer experience, and capabilities teams can adopt confidently.* AI/ML service deployment, model serving, computer vision, or industrial software experience is a plus.* Strong proficiency in English is required. **Our Offer to You**We offer:* Flexible working hours (depending on the role), a hybrid work model, and a wide portfolio of training opportunities* A 40\-hour work week with at least 25 vacation days per year, plus 4 to 7 additional days off between bank holidays* Free parking and direct access to public transport* Healthy lunches cooked onsite at our own METTLER TOLEDO restaurant, with special prices for employees* A range of additional attractive benefits, including employee discounts at select area businessesYou can expect challenging, interesting, and varied tasks in an innovative and international environment, with the opportunity to network globally and achieve your career goals.    Have we raised your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your complete application at our portal.Please note that we do not accept any application documents via e\-mail, only applications submitted on our job platform due to our data protection guidelines. jobs.title: Content & Product Specialist
jobs.description: Ref 2589689 \| Date: 6 Nov 2026![Clinique La Prairie]( )**Content \& Product Specialist*****Dear applicants, you have an assignment to complete at the bottom of this job add.******Applications will not be considered if not complete.***Definition of function and missionClinique La Prairie is a science\-based longevity company. Its value comes from turning medical innovation into programmes that people can understand, trust and book. As Product Content \& Education Specialist, you will know that science and that offer better than anyone outside the medical team. You will turn them into the content every team uses to explain the offer, sell it and prove it.This is a hands\-on expert role, built on writing and product knowledge. You write most of what you deliver yourself: brochures, web and sales copy, scripts, training content and briefs. Your value comes from how deeply you know the product and how well you write.The role sits in Strategic \& Product Marketing and reports to the Head of Strategic \& Product Marketing. On one side are Innovation and Medical; on the other are Sales, Digital, PR, APAC and the properties. Product creates the content and those teams use it. Your work covers the whole guest journey, from the first video a prospect sees to the brochure a sales advisor sends and the e\-learning module a new team member completes.In 2027, CLP's priority is to own scientific and medical excellence in longevity. No competitor holds this ground yet, and CLP's programmes and doctors already earn it. Most of the evidence exists inside the company but has not yet been made public. Your mission is to publish it accurately, in the brand's voice, across every destination.The role succeeds when:* Every destination presents the offer the same way, using the latest version.* Each programme or offer update reaches every material quickly and without errors.* Public content relies more on science, in line with the 2027 mix for Longevity Talks: 40% science, 30% performance, 30% personalities.* The content supports the 2027 KPIs: programmes sold and average price in Montreux, content performance, and CLP's share of AI answers on scientific and medical excellence.ResponsibilitiesA. Product Expertise \& Innovation\-to\-Market*Purpose: be the marketing team's reference on what CLP offers and why it works, and make sure every innovation reaches the market accurately.** Master the full portfolio, by destination (Montreux, Health Resorts, Longevity Hubs): every programme, protocol, pillar, diagnostic and treatment, plus the CLP Method and the science behind it.* Build and maintain the Product Knowledge Base, with one source of truth per programme: content, duration, price structure, inclusions, approved claims, medical references and differences by destination.* Build and maintain, with Medical, a library of evidence that can be made public: studies, the scientific committee, doctor profiles, results and data.* Be marketing's day\-to\-day contact for Innovation and Medical on product content. Follow the innovation pipeline, attend product reviews and learn about changes before they launch.* Check scientific accuracy and claims with Medical, and with Legal where needed, before any content is published.* For each programme or offer change, list every affected asset (brochures, toolkit, e\-learning, website, guest communications) and track it until all are updated.* Write the launch package for each new programme or update: key messages, sales narrative, FAQs and internal briefing.* Answer product questions from Sales, Digital, PR, Regional teams and the properties.* Provide verified product and scientific content for the website and its knowledge base.B. Offer \& Sales Content (Sales \& Marketing Enabling Toolkit)*Purpose: give Sales and every property the tools to present one standard offer and to hold a consultative, client\-led conversation.** Write and maintain the content of the Sales \& Marketing Enabling Toolkit, covering Global Brand, Health Resorts, Longevity Hubs and internal enablement. Keep its SharePoint structure and version control up to date.* Write and update brochures, one\-pagers, commercial fact sheets and programme summaries, all built on one standard offer across Resorts and Hubs.* Write pre\-booking templates, welcome communications and guest preparation materials.* Prepare the content package for new openings, such as the upcoming Longevity Hub in New York* Send each update to the markets with a short note on what changed, and withdraw outdated versions.C. Scientific \& Brand Content for the Funnel*Purpose: turn CLP's science, doctors and guest stories into content that Digital, PR, Sales and regional teams can use at each stage of the funnel.** Write storylines, scripts and briefs for video shoots with doctors and experts, so that medical expertise becomes clear and engaging content.* Develop topics, storylines and briefs for Longevity Talks and Guest Testimonials, with science at the centre of the mix.* Create content for each stage of the funnel, from awareness to consideration and conversion, and adapt it to CLP's customer personas (Achiever, Optimiser, Purist), including their motivations, expectations and preferred formats.* Write the content for educational formats aimed at prospects, such as webinars, and prepare the experts who present them.* Provide scientific and product content for digital channels such as the website, newsletter and social media, which the Digital team then publishes. The scope may later extend to newsletter strategy.* Write background content on programmes, experts and CLP's scientific credentials to support PR.* Brief regional adaptations so that each market has relevant proof, voices and language versions.* Give product and scientific input to brand campaigns and video productions.D. Internal Education \& Enablement*Purpose: make sure everyone who speaks for CLP understands the offer, the science and the brand, and can explain them with confidence.** Write the annual brand and product education agenda.* Lead the e\-learning project end to end: write the scripts for the quarterly modules, organise and brief the video shoots, and coordinate the launch with HR, building on the three chapters already delivered.* Write and present product training for Sales and property teams at each launch and opening.* Write onboarding materials and internal fact sheets for new and existing teams.* Propose a simple way to check product knowledge after each module, such as a short quiz or certification.Profile requirementsEducation \& experience* A degree in communication, journalism, literature or marketing. A background in life sciences, health or nutrition is a strong plus. Business Analyst PLM
====================

**The company**

**We don't exclusively manufacture legendary watches; we keep in time with technology!**



The Swatch Group Services' IT division plays a key role in the digital transformation of a global leader in watchmaking.  

At the heart of innovation, you will help design high\-performing technological solutions serving iconic brands.  



For our growing team into the PLM team, we are looking for a

**Business Analyst PLM**

**Job description**

###### As a Business Analyst PLM, you will:

* Act as co\-owner of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) evolution projects and contribute to the Swatch Group's digital transformation initiatives
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of end\-to\-end processes within the 3DEXPERIENCE platform
* Analyze business requirements and design innovative solutions leveraging Dassault Systèmes technologies
* Lead and coordinate projects from requirements gathering through implementation, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live support
* Serve as Simulation Service Owner for Swatch Group companies, managing solutions such as SIMULIA (Abaqus, Simpack, CST Studio), Ansys, Forge, and Sigmasoft
* Provide functional and technical support to Simulation users across the Group
* Manage projects using both Waterfall and Agile (Scrum) methodologies in collaboration with Swatch Group brands and manufacturing entities
* Drive digital transformation initiatives, including the migration of companies to the 3DEXPERIENCE collaborative platform
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, coordinate multidisciplinary teams, and ensure the continuous improvement of PLM processes and solutions


**Profile**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Interest in innovation, digital transformation and engineering processes
* First experience in project management or willingness to develop project management skills
* Effective communication across technical and non\-technical teams
* Team\-oriented, autonomous and eager to learn
* Comfortable working in a changing environment
* Service\-oriented with a strong customer focus


**Professional requirements**

* Technical degree, Higher Technical School diploma (Swiss HF/ES) or equivalent qualification in Microtechnology, Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, or a related field
* Good understanding of product design, development and industrialization processes, ideally within the microtechnology and/or watchmaking industry
* Knowledge of PLM solutions, Simulation (FEM, MBD, EM) and/or CAD environments would be an asset
* Knowledge of 3DEXPERIENCE and/or CATIA V5 would be an advantage


**Languages**

 

* Native French or German speaker with good working knowledge of the other language
* Good command of English, both written and spoken


 

You may not tick every box, and that's perfectly fine. If you are motivated, curious, and eager to learn, we will gladly support your development and share our expertise.

 

**Company address**

ETA SA Manufacture Horlogère Suisse

Schild\-Rust\-Strasse 17

CH\-2540 Grenchen

**Contact**

Florine Marois

jobs.title: Director, Commissioning, EMEA
jobs.description:
Director, Commissioning, EMEA

Role Summary

The Commissioning Director, EMEA will lead commissioning across STACK data centre projects, from early project engagement through testing, validation and final power and facilities handover. This role provides programme-level leadership for the planning, development and consistent execution of commissioning activities across mission-critical facilities, ensuring systems perform safely, reliably and in line with design intent and client requirements.

Working across engineering, construction, operations and external commissioning partners, you will set and maintain commissioning standards, oversee test strategies and documentation, and provide clear visibility of progress, risk and readiness across the EMEA portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead the development and execution of commissioning plans across STACK EMEA projects, including all commissioning levels through Integrated Systems Testing and handover.

· Develop, standardise and review commissioning documentation, including Functional Performance Tests, Factory Acceptance Tests, equipment start-up procedures, installation checklists, test protocols, scripts and methods.

· Ensure commissioning documentation and activities align with project design, specifications, Basis of Design and Owner’s Project Requirements.

· Provide programme-level oversight of multi-discipline pre-commissioning and commissioning activities across critical infrastructure construction and special projects.

· Coordinate with project teams, client engineers and technical stakeholders to assess issues identified during testing, determine criticality and drive appropriate resolution.

· Oversee QA/QC of pre-functional and functional test results, ensuring completeness, accuracy and appropriate interpretation of results.

· Provide commissioning input into project design, planning and schedules, identifying risks, dependencies and potential constraints early.

· Ensure commissioning activities comply with applicable safety, environmental, quality and technical standards, and actively support STACK safety programmes.

· Manage and coordinate commissioning agents and subcontractors on site, escalating issues or potential blockers that could affect project delivery.

· Track commissioning progress against key delivery milestones and provide programme reporting, metrics and data-driven insight to stakeholders.

· Partner with Procurement, Legal, Finance and other functions to develop effective cross-functional processes and resolve delivery gaps.

· Manage commissioning budgets and support effective commercial oversight of commissioning activities.

What You’ll Bring

· Demonstrable commissioning leadership experience within data centres or other mission-critical environments, with strong experience managing complex mechanical and electrical commissioning programmes.

· A qualification in Electrical, Mechanical, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

· Strong technical knowledge of mechanical and electrical plant and services supporting mission-critical Data Centre environments, including MV/LV distribution switchgear, automatic transfer schemes, standby generators, UPS, chillers, CRAC/CRAH systems, ancillary cooling plant, BMS and automation/monitoring systems.

· Advanced understanding of mechanical and/or electrical systems commissioning, controls and design principles.

· Ability to read and interpret construction and technical documentation, including electrical and mechanical schematics, control diagrams, specifications and design drawings.

· Knowledge of Data Centre and mission-critical design concepts, commissioning standards and safety requirements.

· Experience developing and reviewing test scripts and protocols that validate design intent and operational performance.

· Commercial awareness, including budget management, contracting considerations, programme reporting and performance metrics.

· Strong communication, stakeholder management and negotiation skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, delivery, operations, clients and external partners.

· Comfort working across multiple projects and countries, with the ability to travel to EMEA project and installation sites as required (approximately 20%).

What We Offer

· The opportunity to play a key role in delivering critical digital infrastructure across EMEA.

· The chance to build your career with STACK in a fast-growing, international Data Centre business.

· Competitive compensation and benefits designed to support you both professionally and personally.

About STACK Infrastructure

STACK Infrastructure is a global digital infrastructure partner to the world’s most innovative companies. We develop, build and operate Data Centres designed to meet the scale, performance and sustainability requirements of today’s leading technology businesses. Across EMEA, our teams work together to deliver resilient, high-quality infrastructure and create long-term value for our customers and communities.

jobs.title: (Senior) Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
You take a signed customer and turn them into a flagship reference, owning the journey from first go-live to a full rollout across their plants.

Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We serve manufacturers from Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, and are backed by Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Palantir, McKinsey, Meta, Google, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity.

WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT?

You will take a signed logo and turn them into a flagship reference. That means getting onto the shopfloor fast, understanding what drives their KPIs, and deploying Ethon's agentic workflows where the impact is highest. You implement the first use case while already mapping the next. Once one is live, you find the next one. When the engineer is sold, you bring in the plant manager. Once the plant manager is convinced, you get to the COO. This is what you'll do:

  • Own the deployment: You're the person who makes sure go-live happens on time and the customer's team knows how to use it. You handle the onboarding, the training, and the change management that gets a new platform embedded into daily operations.

  • Turn shopfloor problems into business cases: An operator tells you yield drops on line 3 every Tuesday night. You figure out why, quantify what it costs, and build the case for the next deployment. You're as comfortable talking to a process engineer as you are presenting to a VP of Operations.

  • Drive expansion: You know which teams in the account haven't seen Ethon yet, which problems are still unsolved, and what it takes to get the next use case signed.

  • Be on-site: You're in factories. The insights that matter don't come from email chains and slides, they come from being on the floor.

  • Feed the product: You're closest to what customers actually need. You bring that signal back to Engineering and Product and you help us build something better.

  • Work with the team: GTM & Sales brings the logo with your help as a trustworthy industry expert, you take it from there. You work tightly with Engineering on delivery and with the commercial team on expansion opportunities.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING?

The best people in this seat combine strategic thinking with the willingness to get their hands dirty on a shopfloor. We can teach you our product. We can't teach you to care about how things get made, or to push hard when a deployment is stuck.

  • You're technically sharp enough to understand a production process and commercially minded enough to turn a pain point into a business case

  • You have 3-5 years of experience in something demanding: consulting, enterprise tech deployment, or a career on the shopfloor

  • You know how to manage complex stakeholder environments, from shopfloor operators to C-suite sponsors

  • You've run change management or adoption programs and know what it takes to get people to actually use new tools

  • You have a builder mindset: when something isn't working, your instinct is to fix it rather than escalate it

  • You're open to travel 30-50% of the time

This is how we'll set you up in your first six months:

  • Months 1-2: Learn about product, customers, and how our best deployments get done. You shadow live accounts, learn the platform end-to-end, and expand your understanding of how manufacturers think. You start working on your first account.

  • Months 3-4: You own delivery for one or more accounts, with support from the team.

  • Months 5-6: Full ownership of one or more customers. You're running deployments, driving expansion conversations, and your first upsell is in motion.

Great fits tend to come from backgrounds like:

  • Deployment, implementation, or customer success at high-growth industrial tech companies (e.g., Palantir, c3ai, Rockwell, Siemens Digital Industries) where you owned outcomes

  • Top-tier consulting, ready to stop writing recommendations and start executing them

  • Digital transformation or operational excellence roles inside manufacturing companies, where things were moving too slowly for you

  • Manufacturing or process engineering, where you've lived the problems Ethon solves, you know what a plant manager actually cares about, and customers trust you the moment you walk onto their floor

  • A technical degree in chemical, mechanical, electrical engineering, physics, or a related field

Bonus:

  • Experience with MES, ERP, Historian, or quality systems in manufacturing environments

  • Fluency in German, French, or another European language

WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU?

We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person. Feedback loops are short, access to founders is direct. People who prove themselves here outgrow their title fast.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Performance-based career & growth paths

  • On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules

  • Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success

  • Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation

  • Flexible parental leave

  • Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse world we live in. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, and we especially welcome voices traditionally underrepresented in tech.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff Intern
jobs.description:
What is Finary?

Money is broken. Most people's wealth sits in products they did not choose, with fees they cannot see, and a private banker costs more than they will ever pay. We are putting one in everyone's pocket: the same quality of advice for a €10K saver and a €10M client.

Mounir launched Finary in 2021, and more than 1M people now track their wealth with us, for free. Finary AI turns that financial context into a plan, and our own investment products and in-house wealth advisors (Finary One) make it real: clarity on what you have, guidance on where you are going, action to get there.

Why now?

AI makes this vision possible, and 3 things make it hard to copy:

  • Data: years of per-user financial history, goals and risk profiles that no public dataset holds.

  • Brand: half of our new users come from our own channels, and 1 signup in 5 names our YouTube channel.

  • Licences: stocks, ETFs and crypto on one regulated platform, passportable across Europe. We started early, when a simple registration was enough: PSAN in 2022, Investment Firm licence in March 2026, MiCA in July 2026. Since July, every crypto platform in Europe must be licensed or stop.

Many fintechs will have the AI, and a few will have the licences. We have all 3. We raised €40M from Hedosophia, Y Combinator and Speedinvest, alongside founders and operators like Steve Anavi & Alexandre Prot (Qonto), Matthieu Rouif (Photoroom), Eric Demuth (Bitpanda), Axel Weber (former UBS Chairman) and Harsh Sinha (CTO at Wise). There's never been a more exciting time to join.

What we offer

We're 70 builders who genuinely love what they do: real ownership from day one, tier-1 salary and equity, offices in the heart of Paris with hybrid remote, and quarterly gatherings we actually look forward to.

We hire A-players who are as kind as they are demanding, people whose ideas transform not just our product but the way we work and think. Our culture is direct, transparent, and built on radical candor: we challenge each other openly, then commit. And we don't hedge on AI. It's the single most important skill of the next decade and a real bar here. Everyone at Finary has rebuilt how they work around it. If that's already second nature to you, you'll be surrounded by people pushing that frontier every day.

Read more about our values here.

The role

The CEO Office owns Finary's most important strategic projects, the delivery of the business plan, company’s operating rituals and runs the board and investor relations. Today one Chief of Staff carries all of it. You join as a real partner: you own a share of these projects from day one and move key topics forward fast, side by side with the Chief of Staff and the CEO.

What you will do

  • Take one area of the company and measurably improve its metrics.

  • Lead the analyses behind big decisions: business plan updates, international expansion, new offers and segments. You turn a question into a recommendation the leadership team can act on.

  • Run the board operating rhythm and the monthly reporting, with numbers you have checked yourself.

  • Work with Finance on budget, targets, forecast and costs.

  • Own Finary's operating rituals (weekly kick-off, all-hands, performance reviews, leadership topics) and make them sharper.

What success looks like

  • After 1 month: you know Finary's business, numbers and new vision, and you run the operating rituals.

  • After 3 months: you co-run the board and the monthly reporting, and the team you focus on performs measurably better.

  • After 6 months: you are a multiplier across teams. The CEO Office delivers more, faster.

Who you are

  • You have a track record of winning: a competition, a sport, a project where you went further than anyone expected.

  • You own outcomes, not tasks. You come back with proposals, not questions.

  • You are extremely rigorous with numbers: models, Excel, data. Nothing leaves your hands unchecked.

  • You write short, clear English that a board member reads in 5 minutes.

  • You are an AI pioneer.

  • You build trust fast and get things done through people, without authority.

  • You are discreet and put the company first.

  • You are in your final year or a recent graduate of a top business or engineering school, fluent in French and English.

Bonus: a first internship in strategy consulting, ideally followed by startup ops or product. Being a Finary user.

Practical details

  • 6-month end-of-studies internship or graduate program, starting January 2027.

  • Onsite in Paris, every day, with the CEO Office.

  • Process: application review, screening call, case study with a debrief with the Chief of Staff and the CEO, then a culture fit interview.

Compensation: €1.8K – €2K per month

jobs.description:
La mission de Finary

Notre mission : rendre le pouvoir aux investisseurs. Le bon conseil financier a toujours existé, mais il était réservé à ceux qui dépassaient un certain seuil de patrimoine. Nous changeons la donne en construisant la plateforme d'investissement tout-en-un, propulsée par l'IA : suivre ses actifs, gérer son budget, investir et se former, au même endroit. Une idée simple et ambitieuse nous guide : mettre un banquier privé dans la poche de chacun.

Mounir a lancé Finary en 2021, et plus d'un million de personnes nous confient aujourd'hui leur vie financière. Nous lançons des produits de pointe avec une touche de plaisir, et nous sommes exigeants sur l'expérience, la performance et la simplicité.

 

Pourquoi maintenant ?

Une nouvelle génération d'investisseurs émerge : ambitieuse, impliquée, débarrassée des tabous autour de l'argent. Nous croyons en un monde où investir permet à chacun de vivre la vie dont il a toujours rêvé. Pour accélérer, nous avons levé 40M€ auprès de Hedosophia, Y Combinator et Speedinvest, aux côtés de fondateurs et d'opérateurs comme Steve Anavi et Alexandre Prot (Qonto), Matthieu Rouif (Photoroom), Eric Demuth (Bitpanda), Axel Weber (ancien président d'UBS) et Harsh Sinha (CTO de Wise).

En juillet 2026, l'AMF nous a accordé l'agrément MiCA, qui s'ajoute à notre agrément d'Entreprise d'Investissement : nous sommes l'une des très rares plateformes françaises à détenir les deux, avec actions, ETF et crypto réunis sur une seule plateforme régulée, au moment même où l'Europe se consolide autour des acteurs agréés. Il n'y a jamais eu de meilleur moment pour nous rejoindre.

 

Ce que nous offrons

Nous sommes 70 builders qui aimons profondément ce que nous faisons : de vraies responsabilités dès le premier jour, un package salaire et equity au meilleur niveau du marché, des bureaux en plein cœur de Paris avec du remote hybride, et des offsites trimestriels qu'on attend vraiment.

Nous recrutons des A-players aussi bienveillants qu'exigeants, des personnes dont les idées transforment notre produit autant que notre façon de travailler et de penser. Notre culture est directe et transparente : on se challenge ouvertement, puis on s'aligne et on exécute. Et sur l'IA, pas de demi-mesure : c'est la compétence la plus importante de la décennie et un vrai critère chez nous. Chacun a repensé sa manière de travailler autour d'elle. Si c'est déjà une seconde nature pour vous, vous trouverez ici des gens qui repoussent cette frontière chaque jour.

Découvrez nos valeurs ici.

---

LE POSTE

Finary Media fait la première chaîne YouTube d’éducation financière en France : 880 000 abonnés et 5 à 10 millions de vues par mois, tout est produit en interne. Chaque vidéo est traitée comme un produit : on mesure, on itère, on améliore.

Rattaché·e à Rayan, tu travailles sur l’ensemble de la chaîne d’écriture : recherche, script, vérification, packaging et présentation face caméra.

TES MISSIONS

  • Mener la recherche sur des sujets d’investissement et de patrimoine (ETF, assurance-vie, immobilier, fiscalité), à partir de sources fiables, et vérifier chaque donnée.

  • Rédiger des scripts pour la chaîne YouTube et les formats courts, puis les faire évoluer avec l’auteur senior jusqu’à la version validée.

  • Présenter tes scripts face caméra.

  • Concevoir le packaging des vidéos : titres, accroches, angles de miniature.

  • Intégrer l’IA à chaque étape de la production et développer tes propres outils : prompts structurés, workflows, automatisations.

CE QUE CE STAGE T’APPORTE

  • Écrire pour une audience de plusieurs centaines de milliers de personnes, avec des résultats mesurés sur chaque vidéo.

  • Une formation à la présentation face caméra, au sein d’une équipe qui tourne chaque semaine.

  • La rigueur d’une rédaction financière, où aucune approximation n’est acceptée.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

  • Étudiant·e en Bac+4 ou Bac+5 en école de journalisme, en école de commerce ou en master de finance ou d’économie, avec une convention de stage.

  • Une pratique avancée de l’IA : au-delà d’un usage conversationnel, tu as déjà conçu des prompts structurés, des workflows ou des automatisations pour produire mieux et plus vite.

  • Un vrai esprit de synthèse, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

  • La capacité à intégrer un retour rapidement et à le traduire dans la version suivante.

ATOUTS APPRÉCIÉS

  • Une expérience vidéo : tournage, présentation ou montage.

  • Des compétences techniques : code, outils no-code, création d’outils d’analyse financière.

  • Une première expérience en finance, dans un média ou dans une fintech.

Entretiens

Les entretiens avec les candidat·es francophones se déroulent en français. En tant qu’entreprise internationale, nous attendons un niveau d’anglais professionnel, que nous évaluons lors de l’entretien de présélection.

jobs.title: IT Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an IT Operations Engineer to help build, operate, and secure the infrastructure that supports our rapidly growing company.

This is a broad role an early, hyper scaling startup. You will work across enterprise IT, server administration, hosting, DevOps, user support, and information security. The role combines hands-on technical operations with the opportunity to develop robust, well-managed IT environments for engineering, manufacturing, testing, and business operations.

We are looking for someone who understands that reliable IT is essential to a high-performance engineering organisation and that processes and platforms need to be scalable from initial implementation. You should be comfortable working across both Windows and Linux environments, troubleshooting directly, and improving systems rather than simply maintaining them.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching ballistic rockets on a regular basis, have just crossed €10m in revenue for our first operating year and are applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Operate and improve IT infrastructure across servers, endpoints, identity systems, Microsoft 365, Exchange, Active Directory, and related services.

  • Manage Windows and Linux systems, including configuration, patching, backups, monitoring, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management.

  • Support hosting and DevOps activities, including deployments, automation, system reliability, and operational documentation.

  • Manage user access, permissions, devices, software, and IT support requests across the organisation.

  • Help design and maintain secure, segregated, and reliable IT environments for engineering, operations, and business functions.

  • Support IT processes including incident management, change control, asset management, configuration management, and security compliance.

What we are looking for

  • Experience in IT operations, IT support, systems administration, server management, DevOps, hosting, or a similar technical role.

  • Practical experience administering Microsoft environments, including Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Exchange, or comparable services.

  • Experience managing servers and infrastructure in Windows, Linux, data-centre, or hybrid environments.

  • A strong interest in IT security, system reliability, access control, hardening, monitoring, and structured operations.

  • The ability to troubleshoot methodically, document solutions clearly, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical users.

  • A degree, vocational qualification, professional certification, or equivalent practical experience in IT, computer science, systems engineering, or a related field.

Desirable experience/Things you will have the opportunity to support

  • Classified-information requirements such as VS-NfD or higher, BSI IT-Grundschutz, or similar security frameworks.

  • Access and permission management, system hardening, security monitoring, segregated networks, or environments with high protection requirements.

  • BSI-approved cryptography or other regulated information-security requirements.

  • Cloud computing, virtualisation, hypervisors such as Proxmox, virtual machines, Docker, or Kubernetes.

  • Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Ansible or Terraform, together with software-development experience.

  • Enterprise IT tools including mobile-device management, patch management, CMDB, ISMS, monitoring, or hardware and asset-management systems.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

Please submit applications in English

jobs.title: Account Executive, Southern Europe
jobs.description:
🏢 Who we are

A team from Germany with the vision to make advanced network security accessible for everyone

We are a software company developing an open source zero-trust network security platform that is both easy to use and affordable for teams of all sizes and budgets. Our mission is grounded in a simple yet powerful belief: secure private networking is a fundamental right of every modern company.

Since our launch on GitHub in 2021, we have gained trust among thousands of companies seeking secure and seamless solutions for connecting remote employees and infrastructure. By replacing traditional centralized VPNs, NetBird has become a trusted choice for modern network security, connecting today hundreds of thousands of users and machines worldwide. Our open source, community-driven approach has been a key driver of our success. We listen to our users, and their input helps us make network security better for everyone.

Want to see what we're working on? Check out our GitHub repo at https://github.com/netbirdio/netbird or https://netbird.io/knowledge-hub

✏️ What you will do

As Account Executive for Southern Europe, you'll build NetBird's business in France, Spain, Portugal, Italy and Greece, with France as your anchor market. Many teams in the region already run NetBird through our open source and self-serve products, and you'll turn that adoption into annual cloud and self-hosted enterprise contracts while opening new mid-market and enterprise accounts. You own the full cycle, from first touch to signed contract and expansion. You'll report to our Head of Sales and work closely with our Solutions Engineers, Marketing and Product.

You will:

  • Own the full sales cycle in Southern Europe: prospecting, discovery, demos with a Solutions Engineer, proposals, negotiation and close.

  • Turn open source and self-serve users into paying annual customers, using product usage signals to find the right accounts and the right moment.

  • Run outbound into mid-market and enterprise companies that want to replace legacy VPNs such as OpenVPN, Cisco AnyConnect, Fortinet or GlobalProtect.

  • Sell to technical buyers, from infrastructure and network engineers to security leads, with a clear story on open source, self-hosting and zero trust.

  • Build relationships with MSPs, integrators and resellers across the region.

  • Meet customers on site, at conferences and at meetups, and join the team in Berlin for regular offsites.

  • Keep your forecast and HubSpot data accurate, and bring regional product and pricing feedback back to the team.

  • Shape messaging for French-speaking markets with Marketing, including compliance and data sovereignty topics such as NIS2, GDPR and SecNumCloud.

This is a builder role: you'll be the first person dedicated to the region, with a lot of freedom in how you build it and room to grow as the team expands.

🔎 What we are looking for

We're looking for a French-speaking Account Executive who loves selling technical products and has built a territory from little or nothing. If you've sold commercial open source, developer-led or security products into France and Southern Europe, we'd especially love to hear from you.

Must-Haves

  • 3+ years closing new business as an Account Executive in B2B software, with a track record of hitting quota.

  • Experience selling networking, security, infrastructure or DevOps software, for example VPN, ZTNA or SASE, identity, firewall or cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience with an open source, product-led or freemium model, and turning free users into paying customers.

  • Comfortable discussing WireGuard, VPN vs. zero trust, SSO and identity provider integration, Kubernetes and self-hosting with engineers.

  • A structured qualification approach such as MEDDPICC.

  • Native French, and able to run discovery, negotiations and executive meetings in French.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Self-directed and organised when working remotely, and happy to travel regularly across the region and to Berlin.

  • You work AI native. You use AI tools every day, for example to research accounts, prepare discovery calls or draft outreach, and you know where they help and where they don't.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Spanish, Italian or Portuguese.

  • Experience as the first or second Account Executive in a new region at a startup.

  • An existing network of IT and security leaders in France, Spain or Italy.

  • Experience with channel partners, MSPs or public sector procurement.

  • Experience with HubSpot.

🌟 What makes you a great fit

These are the values we work by as a team, and what they mean for this role:

  • Own the outcome: The region is yours. You build your own pipeline, own your number, and fix what's in the way instead of waiting for it to be fixed.

  • Default to candor: You forecast honestly, call out deals that aren't real early, and tell customers clearly what NetBird does and doesn't do.

  • Stay close to the user: You know our product well enough to have credible conversations with engineers, and you bring what customers say back to the team.

😌 What's in it for you

We know that happy and supported team members build the best products. That's why we offer:

  • Competitive compensation including salary and equity.

  • Attractive commission plan with no cap on variable pay.

  • Fully remote within the region (+/-1 Central European Time), with regular time with the team in Berlin.

  • Build a region from day one: real ownership of the territory, and room to grow as we expand our sales team.

  • Close collaboration with our Head of Sales, Solutions Engineers, Marketing and Product.

  • The essentials done well: team lunches, team events, and health and fitness programs (e.g., Wellpass).

If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

Aus Europa, für Europa – wir entwickeln Europas Business-KI.

Wir sind das größte KI-Start-up in Aachen.

Mittelständische Unternehmen profitieren davon, wenn internes Wissen sofort nutzbar wird und intelligente Agenten darauf reagieren können. Wir glauben an eine Zukunft, in der Business-KI – einschließlich Agenten innerhalb von amber und anderen Plattformen – auf einer gemeinsamen Kontextebene arbeitet. So können Teams schneller arbeiten, Übergaben nahtlos erfolgen und wertvolles Wissen im Unternehmen bleiben.

Als (Senior) Fullstack Engineer (F/M/*) entwickelst du unsere Plattform ganzheitlich weiter – von der Benutzeroberfläche bis zu den dahinterliegenden Services. Ein wichtiger Teil deiner Arbeit ist die Gestaltung moderner, intuitiver Nutzererlebnisse. Gleichzeitig bringst du dich in Backend- und API-Themen ein und sorgst dafür, dass alle Komponenten zuverlässig zusammenspielen.

Wenn du ein Unternehmen suchst, dessen Produkt im Arbeitsalltag von Tausenden Menschen einen echten Unterschied macht, dann gestalte mit uns die Zukunft nutzerzentrierter Technologien und bewirb dich jetzt! Werde Teil eines Teams, das Wert auf Codequalität, Mentoring und kontinuierliches Lernen legt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und verbesserst die Benutzeroberflächen unserer Plattform mit Vue.js und Nuxt.js.

  • Du achtest auf intuitive Bedienbarkeit, responsive Darstellung und eine zuverlässige Performance im Frontend.

  • Du setzt Features über den gesamten Stack um und integrierst RESTful APIs in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Produkt- und Backend-Team.

  • Du bringst dich in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Backend-Services ein, zum Beispiel bei Schnittstellen und der Verarbeitung asynchroner Daten.

  • Du schreibst sauberen, gut getesteten und wartbaren Code – sowohl im Frontend als auch im Backend.

  • Du wirkst an Architekturentscheidungen mit und hilfst, unsere Tools und Entwicklungskonventionen weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du identifizierst Performance-Engpässe und findest passende Verbesserungen für die betroffenen Bereiche unserer Plattform.

  • Du führst Code-Reviews durch, unterstützt weniger erfahrene Entwickler:innen und teilst dein Wissen im Team.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für wichtige Features und unterstützt das Team bei kritischen Releases.

  • Du förderst die kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer Codequalität und Zusammenarbeit.

Deine Qualifikationen

  • Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in der Frontend-Entwicklung mit.

  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit Vue.js und Nuxt.js sowie sehr gute Kenntnisse in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3 und SCSS/SASS.

  • Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis von responsivem Design, Barrierefreiheit und Browserkompatibilität.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit RESTful APIs, Authentifizierungsprozessen und der Verarbeitung asynchroner Daten.

  • Du bringst Erfahrung mit Backend-Entwicklung mit; Kenntnisse in Node.js sind von Vorteil.

  • Du bist mit Git-basierten Workflows, CI/CD-Pipelines, agilen Methoden und modernen Frontend-Tools wie Webpack oder Vite vertraut.

  • Du setzt Best Practices im Testing ein und hast Erfahrung mit Tools wie Jest, Cypress oder vergleichbaren Frameworks.

  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für UI/UX und arbeitest gerne mit Produkt- und Design-Teams zusammen.

  • Du bringst begonnene Aufgaben zuverlässig zu Ende und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Arbeit.

  • Du hast Freude daran, weniger erfahrene Entwickler:innen zu unterstützen und weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Wir stellen unsere Ambitionen über unser Ego. Wir sind ein junges, sehr ambitioniertes Team – deine Ambitionen sollten stärker sein als dein Ego.

  • Du sprichst fließend Englisch und Deutsch.

Deine Benefits

  • Team-Offsites: Da du in einem internationalen Team arbeitest, treffen wir uns zweimal im Jahr an einem Ort irgendwo in Europa.

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Zusätzlich belohnen wir herausragende Leistungen mit Unternehmensanteilen, sodass du direkt am Erfolg des Unternehmens beteiligt bist.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Bei uns kannst du bestehende Fähigkeiten ausbauen und neue erlernen.

  • Persönliche Weiterentwicklung: Wir fördern deine Entwicklung durch Weiterbildungen und Freiraum für Eigenverantwortung.

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Regelmäßige persönliche Zusammenarbeit ist uns wichtig. Deshalb treffen wir uns dreimal pro Woche an einem unserer Standorte.

  • Du hast die Wahl: Wir übernehmen entweder die Kosten für ein bezuschusstes Deutschlandticket oder eine Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club.

  • Ein motiviertes Team: Arbeite mit Menschen zusammen, die KI-Lösungen für mittelständische Unternehmen zugänglich machen möchten.

  • Modernste Technologien und Tools 🔨

Ein paar Worte zum Schluss

Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung zu übernehmen: Gestalte die Weiterentwicklung unserer Plattform mit und bring deine Expertise in ein wegweisendes KI-Produkt ein.

Klingt spannend? Dann werde jetzt Teil unseres Teams und sende uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf. Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören!

Bitte beachte, dass wir für diese Position ausschließlich Kandidat:innen suchen, die sich in Deutschland befinden.

Lass uns gemeinsam etwas Großes aufbauen! 🚀

Compensation: €60K – €90K
