jobs.title: Auditeur - Horaires flexibles, Parking (H/F)
jobs.description: Auditeur - Horaires flexible, Parking Notre client est un cabinet d'audit indépendant à taille humaine, reconnu au Luxembourg pour son approche de proximité et la qualité de l'accompagnement proposé à ses clients. Dans le cadre de son développement, la structure souhaite accueillir un Auditeur expérimenté ayant l'ambition de construire progressivement son avenir au sein du cabinet et d'évoluer, à terme, vers une position de Partner.Vous intégrerez une équipe à taille humaine, composée de professionnels expérimentés, et interviendrez sur un portefeuille de clients varié incluant notamment des fonds d'investissement, des structures de titrisation ainsi que des sociétés commerciales et industrielles. Au fil de votre évolution, vous serez amené à prendre davantage d'autonomie dans la gestion des missions, le suivi des relations clients, la supervision des équipes et la participation au développement commercial du cabinet.Cette opportunité représente avant tout un projet de carrier/ière construit sur le long terme. Le cabinet souhaite accompagner progressivement le futur Partner dans sa prise de responsabilités et lui donner une véritable place dans le développement de la structure, tant sur le plan stratégique que commercial. Une belle opportunité pour un professionnel souhaitant rejoindre un cabinet stable, en croissance, et s'investir durablement dans un projet entrepreneurial, avec une perspective concrète d'association à moyen terme. Vos responsabilités / Cabinet d'audit - Auditeur - Germanophone - Mamer Vous gérez en toute autonomie un portefeuille de sociétés commerciales et supervisez l'ensemble du processus d'audit, depuis la planification des missions jusqu'à leur finalisation et l'émission des rapports.Vous planifiez, dirigez et réalisez les missions d'audit, en garantissant le respect des normes professionnelles, des obligations réglementaires et des standards de qualité du cabinet.Vous analysez les risques et problématiques clés identifiés au cours des missions et formulez des recommandations pertinentes et à forte valeur ajoutée, adaptées aux besoins de vos clients.En tant qu'interlocuteur privilégié, vous assurez la gestion de la relation avec les clients, leur management ainsi qu'avec les Partners, en veillant au bon déroulement et au suivi des missions. Offre & avantages / Cabinet d'audit - Auditeur - Germanophone - Mamer Une rémunération pouvant atteindre . € brut annuel, en fonction de votre expérience et de votre expertise.Une place de parking dédiée, ainsi qu'un environnement de travail agréable et facilement accessible, situé à seulement quelques minutes du centre-ville de Luxembourg.L'opportunité d'intégrer un cabinet d'audit à taille humaine, avec des Partners accessibles et fortement impliqués dans les missions et la vie du cabinet.Un environnement favorisant l'autonomie, la prise d'initiative et le développement professionnel, avec la possibilité de contribuer activement à l'évolution de la structure.Une perspective concrète d'association à moyen/long terme, vous permettant de progressivement prendre part aux décisions stratégiques, au développement commercial et à la croissance du cabinet. jobs.title: CHARGE D'AFFAIRES EXECUTION RENOVATION (H/F/X)
jobs.description: En tant que Chargé(e) d'Affaires Exécution Rénovation, vous prenez le relais des équipes commerciales une fois le projet vendu. Vous êtes responsable de la bonne réalisation des chantiers et veillez au respect des engagements pris auprès du client en matier/ière de qualité, de budget et de délai. Véritable chef d'orchestre du chantier, vous coordonnez les sous-traitants, planifiez les différentes phases de travaux et assurez le suivi des opérations jusqu'à la réception finale. QUI SOMMES NOUS ?Remake fait partie du groupe Reckinger Alfred SA, acteur reconnu au Luxembourg dans les domaines des techniques du bâtiment et de la rénovation.À travers Remake, nous accompagnons les particuliers dans leurs projets de transformation et de rénovation de l'habitat. Notre ambition est de proposer une solution unique à nos clients en prenant en charge l'ensemble de leur projet, de la conception jusqu'à la réalisation.Notre force repose sur un réseau de partenaires et de sous-traitants qualifiés couvrant tous les corps de métier : chauffage, sanitaire, électricité, toiture, menuiserie, peinture, carrelage, isolation, aménagement intérieur et rénovation générale.Qu'il s'agisse d'une salle de bain clé en main, d'un aménagement de combles, d'une rénovation énergétique ou d'une transformation complète de maison, Remake coordonne l'ensemble des intervenants afin d'offrir au client un interlocuteur unique et une gestion simplifiée de son chantier. VOS MISSIONS :Organiser le lancement des projets vendus par les équipes commerciales Analyser les dossiers et préparer les phases d'exécution Planifier les interventions des différents sous-traitants Coordonner l'ensemble des corps de métier intervenant sur les chantiers Assurer les réunions de chantier avec les clients et les partenaires Veiller au respect des plannings, des budgets et des objectifs de qualité Contrôler la conformité des prestations réalisées Identifier les risques et anticiper les éventuelles difficultés d'exécution Gérer les adaptations de chantier et les travaux complémentaires Valider les états d'avancement et les facturations des sous-traitants Assurer le suivi financier et la rentabilité des projets Préparer et réaliser les réceptions de chantier Garantir la satisfaction du client jusqu'à la clôture complète du projet TYPES DE PROJETS :Selon les projets et les besoins de nos clients, vous intervenez notamment dans les domaines suivants :Les rénovations complètes de maisons et d'appartementsLes transformations intérieuresLes aménagements de comblesLes salles de bain clé en mainLes rénovations énergétiquesLes extensions et réaménagementsLes projets nécessitant l'intervention de plusieurs corps de métier VOTRE PROFIL :Vous aimez coordonner des projets complexes et êtes capable de piloter simultanément plusieurs intervenants afin d'atteindre les objectifs de qualité, de délai et de rentabilité. Véritable homme ou femme de terrain, vous savez trouver des solutions, gérer les imprévus et maintenir une relation de confiance avec les clients comme avec les partenaires. Vous disposez de:Une expérience significative dans la conduite de travaux, la gestion de projets ou le suivi d'exécution dans le domaine de la rénovation ou de la construction Une bonne connaissance des différents corps de métier du bâtiment Une capacité à coordonner plusieurs intervenants et à gérer les priorités Une bonne maîtrise du suivi budgétaire et de la planification Un excellent sens de l'organisation De l'autonomie et un fort esprit d'initiative De bonnes capacités relationnelles et de communication Une bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques LanguesVous maîtrisez le français.La connaissance de l'allemand ou de l'anglais est un atout.Le luxembourgeois constitue un avantage supplémentaire. Pourquoi rejoindre cette entreprise ?Un CDI à temps plein, avec une entrée en fonction immédiate ou à convenir Un environnement de travail dynamique, stimulant et responsabilisant Des projets variés et techniquement enrichissants Une entreprise reconnue pour son savoir-faire et la qualité de ses prestations Des possibilités d'évolution professionnelle Une rémunération attractive, en adéquation avec votre expérience et vos compétences

jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.description:
At Serve Robotics, weâre reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. Itâs designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses.

The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. Weâre looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity.

Who We Are

We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully.

JOB OVERVIEW

The Accountant supports the company's accounting operations by maintaining accurate financial records, performing assigned close activities, and preparing financial reports. The role executes and monitors key accounting processes, partners with cross-functional stakeholders to resolve discrepancies, supports audits, and helps maintain compliance with GAAP, SOX requirements, internal controls, and company policies.

JOB DUTIES

  • Oversee the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and reports, ensuring completeness and accuracy.

  • Perform account reconciliations, including bank, accounts payable, and accounts receivable reconciliations, and resolve identified discrepancies.

  • Prepare and post journal entries and maintain an accurate and current general ledger.

  • Review, classify, and record expenses in accordance with company policies and applicable budget guidelines.

  • Oversee key accounting processes, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, inventory, accruals, and prepaid expenses.

  • Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation and providing timely, accurate responses to requests.

  • Monitor accounting activities for compliance with GAAP, SOX requirements, internal controls, and established company procedures.

  • Identify and recommend process improvements that strengthen controls and increase the efficiency and accuracy of accounting operations.

EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS, & SKILLS

Required Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

  • Bachelorâs degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical accounting experience.

  • 5+ years of full accounting experience

  • Proficiency with accounting software such as Xero or NetSuite and intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

  • Working knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, or GAAP, and a strong understanding of Sarbanes Oxley compliance processes, internal controls, and financial reporting requirements.

  • Strong organizational, time management, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to prioritize work, meet deadlines, and partner effectively across teams.

  • High degree of accuracy and analytical ability, including the ability to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve accounting discrepancies and process inefficiencies.

Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

  • Progress toward CPA certification.

  • Experience with a publicly traded company or public accounting firm.

  • Experience in a startup or other fast paced environment.

  • Experience with robotics, manufacturing, or technology companies, including exposure to inventory management or cost accounting processes.

  • Demonstrated ability to adapt and operate effectively in a dynamic, collaborative environment.

jobs.description: Permanent contract | BelvauxAre you passionate about research? So are we! Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ How will you contribute?This position is for a scientist to contribute to the core mission of the Catchment and Eco-hydrology group within the Environmental Modelling and Sensing unit. Research will investigate processes controlling behavior of Earth's Critical Zone, with an emphasis on understanding dependencies and feedbacks between the hydrologic cycle and ecosystems. We seek a scientist dedicated to integrating novel empirical observations and theory to answer questions motivated by pressing societal needs related to natural resources, and relevant to both the global scientific community and applied practitioners who manage those natural resources. The successful candidate will be a key member of an interdisciplinary and collaborative research group. The successful candidate is expected to develop an internationally recognized research program in ecohydrology, specifically in one of the following research areas:1. Tracers of eco-hydrologic processes. Research developing and applying innovative tracer approaches to understand water dynamics and associated biogeochemical processes across the soil–plant–atmosphere continuum. Building on existing strengths and infrastructure in the group, particular interest lies in stable isotope approaches that integrate environmental and eco-hydrological information using hydrological, plant physiological, or biogeochemical measurements.2. Small-catchment eco-hydrology. Research investigating interactions among vegetation, water dynamics, and biogeochemical processes, especially in forested headwater catchments. Particular interests include plant and ecosystem responses to hydrological extremes such as droughts and floods; thresholds and tipping points in vegetation and catchment functioning; and ecohydrological controls on the cycling and transport of carbon, plant nutrients, and pollutants.  Is Your profile described below? jobs.title: PRODAJNI/A SAVJETNIK/CA – PRODAJA SOLARNIH ELEKTRANA
jobs.description: TERENSKI/A PRODAJNI/A PREDSTAVNIK/CA ZA SOLARNE ELEKTRANE Green Bean traži prodajnu osobu za aktivno pronalaženje kupaca solarnih elektrana, prvenstveno vlasnika obiteljskih kuća. Kako izgleda posao? Glavninu rada čine terenski obilasci sela i manjih mjesta u okolici Zagreba. Obilazite dodijeljeno područje, neposredno pristupate vlasnicima kuća i započinjete razgovore o mogućnosti ugradnje solarne elektrane. Važan dio posla čine kontakti bez prethodno dogovorenog sastanka. Očekujemo da samostalno stvarate nove prodajne prilike te zainteresirane kupce pratite od prvog razgovora do ugovaranja. Glavni poslovi: • planiranje i obilazak dodijeljenog područja • osobno kontaktiranje vlasnika kuća i predstavljanje ponude • prepoznavanje interesa i prikupljanje podataka potrebnih za izradu ponude • dogovaranje daljnjih sastanaka i tehničkih obilazaka • prezentacija ponuda te redoviti telefonski, e-mail i osobni kontakt s kupcima do njihove odluke • vođenje evidencije kontakata i prodajnih aktivnosti • suradnja s tehničkim i operativnim timom Koga tražimo? Osobu kojoj odgovara svakodnevni teren, koja može samostalno započeti razgovor s nepoznatom osobom i ustrajno pratiti prodajne prilike. Važno nam je kako pristupate kupcu, slušate njegove potrebe i postupate nakon odbijanja. Prednost imaju kandidati s dokazivim iskustvom u samostalnom pronalaženju i pridobivanju novih kupaca, osobito kroz neposrednu terensku prodaju. jobs.title: Agile Program Manager
jobs.description:
We're looking for an experienced Agile Program Manager to lead delivery across multiple cross-functional teams working toward a shared set of business outcomes. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution: translating roadmap priorities into coordinated, predictable delivery, keeping dependencies visible, and making sure the right people are making the right decisions at the right time.

This is a hands-on program role, not a status-reporting one. You'll own the cadence, the plan, and the risks across several Agile teams, and you'll be the person stakeholders trust to tell them where things really stand.

What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of a multi-team program, coordinating three or more Agile teams (Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid) toward shared quarterly objectives.
  • Run program-level planning, including quarterly/PI planning, roadmap alignment, capacity planning, and release planning.
  • Identify, map, and actively manage cross-team dependencies, risks, and blockers, escalating early and with clear options.
  • Facilitate program ceremonies such as Scrum of Scrums, program syncs, system demos, and retrospectives, and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates.
  • Partner with Product Owners and Product Managers to keep backlogs prioritized, refined, and aligned to business value.
  • Build and maintain program-level reporting: delivery health, burn-up/velocity trends, OKR or objective progress, and RAID logs, tailored for both team-level and executive audiences.
  • Drive continuous improvement in delivery practices, tooling, and team workflows, coaching teams and leaders on Agile principles where needed.
  • Manage stakeholder communication across engineering, product, design, business, and leadership, keeping expectations aligned as scope and priorities shift.
  • Track program budget, resourcing, and vendor or third-party deliverables where applicable.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of experience in program or project management, with at least 5 years leading delivery in Agile environments.
  • Proven track record managing multi-team programs (not just single-team Scrum) from planning through release.
  • Deep, practical knowledge of Scrum and Kanban, plus experience with at least one scaling framework (SAFe, LeSS, Scrum@Scale, or similar).
  • Strong command of Agile tooling such as Jira, Jira Align, Azure DevOps, Rally, or equivalent, including building dashboards and program-level reporting.
  • Excellent facilitation skills: you can run a 50-person planning event as comfortably as a tense 1:1 escalation.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to tailor the message for engineers and executives alike.
  • Experience working with distributed or remote teams across time zones.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity: you can stand up structure where there is none and adapt it as the program evolves.

Nice to Have

  • Agile or program management certifications such as SAFe RTE, SAFe SPC, PMI-ACP, PgMP, PMP, CSM/CSP, or ICAgile.
  • Experience with Agile transformations or introducing scaled frameworks into an organization.
  • Background in software, SaaS, data, or digital product delivery.
  • Familiarity with OKRs and value-stream or portfolio management.
  • Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, insurance, public sector) where Agile delivery coexists with compliance requirements.
  • Budget and vendor management experience on programs with multiple delivery partners.

jobs.title: Administrationskoordinator med ansvar for miljøledelse søges til BOFA
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at skabe struktur, overblik og fremdrift i en travl hverdag?

BOFA søger en selvstændig og initiativrig medarbejder til BOFAs administration. Den primære opgave vil være at understøtte BOFAs driftschef og miljøchef i den daglige koordinering af opgaver, projekter, skabe overblik, sikre opfølgning, samt understøtte at aftaler og opgaver bliver ført frem til afslutning.

Stillingen omfatter desuden ansvaret for BOFAs miljøledelsessystem efter ISO 14001, herunder koordinering og udvikling af miljøledelsesarbejdet, samt opfølgning på systemets krav og aktiviteter.

Bornholm har en vision om at blive verdens første affaldsfrie samfund, hvor alt affald skal bruges igen.  BOFA søger en administrations koordinater der i ord og handling, vil være med på holdet og være en del af ”BORNHOLM VISER VEJ – uden affald 2032”.

 Stillingen er ny, og du får derfor mulighed for at præge både funktionens indhold og arbejdsgange i tæt samarbejde med de to chefer.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Koordinere deadlines, aftaler og opfølgning på igangværende opgaver.

  • Koordinere samarbejder med myndigheder og rådgivere.

  • Understøtte planlægning og prioritering af møder, aktiviteter og opgaver.

  • Følge op på entreprenørers leverancer og kontraktmæssige forpligtelser.

  • Deltage i udvalgte møder, udarbejde referater og sikre opfølgning på beslutninger.

  • Varetage mindre projekter og opgaver selvstændigt fra planlægning til afslutning.

  • Bidrage til at udvikle gode arbejdsgange, skabe struktur og sikre fremdrift på tværs af opgaver og samarbejdsflader.

Opgaverne vil udvikle sig i takt med, at rollen tager form, og du får mulighed for at bringe dine kompetencer og idéer i spil.

Du får dermed en alsidig funktion, hvor ledelsesunderstøttelse, koordinering og selvstændigt fagligt ansvar går hånd i hånd.

 Vi forestiller os, at du arbejder struktureret, har blik for detaljen og samtidig kan bevare overblikket over den samlede opgave. Du er god til at prioritere, følger op på aftaler og tager initiativ, når du ser behov for handling.

Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for at drive opgaver fremad.

  • Er god til koordinering, planlægning og opfølgning.

  • Kommunikerer klart og samarbejder konstruktivt med forskellige faggrupper.

  • Har en løsningsorienteret tilgang og ser muligheder for at forbedre arbejdsgange.

  • Trives i en hverdag med mange forskellige opgaver og skiftende prioriteringer.

  • Har mod på at bidrage med egne idéer og være med til at udvikle en ny funktion.

Erfaring med projektkoordinering, ledelsesunderstøttelse, kontraktopfølgning, miljøledelse eller lignende opgaver er en fordel. Det vigtigste er dog, at du har de rette kompetencer, tager ansvar og har lyst til at skabe værdi i hverdagen.

 BOFA kan tilbyde:

  • En arbejdsdag med mange forskellige og spændende opgaver

  • Et stærkt team af dygtige og hjælpsomme kollegaer

  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø – både fagligt og socialt med en aktiv personaleforening

Hos BOFA bliver du en del af en organisation, der arbejder med affald, ressourcer og udvikling af løsninger til gavn for Bornholm. Du får en varieret hverdag, tæt samarbejde med ledelsen og mulighed for at præge en ny funktion, hvor dine kompetencer og initiativer kan gøre en konkret forskel.

Ansættelse 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale

Arbejdstiden er gennemsnitlig 37 timer pr. uge.

 Hvad er BOFA?

BOFA er Bornholms affaldsselskab, ejet af Bornholms Regionskommune. Vi håndterer det bornholmske husholdningsaffald, samt en del erhvervsaffald. Derudover driver BOFA øens seks genbrugspladser, deponi og forbrændingsanlægget i Rønne, samt genbrugscentret i Vestermarie. BOFA beskæftiger omtrent 60 medarbejdere. Du kan læse mere om BOFA og Vision 2032 på www.bofa.dk.

BOFA ønsker at medarbejdersammensætningen afspejler samfundets, og vi ser frem til din ansøgning uanset personlig baggrund – vi ser kun på kvalifikationer og kompetencer.

Det praktiske

Du søger stillingen ved at sende din ansøgning og CV samt dokumentation for uddannelse, via "Søg Jobbet" knappen. Ansøgningsfristen er 17. november 2026.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Chefkonsulent Pieter Jacobus Theron på 2122 7445e eller mail pjt@0000@bofa.dk.

Samtaler vil foregå løbende i uge 47 & 48.

En arbejdsplads, der binder øen sammen

BRK er en unik kommunal arbejdsplads, fordi øen er en selvstændig region. Vi arbejder derfor med strategier og opgaver inden for erhverv, turisme og trafik, som er ansvarsområder danske kommuner normalt ikke varetager. På brk.dk kan du læse mere om kommunen, der med 3.600 ansatte er øens suverænt største arbejdsplads.

BRK er en røgfri arbejdsplads.

Det er en stor beslutning at flytte til ’solskinsøen’ – derfor står du heller ikke alene med den. Vi har nemlig en tilflytterkonsulent, der hjælper med bolig, job til din ægtefælle og skole- eller fritidstilbud til familiens mindste. Læs mere her.

jobs.title: Social og sundhedsassistent søges til plejecenter Snorrebakken, afd. EF
jobs.description:
Social- og Sundhedsassistent til Plejecenter Snorrebakken EF, det røde hus

Er du social- og sundhedsassistent og brænder du for at arbejde i et team, hvor faglighed, trivsel og beboernes livskvalitet er i fokus? Så er det måske dig, vi søger til vores afdeling EF på Plejecenter Snorrebakken – det røde hus.

Om plejecenter Snorrebakken EFPlejecenter Snorrebakken EF er en afdeling i konstant udvikling, hvor vi har fokus på at skabe et hjemligt, trygt og værdigt liv for vores beboere. Her understøtter vi beboernes ret til at leve det liv, de ønsker – "længst muligt i eget liv".Afdelingen består af 20 boliger i afdeling E/F, som er indrettet som leve-bo-miljøer, hvor maden laves i huset, og pleje og omsorg tilpasses den enkelte beboers behov. Vi arbejder rehabiliterende og tæt sammen med både beboere og deres pårørende for at sikre en meningsfuld hverdag.

Beboerne i afdeling EFVores beboere har vidt forskellige behov, og du vil arbejde med både demente og psykiatriske beboere. Vi tilpasser plejen til den enkeltes livssituation og sørger for, at alle beboere får mulighed for at leve et liv med højeste mulige livskvalitet, selv i mødet med sygdom og udfordringer. Det er derfor afgørende, at du er indstillet på at arbejde med forskellige diagnoser og er klar til at give den rette støtte og pleje.

StillingenVi søger en social- og sundhedsassistent til en stilling i skiftendevagter, fortrinsvis i dagvagter i afdeling EF. Stillingen er på 37 timer pr. uge med arbejde hver anden weekend. 

Du bliver en del af et engageret team med fokus på samarbejde, høj faglighed og en positiv arbejdskultur. Vi tilbyder en grundig og individuel oplæring, hvor erfarne kollegaer støtter dig godt ind i arbejdet – uanset om du er nyuddannet eller erfaren inden for faget.

Dine opgaverSom social- og sundhedsassistent vil du arbejde tæt sammen med beboerne, deres pårørende og et tværfagligt team for at sikre høj faglighed, værdighed og livskvalitet i beboernes hverdag. Du vil blandt andet:

  • Arbejde rehabiliterende med fokus på beboernes fysiske og psykiske trivsel

  • Støtte både demente og psykiatriske beboere i at skabe en meningsfuld og aktiv hverdag

  • Varetage pleje- og omsorgsopgaver, der er tilpasset den enkeltes behov

  • Indgå i et tæt samarbejde med både kollegaer og pårørende

  • Arbejde i et hus med et stærkt fællesskab og en positiv arbejdskultur

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent

  • Er fagligt engageret og har lyst til at arbejde rehabiliterende

  • Er åben for at arbejde med både demente og psykiatriske beboere

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og respektfuldt, med empati for både beboere og pårørende

  • Har en positiv og fleksibel tilgang til arbejdet

  • Er stabil og engageret i dit arbejde

  • Er vant til at arbejde med IT på brugerniveau, gerne kendskab til Cura

  • Er en teamplayer og trives i et tværfagligt miljø

Vi tilbyder dig:

  • En spændende arbejdsplads med mange varierede opgaver

  • Et team af dygtige og engagerede kollegaer med høj faglighed og et godt arbejdsmiljø

  • En afvekslende arbejdsdag med mulighed for at bidrage til udviklingen af vores plejecenter

  • En grundig og individuel introduktion til dine opgaver

  • Mulighed for kompetenceudvikling og sparring med erfarne kollegaer

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på trivsel og arbejdsglæde

Er du klar til at være en del af et team, der arbejder for beboernes trivsel og livskvalitet? Så send os din ansøgning allerede i dag!

 Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst og efter principperne i lokal løndannelse.

Der vil blive indhentet straffeattest ved ansættelse.

Stillingen er på 37 timer pr. uge. 

 Praktisk information

Send din ansøgning og CV samt dokumentation for uddannelse, via "Søg Jobbet" knappen. 

Ansøgningsfrist

19-11-2026

Samtaletidspunkt

23 og 24 november

Ansættelsesdato

01-01-2027

Kontaktperson

leder af Plejecenter Snorrebakken EFZandra Mikkonen Brinkmann56922707 / 24270112

Arbejdssted

Plejecenter Snorrebakken EFSnorrebakke Allé 1, 3700 Rønne

En arbejdsplads, der binder øen sammen

BRK er en unik kommunal arbejdsplads, fordi øen er en selvstændig region. Vi arbejder derfor med strategier og opgaver inden for erhverv, turisme og trafik, som er ansvarsområder danske kommuner normalt ikke varetager. På brk.dk kan du læse mere om kommunen, der med 3.600 ansatte er øens suverænt største arbejdsplads.

BRK er en røgfri arbejdsplads. 

Vi hjælper dig på plads

Det er en stor beslutning at flytte til ’solskinsøen’ – derfor står du heller ikke alene med den. Vi har nemlig en tilflytterkonsulent, der hjælper med bolig, job til din ægtefælle og skole- eller fritidstilbud til familiens mindste. Læs mere her.

jobs.title: Architecte cloud Kubernetes F/H h/f
jobs.description: Si pour vous avoir la tête dans les nuages c'est travailler dans le cloud, on est fait pour être ensemble.Vous aimez concevoir des architectures robustes et sécurisées qui font avancer toute une organisation ? Ce qui vous anime, c'est transformer des sujets complexes - multi-cloud, sécurité, industrialisation - en solutions concrètes au service des équipes et des clients ? Alors rejoignez notre équipe cloud pour faire grandir ensemble notre offre de service Kubernetes.Ce que l'on vous propose :Au sein de notre équipe cloud, composée de DevOps, SRE, architectes cloud et experts cybersécurité, vous contribuerez à concevoir et faire évoluer une offre de service Kubernetes multiplateforme, industrialisée, sécurisée et self-service, destinée à nos équipes internes comme à nos clients.Ensemble, nous opérons des solutions multi-provider sur AWS, Azure et GCP, avec l'ambition de construire un socle technique fiable, performant et évolutif. Ce poste vous offre une vision à 360° : architecture, réseau, sécurité, FinOps et run, avec une véritable liberté de conception et de choix d'architecture.Ce que vous ferez au quotidien :Au cœur de l'équipe, vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie de notre plateforme Kubernetes :- Concevoir l'architecture de clusters EKS/GKE, en couvrant la multi-tenancy, le réseau, le stockage et l'observabilité.- Intégrer la sécurité dès la conception : réseau (Network Policies, service mesh, mTLS), applicatif et cluster (RBAC, Pod Security, OPA/Kyverno), supply chain et IAM.- Industrialiser les déploiements à grande échelle grâce à Terraform, Ansible et des pipelines CI/CD en approche GitOps.- Garantir la résilience et la performance des plateformes : haute disponibilité, scalabilité, plan de reprise d'activité et observabilité via des SLO.- Piloter la démarche FinOps et définir la vision technique à moyen et long terme (serverless, event-driven, Kubernetes avancé).- Accompagner les clients et les équipes dans leur onboarding, et contribuer au mentoring et à la montée en compétences collective.À propos de vous :- Vous justifiez d'une expérience de 5 à 8 ans et plus en ingénierie cloud, avec une expertise reconnue sur Kubernetes (EKS et/ou GKE) et au moins un provider majeur (AWS, GCP).- Vous disposez d'une solide culture sécurité couvrant les dimensions réseau, applicatif, IAM, supply chain et conformité.- Vous maîtrisez Terraform et les approches d'infrastructure as code, ainsi que les pipelines CI/CD en GitOps.- Vous portez une sensibilité FinOps qui vous permet d'allier performance technique et maîtrise des coûts.- Vous êtes reconnu pour votre leadership technique et votre capacité à embarquer les équipes autour d'une vision commune.- Vous appréciez transmettre votre expertise et accompagner la montée en compétences de vos collègues comme de vos clients.Les prochaines étapes pour nous rejoindre :- Sélection de votre candidature par notre équipe de recrutement.- Deux à trois entretiens maximum avec nos équipes pour mieux vous connaître et vous présenter l'entreprise.- Prise de contact par Chloé, votre interlocutrice dédiée.Pour faire équipe avec nous, postulez dès maintenant ! #OnEstFaitPourEtreEnsemble

jobs.title: Feltsense AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About the company

We raised $5.1M to build agents that operate as fully autonomous founders. Our backers include Matt Schlicht (founder of Moltbook), the founders of Crunchbase and Republic, and VCs including Draper, Precursor, and Liquid2.

We're working at the frontier of autonomous systems, building agents that don't just chat, but run entire businesses.

Our system identifies business opportunities through market signals, validates ideas with live ad tests, builds and launches software products, and brings in human experts wherever agents fall short. That loop already runs end to end: from idea to launched product to first revenue.

Over the next 12 months, our focus is on reliability, throughput, and self-improvement, making every launch better than the last.

About the role

We're looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to take ownership of the architecture and development of our autonomous agent system.

You'll lead the technical direction of the platform, building multi-agent orchestration systems, self-improving agent harnesses, and AI-powered backend services. This is a highly technical leadership role that combines architectural decision-making with hands-on engineering.

You'll be expected to ship production code, make key technical decisions, improve agent behavior in production, and help establish the engineering standards as the company scales.

Responsibilities

  • Own the system architecture and make key technical decisions across the platform.

  • Design and build multi-agent systems and orchestration infrastructure that take products from idea to launch.

  • Develop self-improving agent harnesses, including feedback loops, evaluation systems, and memory.

  • Build and maintain AI-powered backend services on top of LLM APIs such as Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini.

  • Write production code, particularly around agent runtime and orchestration.

  • Debug and improve AI behavior in production through prompt engineering, structured outputs, retries, and fallbacks.

  • Break down complex technical challenges into actionable milestones and prioritize the engineering roadmap.

  • Establish engineering standards around code reviews, testing, observability, and release processes.

  • Lead and support the engineering team while remaining deeply involved in implementation.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience.

  • Previous technical leadership experience at an early-stage company (Founding Engineer, Tech Lead, Head of Engineering, or similar).

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping multi-agent systems and orchestration frameworks to production.

  • Experience developing self-improving or self-evolving agent harnesses.

  • Strong backend engineering skills, including designing and maintaining APIs, services, and data flows.

  • Experience working with LLM-based systems, including prompt engineering, model configuration, structured outputs, embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation.

  • Daily hands-on experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, or similar tools. You should know how to delegate work to agents, review their output, and verify what they build.

Nice to have

  • Strong TypeScript and Node.js experience.

  • Experience with Vercel AI SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or building custom agent runtimes.

  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Supabase, and pgvector.

  • Familiarity with background job systems such as Inngest or Pub/Sub.

  • Experience with Zod, Vitest, and GCP Cloud Run.

  • Experience growing or restructuring distributed engineering teams.

  • Interest in AI evaluation, safety, and observability.

jobs.title: Operations Expert with Python for AI Supply Chain Task Design
jobs.description:
Overview

A fast-growing AI data company is hiring supply chain practitioners to design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks for evaluating AI agents. You will turn real planning work into end-to-end challenges, each with files, a working solution and an automated correctness check. The goal is to build a benchmark grounded in real operations work.

***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***

Responsibilities

â¢ Design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks by turning a real supply chain task from your work into a challenge an AI agent solves end to end.

â¢ Define the files, data exports and systems each task runs on, such as ERP, MES and WMS extracts, so the scenario reflects realistic planning conditions.

â¢ Write a working solution for each task, for example a 5-day production plan, and confirm it can be solved in 60 to 75 minutes.

â¢ Build the automated check that proves the result is correct, using tests or scripts that accept valid answers and catch planning errors objectively.

â¢ Document the written rules, constraints and SOPs that decide each case, along with realistic edge cases, data inconsistencies and common planner errors from your process.

â¢ Iterate on tasks based on reviewer feedback, keeping instructions unambiguous, data consistent and the solution and verification reproducible in a command-line environment.

Skills/Experience

â¢ 3+ years of hands-on supply chain or production planning work (not only studying, selling or managing it), or a PhD with active research in the subfield

â¢ Did the work within the last 3 years and can name the systems, tools, data and rules used

â¢ Personally executed a process where each case is decided by written rules such as SOPs, planning rules or constraints

â¢ Worked inside systems of record (ERP, WMS) and with their exports or reports

â¢ Can describe edge cases, data inconsistencies and common planner errors, and how a mistake would be caught

â¢ Technical fluency in Python or another language and the command line, plus files, CSV/JSON, APIs or databases

â¢ Available to start around November 4, 2026

Nice-to-have

â¢ Automated or audited the process with scripts, SQL, RPA or rules engines

â¢ 5+ years in the same process family

â¢ Docker, Git and experience writing tests

â¢ Hands-on experience with SAP or other ERPs and TMS/WMS platforms

â¢ Advanced Excel skills

Process

â¢ Task-based engagement paid per task, with each task taking about 60 to 75 minutes

â¢ Vetting task instead of a live interview

â¢ Tasks are reviewed by the client before approval

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant, Mid-Market, DACH
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:



Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.

 - Fluency in German.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €174,000 - €186,000 per year.

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant, Commercial, CEE
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.

 - Fluency in Polish or Czech.

jobs.title: Etsimme vahvistusta Factoryn HR-tiimiin!
jobs.description: Etsimme vahvistusta Factoryn HR-tiimiin!Oletko ihmisläheinen tekijä, joka viihtyy ravintoloiden arjessa, innostuu asioiden järjestämisestä ja uskaltaa tarttua haastaviinkin tilanteisiin? Meillä voisi olla sinulle paikka!Factorylla on 28 ravintolaa Helsingissä, Espoossa, Vantaalla, Salossa, Hämeenlinnassa ja Lahdessaja kasvumme jatkuu!Meillä työskentelee paljon pitkäaikaisia työntekijöitä, joiden osaaminen ja kokemus ovat tärkeä osa Factorya.Nyt etsimme HR-tiimiimme uutta työkaveria tukemaan henkilöstömme ja ravintoloidemme arkea.Meillä henkilöstötyötä tehdään lähellä ihmisiä: ravintoloissa, esihenkilöiden rinnalla ja yhdessä monikulttuurisen työyhteisömme kanssa.Päiviin mahtuu kohtaamisia, käytännön järjestelyjä, uuden ideointia ja yhdessä onnistumisen iloa.Millaista arkea sinulle olisi luvassa?Olet tärkeä tuki ravintoloidemme esihenkilöille niin päivittäisissä kysymyksissä kuin haastavammissakin henkilöstötilanteissa.Työhösi kuuluu:- Esihenkilöiden ja henkilöstön tukemista arjessa: kuuntelemista, neuvomista ja käytännön ravintolatilanteiden ratkomista yhdessä.- Innostavaa rekrytointia, jossa Factoryn työkulttuuri pääsee näkyviin, sekä perehdyttämistä ja uusien työntekijöiden tukemista, jotta he tuntevat itsensä tervetulleiksi ja pääsevät sujuvasti osaksi työyhteisöä.- Toimipistekierroksia ja henkilöstön kohtaamista ravintoloiden arjessa. Hahmotat toiminnan kokonaisuuden, ymmärrät työhön kohdistuvat odotukset ja asiakkaan polun sekä tartut reippaasti havaittuihin kehityskohteisiin yhdessä henkilöstön ja esihenkilöiden kanssa.- Uusien ravintoloiden avausten valmistelua ja avauksissa mukana olemista, henkilöstön perehdyttämistä sekä päivittäisen työohjelman ja arjen toimintatapojen rakentamista. Luoden hyvää työilmapiiriä ja yhteistä Factoryn toimintakulttuuria.- Esihenkilöiden tukemista henkilöstötarpeiden ennakoinnissa, työntekijöiden koordinoinnissa toimipisteiden välillä sekä lomien ja sijaistusten järjestelyissä.- Työsuhteen eri vaiheisiin liittyvien asioiden hoitamista, työsopimusten huolellista valmistelua sekä henkilöstötietojen tarkkaa ja ajantasaista ylläpitoa eri järjestelmissä.Lisäksi tehtäviin kuuluu työnteko-oikeuden ja oleskelulupien tarkistamista.- Henkilöstöviestintää, aktiivista kommunikointia ja ohjeistusten päivittämistä. Varmistat, että tieto kulkee ja ohjeet ymmärretään huomioimalla ihmisten erilaiset oppimistavat ja tuen tarpeet.- Tiivistä yhteistyötä palkanlaskennan kanssa, palkkoihin liittyvien kysymysten selvittämistä sekä molemminpuolista tukea ja apua arjen työtehtävissä.- Työkyvyn ja työhyvinvoinnin tukemista sekä esihenkilöiden tukemista varhaisen tuen keskusteluissa. Meille välitön välittäminen tarkoittaa huolten huomaamista, kuuntelemista ja tuen tarjoamista ajoissa.- Esihenkilöiden tukemista henkilöstön johtamisessa, nopeaa reagointia arjen tilanteisiin sekä vaikeiden asioiden puheeksi ottamista. Tässä tarvitaan taitoa kuunnella, rohkeutta keskustella ja halua löytää ratkaisuja.- Koulutusten ja harjoittelujen koordinointia sekä henkilöstön osaamisen kehittämistä. Meille on tärkeää, että työntekijämme saavat mahdollisuuksia oppia uutta, kehittyä ja edetä urallaan.- Yhteistyötä kumppaneidemme, kuten oppilaitosten ja työterveyshuollon, kanssa. Huolehdit avoimesta yhteydenpidosta ja sujuvasta yhteistyöstä, jotta asiat etenevät ja tuki tavoittaa oikeat ihmiset.- HR-käytäntöjen ideointia ja kehittämistä, jotta arki pysyy sujuvana ja toimintatapamme kehittyvät yrityksen kasvun mukana.Kaiken keskiössä ovat ihmiset ja arjen sujuminen. Tehtävässä pääset sekä suunnittelemaan että tarttumaan käytännön tekemiseen, oman tiimin tuella.Millainen työkaveri sopisi meidän HR-tiimiin?Toivomme, että olet helposti lähestyttävä, oma-aloitteinen ja luotettava.Pidät monta lankaa käsissäsi ja kohtaat ihmiset lämpimästi myös kiireen keskellä. Innostut uusista asioista ja tuot rohkeasti omia ideoitasi esiin.Teet töitä pilke silmäkulmassa ja tuot huumorillasi hyvää fiilistä arkeen!Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi, sillä saat tiimiltämme tukea työtehtäviisi.Tehtävässä tarvitset:- Hyviä tietoteknisiä taitoja ja valmiutta oppia käyttämään erilaisia HR- ja rekrytointijärjestelmiä.- Erinomaista suomen ja hyvää englannin kielen taitoa, ilmaiset itseäsi sujuvasti sekä kirjallisesti että suullisesti molemmilla kielillä.- Oman auton ja ajokortin, sillä työ sisältää liikkumista toimipisteidemme välillä.- Valmiutta ja joustavuutta työskennellä pääsääntöisesti pääkaupunkiseudulla sekä tehdä käyntejä ja yrityksen laajentuessa työskennellä myös sen ulkopuolella.- Ravintolan toimintatapojen tuntemusta ja valmiutta perehdyttää työntekijöitä. Ravintola-alan työkokemus on meille ehdoton plussa!- Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja organisointitaitoja sekä hienotunteisuutta henkilöstöasioiden käsittelyssä.- Aikaisempi kokemus tiimin johtamisesta ja kokonaisuuden hallinnasta.Mitä saat meiltä?- Rempseän työtiimin, jossa saat kysyä, olla oma itsesi ja ratkoa asioita yhdessä.- Kokeneita, pitkään talossa olleita työkavereita sekä perehdytystä ja tukea työtehtäviisi.- Joustavan työajan ja pääsääntöisesti arkiaamuihin painottuvan työn. Mahdollisuuden tehdä satunnaisesti etätöitä.- Monipuolisen tehtävän jatkuvasti kasvavassa ravintolayrityksessä.- Mahdollisuuden kehittää ja ideoida toimintatapojamme sekä edetä urallasi.- Työn, jossa oman tekemisesi vaikutus näkyy ihmisten ja ravintoloiden arjessa.- Toimistomme sijaitsee Helsingin Pitäjänmäellä. Työskentelet sekä toimistolla että ravintoloissamme.Etsimme pitkäaikaista työkaveria ja toivomme, että viihdyt meillä pitkään. Olisitko sinä sopiva meidän HR-tiimiimme?Haluaisimme kuulla sinusta!Lähetä persoonallinen hakemuksesi ja CV palkkatoiveineen.Kerro meille, kuka olet, osaamisesi ja mikä sinua innostaa työssä Factoryn HR-tiimissä.Haku on avoinna toistaiseksi.Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten lähetäthän hakemuksesi pian!

jobs.title: VVS-installatør søges til Hafnia Bad ApS
jobs.description:
VVS-montør / VVS-installatør til komplette badeværelsesprojekter - med mulighed for projektledelse

Virksomhed: Hafnia Bad

Stillingstype: Fuldtid

Tiltrædelse: Hurtigst muligt / efter aftale

Brænder du for høj håndværksmæssig kvalitet, gennemtænkte VVS-løsninger og flotte badeværelser? Hos Hafnia Bad har vi rygende travlt med at skabe kompromisløse badeværelsesdrømme for vores kunder. Derfor søger vi en dygtig og engageret VVS-profil, der vil have en central rolle på vores projekter.

Om jobbet

Som vores nye kollega får du ansvaret for at drive og udføre VVS-entreprisen på vores badeværelsesprojekter fra start til slut.

Dine primære opgaver bliver:

  • Udførelse af alt traditionelt VVS-arbejde i forbindelse med etablering og renovering af badeværelser (faldstammer, vand- og afløbsinstallationer, gulvvarme, montering af sanitet og armaturer).

  • Kvalitetssikring af det udførte VVS-arbejde.

  • Dialog med bygherre/kunder ude på pladsen for at sikre den bedste løsning.

Ekstra mulighed: Projektledelse og fagentreprise (ikke et krav)

Har du lyst til mere end bare at skrue rør, og trives du med overblik og koordinering? Hvis interessen og modet er der, giver vi dig gerne muligheden for at påtage dig rollen som projektleder. Det vil indebære koordinering og drift af de andre faggrupper på pladsen (f.eks. murere, tømrere, elektrikere og malere).

Er projektledelse ikke dig? Så er det intet problem – det vigtigste for os er dit stærke VVS-håndværk og din faglige stolthed.

Hvem er du?

  • Du er uddannet VVS-montør, VVS-energispecialist eller VVS-installatør.

  • Du har erfaring med renovering og etablering af badeværelser.

  • Du arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og sætter en ære i at aflevere et fejlfrit resultat.

  • Du er serviceminded, har gode samarbejdsevner og taler/forstår dansk.

  • Du har gyldigt kørekort (B).

Hvad tilbyder Hafnia Bad?

  • En spændende og afvekslende hverdag i en virksomhed i vækst med fokus på kvalitet.

  • Egen veludstyret servicevogn med professionelt værktøj.

  • Stor frihed under ansvar og indflydelse på din egen arbejdsdag.

  • Attraktive og konkurrencedygtige lønvilkår efter kvalifikationer samt pensionsordning.

  • Gode, hjælpsomme kolleger og en uformel omgangstone, hvor vi hjælper hinanden i mål.

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til kontakt@hafniabad.dk

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Signe Jensen på tlf. 22887725.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og lukker stillingen, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

jobs.title: Technical Sales Manager, Finland / Nordic region
jobs.description:
Are you ready to grow a business and make a difference in plant health?

Lallemand Plant Care is looking for a commercially driven and technically skilled Technical Sales Manager to lead business development across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.

This is an exciting opportunity for a professional who combines a passion for agriculture and plant health with strong sales capabilities and a strategic business mindset. You will play a key role in expanding Lallemands market presence and bringing innovative microorganism-based plant protection and biofertilizer products to distributors, growers and industry partners.

Your role and key responsibilities

 * Principle contact to sales for Lallemand Plant Care customers in assigned territory.
 * Take ownership of the annual sales budget and maximize sales growth.
 * Build and strengthen long-term relationships with existing and new customers.
 * Lead commercial negotiations with distributors, strategic partners and key accounts.
 * Identify new business opportunities, monitor market trends and translate customer needs into growth opportunities.
 * Collaborate with sales, marketing, regulatory and field solutions teams to ensure consistent market offering and high customer satisfaction.
 * Report on business development and sales performance regularly to the Commercial Director.

Be a trusted technical partner

 * Manage and provide technical support to customers, including support for product demonstrations and field trials.
 * Deliver customer training and technical presentations, helping customers understand product performance and best practices.
 * Represent Lallemand Plant Care at industry events, trade shows and professional forums.

What will help you succeed?

We are looking for an experienced professional who understands the micro-organism-based solutions market and knows how to turn technical expertise into commercial success.

You will ideally bring:

 * A bachelors or masters degree in agricultural sciences or a related field. Additional qualifications in business, management or plant protection are an advantage.
 * At least 10 years of relevant professional experience, including proven success in technical sales and business development within the agricultural input sector.
 * A strong understanding of agricultural markets, distribution channels and commercial business practices.
 * Excellent sales, negotiation and business development skills.
 * An established network within the agricultural input industry is an advantage.
 * Fluency in English and Swedish – Finnish and other Scandinavian language skills are a bonus.
 * Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools.

In addition

You are likely to thrive in this role if you are:

 * Entrepreneurial and self-motivated, with a strong drive to achieve results.
 * Adaptable and curious, willing to learn quickly and embrace new challenges.
 * Collaborative and communicative, able to build trust with customers and colleagues.
 * Reliable and honest, with a strong work ethic and a commitment to delivering on promises.

What to expect

 * A regional role with responsibility for business growth across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.
 * The opportunity to combine commercial leadership with technical expertise in plant care.
 * Close collaboration with customers, distributors and cross-functional teams.
 * A hybrid working arrangement.
 * Travel of up to approximately 50% of working time, mainly within Nordic territory, with occasional international travel for training and meetings.

A valid passport and driving license are required. The role also involves occasional visits to agricultural, field and factory environments.

How to get more information about the position 

For further information about the position, please email professional@visiohr.fi  or contact Visio Professionals Talent Managers Sanna Majava, tel. +358 45 860 7556 or Tarja Laakso, tel. +358 45 858 8441.

About Lallemand Plant Care

Lallemand is a privately held Canadian company founded in the late 19th century, which develops, produces, and markets microorganisms for various markets. Lallemand Plant Care brings value to growers through innovative microorganism-based solutions for agriculture, horticulture, forestry, and turf. From selecting the right strains to delivering high-quality products and application expertise, we focus on solutions growers can trust. Our broad portfolio is designed to integrate easily into existing practices and address specific challenges. Read more: Lallemand Plant Care  or Lallemand Finland Oy 

Visio Professional

Visio Professional is a recruitment company specialising in professional and white-collar recruitment. It is part of the Visio Group, established in 2020. We are constantly looking for talented professionals across a wide range of industries and experience levels, from entry-level positions to senior roles. We take a personal approach to recruitment and strive to find solutions that benefit both candidates and employers. Whether you are at the beginning of your career or an experienced professional, we are here to help you find a role that matches your skills and expertise.

jobs.title: PA for direktøren på Voksenområdet i Ikast-Brande Kommune
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde helt tæt på topledelsen af de store velfærdsområder i en udviklingsorienteret kommune? Er du god til at skabe overblik og holde styr på detaljerne – også i en travl hverdag? Er du imødekommende og god til at skabe relationer? Så er du måske vores nye medarbejder i Ikast-Brande Kommune.

Direktørområdet består af de tre afdelinger Socialafdelingen, Arbejdsmarked- og Borgerserviceafdelingen samt Sundheds- og Ældreafdelingen. I det daglige vil du skulle arbejde tæt sammen med kolleger i direktørområdets øvrige stabe og områder. Du refererer direkte til direktøren.

Om stillingen

Du får en bred berøringsflade i kommunen og et indgående kendskab til strategisk ledelse og styring på kommunalt toplederniveau. Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet, at:

  • primært understøtte direktørens daglige arbejde med kalenderstyring, mødekoordinering, prioritering af henvendelser og praktisk opfølgning
  • planlægge og koordinere møder, seminarer og andre ledelsesaktiviteter, herunder udarbejdelse af dagsordner, referater og opfølgning på aftaler 
  • betjene chefgruppen med dagsorden og referat til chefmøderne 
  • udarbejde beslutningsgrundlag, notater, præsentationer og kommunikation
  • udarbejde sagsfremstillinger til politiske udvalg samt kommunens direktion
  • koordinere beredskabsplanlægningen på Voksenområdet samt andre koordineringsopgaver

Din profil

Vi søger en kollega, der er nysgerrig, serviceminded og har blik for både detaljer og helheder. Du trives med at arbejde i et krydsfelt mellem administrative- og ledelsesunderstøttende opgaver. Du er proaktiv, god til at følge op og kan håndtere fortrolige oplysninger.

Derudover forventes det, at du

  • kan prioritere og bevare overblikket, når flere opgaver kræver din opmærksomhed.
  • kan kommunikere klart og præcist – både skriftligt og mundtligt.
  • arbejder selvstændigt og tager initiativ til at følge op.
  • har forståelse for arbejdet i en politisk styret organisation.

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke afgørende. Det vigtigste for os er, at du har en relevant uddannelse eller praktisk erfaring, der gør dig i stand til at lykkes i og trives med stillingen. Vi kunne eksempelvis forestille os, at du er kontoruddannet eller har en relevant videregående uddannelse på bachelor- eller kandidatniveau. Men måske er det en helt tredje baggrund, der gør, at du er den helt rette til stillingen. 

Vi tilbyder

  • Varierede opgaver og mange berøringsflader, og dermed en alsidig hverdag.
  • En organisation som møder hinanden med dialog, tillid og ansvarlighed.
  • En arbejdsplads med gode kolleger.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold:

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst. Nuværende mødetid er som udgangspunkt kl. 07.30 alle ugens dage, og timetallet er 37 timer om ugen. Tiltrædelse snarest muligt eller forhåbentligt den. 1. januar 2027.

Ansættelsesprocessen:

Ansøgningsfristen er torsdag den 12. november.Første ansættelsessamtale afholdes mandag den 16. november 2026.Anden ansættelsessamtale afholdes onsdag den 18. november 2026.

Kandidater, der bliver indkaldt til anden samtale, vil blive bedt om at udfylde en personlighedsprofil.

På grund af høj mødeaktivitet i slutningen af november i direktørens kalender er ansættelsesprocessen kort. Vi håber ikke, at den korte frist vil afholde dig fra at søge stillingen. 

Der vil efter aftale blive indhentet referencer på den kandidat, vi ønsker at tilbyde jobbet. 

Spørgsmål vedrørende stillingen rettes til direktør for Voksenområdet Louise Berg på 21837636. Send gerne en SMS forud, så bliver du ringet op.

jobs.title: Permanent nursing positions in Jondal, Norway
jobs.description: On behalf of Ullensvang Municipality, we are recruiting nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Jondal, Western Norway.You will work across both nursing home and home care services, giving you the opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills. You will follow patients over time, make independent clinical assessments and work closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.Jondal is a small community in the Hardanger region on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. Here, you will live by the Hardangerfjord, surrounded by mountains, with Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, just 19 kilometres away.Moving to another country is a big step, and we will support you throughout the process. Dignus Medical provides free Norwegian language training, assistance with Norwegian authorisation and practical support with relocation and settling into your new community.About the positionAs a nurse in Jondal, you will work with patients with different healthcare and care needs, both in a nursing home and in their own homes.The role gives you a high degree of professional responsibility and the opportunity to follow patients over time, while working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.Your responsibilities will include:    Providing nursing care and following up patients    Clinical observation, assessment and documentation    Medication management and treatment    Providing care to patients in nursing homes and in their own homes    Making independent clinical assessments    Working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals    Communicating with relatives and other parts of the healthcare serviceWho are we looking for?We are looking for qualified nurses who are confident in their professional role, comfortable working independently and motivated to build a new life and career in Norway.You:    Hold a valid nursing licence from an EU/EEA country    Hold citizenship from an EU/EEA country    Speak English fluently and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian    Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language programme before starting work    Hold a valid driving licence    Work well both independently and as part of a team    Preferably have experience from community healthcare, nursing homes or home care servicesWe help you prepare for working in NorwayYou do not need to speak Norwegian when you apply. If you are selected for the position, Dignus Medical will guide you through the entire process of preparing for your move to Norway.We provide:    Free online Norwegian language training with a private teacher    Language training up to the required B2 level, including Norwegian for healthcare professionals    Assistance with your application for Norwegian nursing authorisation    Guidance with the documentation and administrative processes required before starting work    Help with finding accommodation and practical aspects of relocating to Norway    Personal follow-up before, during and after your moveThe language training and authorisation process take place before you start working, so you have time to prepare both professionally and practically for your new life in Norway.What you can expect in Jondal    A permanent position in the Norwegian municipal healthcare system    Varied work across nursing home and home care services    The opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills    Independent professional responsibility    Close cooperation with colleagues and other healthcare professionals    The opportunity to follow patients over time    Support with housing, relocation and practical arrangementsLife between the fjord, mountains and glacierJondal is located in Hardanger on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. It is a small community of around 400 people, situated directly by the Hardangerfjord and surrounded by mountains. Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, is only 19 kilometres away.Nature is part of everyday life here. After work, you can hike in the mountains, kayak or fish on the fjord, or simply enjoy the quiet surroundings. In winter, the area offers excellent opportunities for skiing and other outdoor activities.Despite its small size, Jondal has the essentials you need for everyday life, including a grocery store, places to eat and local cultural and leisure activities. If you are moving with your family, Jondal has both a kindergarten and a school for children from primary through lower secondary level, as well as a library, swimming pool and sports facilities. Odda is around 40 minutes away by car, while Bergen offers a larger city environment and an international airport.Interested in starting a new chapter in Norway?Feel free to get in touch for further information, or send us your application.
