jobs.title: Permanent nursing positions in Utne, Norway
jobs.description: On behalf of Ullensvang Municipality, we are recruiting nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Utne, Western Norway.As a nurse in Utne, you will work across both nursing home and home care services. You will meet patients with different healthcare needs, take independent professional responsibility and work closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.Utne is a small community in the Hardanger region on Norway’s west coast, around 2.5 hours from Bergen and Bergen International Airport. Located by the Sørfjord, a branch of the famous Hardangerfjord, Utne is surrounded by mountains, fruit orchards and some of Western Norway’s most characteristic scenery.Moving to another country is a big step, and we will support you throughout the process. Dignus Medical provides free Norwegian language training, assistance with Norwegian authorisation and practical support with relocation and settling into your new community.About the positionAs a nurse in Utne, you will have a varied working day and the opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills. Some patients will be cared for in a nursing home, while others receive care in their own homes.You will work independently and make professional assessments, while also being part of a team and working closely with other healthcare professionals.Your responsibilities will include:    Providing nursing care and following up patients    Clinical observation, assessment and documentation    Medication management and treatment    Providing care to patients in nursing homes and in their own homes    Making independent clinical assessments    Working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals    Communicating with relatives and other parts of the healthcare serviceWho are we looking for?We are looking for qualified nurses who are confident in their professional role, comfortable working independently and motivated to build a new life and career in Norway.You:    Hold a valid nursing licence from an EU/EEA country    Hold citizenship from an EU/EEA country    Speak English fluently and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian    Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language programme before starting work    Hold a valid driving licence    Work well both independently and as part of a team    Preferably have experience from community healthcare, nursing homes or home care servicesWe help you prepare for working in NorwayYou do not need to speak Norwegian when you apply. If you are selected for the position, Dignus Medical will guide you through the entire process of preparing for your move to Norway.We provide:    Free online Norwegian language training with a private teacher    Language training up to the required B2 level, including Norwegian for healthcare professionals    Assistance with your application for Norwegian nursing authorisation    Guidance with the documentation and administrative processes required before starting work    Help with finding accommodation and practical aspects of relocating to Norway    Personal follow-up before, during and after your moveThe language training and authorisation process take place before you start working, so you have time to prepare both professionally and practically for your new life in Norway.What you can expect in Utne    A permanent position in the Norwegian municipal healthcare system    Varied work across nursing home and home care services    The opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills    Independent professional responsibility    Close cooperation with colleagues and other healthcare professionals    The opportunity to follow patients over time    Support with housing, relocation and practical arrangementsLife in the heart of HardangerUtne is located by the Sørfjord in Hardanger on Norway’s west coast, surrounded by mountains and fruit orchards. Fruit growing has been part of life here for generations, and the landscape changes with the seasons, from orchards in full bloom in spring to apples, plums, pears and cherries later in the year.Life here is quieter than in a large city, with the fjord and mountains right outside your door. You can spend your free time hiking, exploring the fjord or discovering local farms and producers. Utne also has a strong cultural heritage, including the Hardanger Folk Museum and the historic Utne Hotel.If you are moving with your family, there is a kindergarten in Utne and a primary school with after-school care nearby. Odda, the main town and administrative centre of Ullensvang Municipality, is around 45 minutes away by car and offers a wider range of shops and services. Ferry connections link Utne to both sides of the fjord, making it easy to explore Hardanger and travel onwards towards Voss and Bergen. Bergen, the largest city in Western Norway, is around 2.5 hours away and has an international airport.Interested in starting a new chapter in Norway?Feel free to get in touch for further information, or send us your application.

jobs.title: Qualified Cosmetician
jobs.description:
Full-Time Position | Copenhagen, Denmark

Employer: BBA Copenhagen – The Beauty Atelier

Workplace: Store Kongensgade 96, Copenhagen, Denmark

Employment type: Full-time, permanent

Working hours: 37 hours per week

Gross monthly salary: DKK 37,200

Start date: By agreement

Application deadline: 1st of January

About Us

BBA Copenhagen – The Beauty Atelier is a professional beauty salon located in Copenhagen, Denmark. We offer a wide range of beauty, skincare and personal care treatments, focusing on quality, professionalism and excellent customer service.

We are seeking a qualified and experienced Cosmetician / Beauty Therapist to join our team on a full-time basis.

The ideal candidate is passionate about the beauty industry, has practical experience in professional beauty treatments and is committed to providing high-quality services in a welcoming salon environment.

Key Responsibilities

- Perform professional facial and skincare treatments, including skin analysis and consultations.

- Provide waxing, threading and eyebrow-shaping services.

- Perform eyelash lifting, eyebrow lamination, tinting and other brow and lash treatments.

- Carry out manicures and pedicures according to professional qualifications.

- Assess clients' skincare needs and recommend suitable treatments and products.

- Provide professional consultations and appropriate aftercare advice.

- Maintain high standards of hygiene, sanitation and client safety.

- Prepare and maintain treatment rooms, equipment and beauty products.

- Manage client appointments, bookings and treatment records.

- Assist with inventory management and daily salon operations.

- Deliver excellent customer service and maintain positive client relationships.

- Work independently and collaborate effectively with other team members.

Qualifications and Experience

We are looking for candidates who have:

- A relevant diploma, certificate or professional qualification in cosmetology, beauty therapy or a related field.

- Practical experience working as a cosmetician, beautician or beauty therapist in a professional salon environment.

- Knowledge and practical skills in facial treatments, waxing, threading, eyebrow and eyelash treatments.

- Understanding of skincare products, treatment procedures and professional hygiene standards.

- Good communication and customer service skills.

- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.

- A professional, reliable and client-focused approach.

What We Offer

- A permanent, full-time position of 37 hours per week.

- A gross monthly salary of DKK 37,200.

- A professional, friendly and supportive working environment.

- Opportunities for professional development and further training.

- A varied role involving skincare, beauty treatments and client consultations.

- Employment conditions in accordance with applicable Danish employment standards.

- Other bonuses.

Employment Conditions

The successful candidate will receive a written employment contract specifying salary, working hours, holiday entitlement, notice period and other applicable employment conditions.

The position is based at our salon in Copenhagen and requires physical attendance at the workplace.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are invited to submit:

- An updated CV.

- Copies of relevant professional qualifications or certificates.

- A short application describing their professional experience and suitability for the position.

Application email: info@bba-cph.com

Applications will be assessed based on relevant qualifications, professional experience and suitability for the position.

We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager – BMW og MINI reservedele og tilbehør
jobs.description:
Schmiedmann Odense A/S søger en resultatorienteret Key Account Manager

Om jobbet

Vil du være med til at udvikle og styrke samarbejdet med vores vigtigste kunder på det internationale marked for BMW- og MINI-reservedele og tilbehør?

Hos Schmiedmann Odense A/S søger vi en engageret Key Account Manager, der kan skabe langsigtede kunderelationer, identificere nye forretningsmuligheder og sikre fortsat vækst gennem professionel kunderådgivning og aktivt salgsarbejde.

Schmiedmann er en specialiseret virksomhed inden for BMW- og MINI-reservedele, tilbehør og relaterede produkter med kunder i Danmark og resten af verden.

Se en video om jobbet her: Work at Schmiedmann | We’re Hiring in Odense!

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Opbygge, udvikle og vedligeholde relationer til eksisterende nøglekunder og franchises.

  • Identificere og opsøge nye forretningsmuligheder.

  • Udarbejde tilbud og følge op på salgsaktiviteter, kundeforespørgsler og ordrer.

  • Forhandle priser, betingelser og samarbejdsaftaler.

  • Analysere kundernes købsmønstre og identificere potentiale for mersalg.

  • Sikre høj kundetilfredshed og en professionel kundeoplevelse.

  • Samarbejde med salg, produkt- og lagerafdeling om at finde de rette løsninger til kunderne.

  • Bidrage til udviklingen af vores internationale forretning og kundeportefølje.

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med B2B-salg, key account management eller anden relevant salgsfunktion.

  • Er kommercielt orienteret og motiveres af at skabe målbare resultater.

  • Er dygtig til at opbygge relationer og skabe tillid hos kunderne.

  • Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt og følger dine opgaver helt til dørs.

  • Har gode forhandlingsevner og kan identificere kundernes behov.

  • Har gode IT-kompetencer og erfaring med CRM- og ERP-systemer eller lignende.

  • Behersker dansk og engelsk på et professionelt niveau.

Kendskab til bilbranchen, BMW og MINI samt reservedele og tilbehør vil være en fordel, men er ikke et krav, hvis du har den rette kommercielle profil og lyst til at lære vores produkter at kende.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende stilling i en specialiseret virksomhed med internationale kunder.

  • Mulighed for at få indflydelse på udviklingen af vores kundeportefølje og salgsresultater.

  • En hverdag med stor kontaktflade på tværs af virksomhedens afdelinger.

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med engagerede kolleger.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer samt pension og øvrige vilkår efter aftale.

  • Sommerferie i uge 28-29-30, Juleferie, samt lukket 1. Maj, Kristi himmelfarts dag med fredag, grundlovsdag.

  • Fri frokost 2 gange ugentligt + frugtordning.

  • Virksomhedsbetalt arbejdstøj (dresscode).

Arbejdssted

Schmiedmann Odense A/SHerluf Trolles Vej 155220 Odense SØ

Ansøgning

Er du vores nye Key Account Manager?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job.odense@schmiedmann.com. og mærk den KAM

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Yötyöpainotteinen Lähihoitaja
jobs.description: **Oletko parhaimmillasi silloin, kun muu maailma nukkuu?**Me etsimme **lähihoitajaa yötyö painotteiseen työhön** Keisarinnaan Raadelmaan Piikkiöön.Yövuorossa työsi on paljon enemmän kuin valvomista. Olet turvallinen läsnäolija, ammattilainen, joka pitää huolen siitä, että asukkaamme voivat nukkua yönsä levollisin mielin. Sinulla on mahdollisuus tehdä työsi rauhassa, käyttää ammattitaitoasi monipuolisesti ja vaikuttaa aidosti ihmisten hyvinvointiin.**Sinä voit olla etsimämme, jos**- työskentelet luontevasti itsenäisesti ja osaat johtaa omaa työtäsi - tartut asioihin oma-aloitteisesti - olet luotettava, vastuullinen ja rauhallinen myös muuttuvissa tilanteissa - haluat kohdata ihmiset arvostavasti ja inhimillisesti - olet koulutukseltasi lähihoitaja - yöpainotteinen työ sopii sinulle **Meillä saat**Työn, jossa sinuun luotetaan ja osaamistasi arvostetaan. Mahdollisuuden tehdä itsenäistä työtä ilman, että jäät yksin. Mukavan, osaavan ja helposti lähestyttävän työyhteisön. Huolellisen perehdytyksen ja tuen onnistumiseesi. Merkityksellisen työn, jossa jokainen työvuoro on tärkeä.Meille tärkeintä ei ole vain se, mitä osaat tänään – vaan myös halusi kehittää osaamistasi ja tehdä työsi sydämellä.**Kuulostaako omalta?** Lähetä hakemuksesi meille. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Voit tehdä 100% työaikaa tai halutessasi myös 80% työaika on sovittavissa.**Yölläkin tehdään arvokasta työtä – tule tekemään sitä kanssamme.**

jobs.title: Liiketoiminnan vetäjä - Paikan pomo
jobs.description: Savo Outpost etsii päähenkilöä – ota kokonainen kohtaamispaikka haltuusi!**Paikka on valmis. Päähenkilö puuttuu.**Savo Outpost on ainutlaatuinen kokous-, tapahtuma- ja kohtaamispaikka Kantalassa, Mikkelin Haukivuorella. Meillä yritykset, työyhteisöt ja yksityiset ryhmät kokoontuvat laadukkaaseen ympäristöön, jossa yhdistyvät luonnon rauha, toimivat tilat ja ensiluokkainen palvelu.Nyt etsimme ihmistä, joka ottaa paikan omakseen.Emme etsi perinteistä toimitilavastaavaa tai tapahtumajärjestäjää. Etsimme oma-aloitteista, kaupallisesti ajattelevaa ja ihmisläheistä tekijää, joka saa asiat tapahtumaan. Ihmistä, joka osaa yhtä luontevasti keskustella yritysjohtajan kanssa, suunnitella asiakkaalle onnistuneen tapahtuman ja huolehtia siitä, että kaikki on kunnossa vieraiden saapuessa.**Tässä työssä et johda ihmisiä, vaan kokonaisuutta.** Saat paljon vastuuta, vapautta ja mahdollisuuden jättää oman kädenjälkesi kasvavaan liiketoimintaan.Mitä päähenkilömme tekee?Vastaat Savo Outpostin päivittäisestä toiminnasta, asiakaskokemuksesta, myynnistä ja kehittämisestä. Käytännössä työsi koostuu neljästä kokonaisuudesta:**1\. Asiakkaat ja tapahtumat**Olet asiakkaidemme ensisijainen yhteyshenkilö. Hoidat varaukset, suunnittelet vierailujen käytännön järjestelyt ja huolehdit, että kaikki toimii alusta loppuun. Varmistat, että tilat ovat kunnossa ja asiakkaamme voivat keskittyä olennaiseen. Tarvittaessa käärit itsekin hihat.**2\. Myynti ja liiketoiminnan kehittäminen**Etsit uusia asiakkaita, rakennat asiakassuhteita, laadit tarjouksia ja kehität palveluitamme. Sinulla on mahdollisuus vaikuttaa siihen, millaiseksi Savo Outpost kasvaa. Työhösi kuuluu myös toiminnan talouden seuraaminen ja käytännön arjen organisointi.**3\. Kumppanit ja paikalliset verkostot**Rakennat yhteistyötä alueen yritysten ja palveluntuottajien kanssa. Huolehdit, että esimerkiksi ruokailut, ohjelmapalvelut ja muut asiakkaiden tarvitsemat kokonaisuudet toimivat saumattomasti.**4\. Näkyvyys ja markkinointi**Olet Savo Outpostin kasvot ja ääni. Tuotat kiinnostavaa sisältöä sosiaaliseen mediaan, osallistut markkinointiin ja teet paikkaa tunnetuksi omalla persoonallasi. Sinun ei tarvitse olla markkinoinnin ammattilainen, mutta toivomme, että viihdyt myös kameran edessä ja osaat kertoa kiinnostavista asioista kiinnostavasti.Kenelle tämä työ sopii?Saatat olla kokenut palvelualan ammattilainen, myyjä, tapahtumien järjestäjä, matkailualan osaaja tai yrittäjähenkinen moniosaaja. Taustasi ei ole meille tärkein asia.Sen sijaan arvostamme, että:- Olet oma-aloitteinen ja kannat vastuuta ilman jatkuvaa ohjausta. - Tulet erinomaisesti toimeen erilaisten ihmisten kanssa ja nautit asiakaspalvelusta. - Sinulla on kaupallista ajattelua ja halua tehdä myyntiä. - Osaat organisoida, ratkaista ongelmia ja pitää monta lankaa käsissäsi. - Tartut käytännön töihin yhtä mielelläsi kuin suunnittelet uutta. - Osaat tai haluat oppia tuottamaan sisältöä sosiaaliseen mediaan. - Tunnet Etelä-Savoa tai haluat rakentaa alueelle vahvat verkostot. - Sinulla on ajokortti ja mahdollisuus käyttää omaa autoa. Aikaisempi kokemus palveluliiketoiminnasta, tapahtumista, matkailusta tai yrittäjyydestä on eduksi, mutta emme edellytä tiettyä tutkintoa tai täydellistä ansioluetteloa.**Etsimme ennen kaikkea ihmistä, jolla on oikea asenne ja kyky saada asioita aikaan.**Mitä tarjoamme?**Poikkeuksellisen työympäristön.** Savo Outpostin tilat ja ympäristö tarjoavat hienot puitteet rakentaa jotain omaleimaista Etelä-Savossa.**Vapautta ja vastuuta.** Saat suunnitella työtäsi itsenäisesti, kehittää toimintaa ja vaikuttaa suoraan sen onnistumiseen.**Yrittäjämäisen roolin ilman yksinyrittämistä.** Savo Outpostin taustalla toimii eteläsavolainen Expion, jonka hallinnollinen ja liiketoiminnallinen tuki on käytössäsi. Sinä voit keskittyä asiakkaisiin, myyntiin ja toiminnan kehittämiseen.**Mahdollisuuden kasvaa tehtävän mukana.** Emme etsi vain nykyisen toiminnan ylläpitäjää vaan ihmistä, joka haluaa tehdä Savo Outpostista tunnetun ja halutun kohtaamispaikan.Tarjoamme vastuuseen nähden kilpailukykyisen ja onnistumisista palkitsevan korvauskokonaisuuden.Kiinnostuitko?Savo Outpost sijaitsee Kantalassa, Mikkelin Haukivuorella. Työ edellyttää läsnäoloa paikan päällä asiakastilaisuuksien ja käytännön järjestelyjen mukaan. Työajat vaihtelevat asiakasvarausten perusteella.Aloitusajankohdasta sovitaan yhdessä.Meitä kiinnostaa ennen kaikkea, millainen ihminen olet ja mitä saisit aikaan.Kerro siis meille, kuka olet, miksi tämä tehtävä kiinnostaa sinua ja miten lähtisit kehittämään Savo Outpostia. Voit hakea vapaamuotoisesti.**Paikka on valmis. Olisitko sinä sen päähenkilö?**

jobs.title: Vi søger en sygeplejerske eller social- og sundhedsassistent (SSA) til Enfamilie ApS
jobs.description:
Vi søger en sygeplejerske eller social- og sundhedsassistent (SSA) til Enfamilie ApS

Brænder du for høj sundhedsfaglig kvalitet, medicinsikkerhed og arbejdet med mennesker, der har brug for særlig støtte og omsorg?

Hos Enfamilie ApS søger vi en engageret og fagligt stærk sygeplejerske eller social- og sundhedsassistent, som har lyst til at blive en del af vores team.

Stillingen indebærer skiftende vagter med arbejde hver anden weekend.

Tiltrædelse: 1. januar 2027 eller gerne før.

Om stillingen

Vi søger en medarbejder, der kan være med til at sikre en høj sundhedsfaglig standard i vores daglige arbejde.

Du får en central rolle i arbejdet med medicinhåndtering, sundhedsfaglig dokumentation og implementering samt efterlevelse af sundhedsfaglige instrukser.

Vi lægger stor vægt på, at vores sundhedsfaglige arbejde udføres systematisk, ansvarligt og i overensstemmelse med gældende lovgivning og retningslinjer fra Styrelsen for Patientsikkerhed.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Sikker og korrekt medicinhåndtering, herunder dispensering, administration, opbevaring og dokumentation.

  • Sikre efterlevelse af gældende sundhedsfaglige instrukser og procedurer.

  • Medvirke til udarbejdelse, implementering og løbende opdatering af lokale sundhedsfaglige instrukser.

  • Arbejde med sundhedsfaglig dokumentation og journalføring i henhold til gældende regler.

  • Bidrage til forebyggelse af medicineringsfejl og håndtering af utilsigtede hændelser.

  • Understøtte kolleger i korrekt udførelse af delegerede sundhedsfaglige opgaver.

  • Samarbejde med læger, øvrige sundhedsfaglige samarbejdspartnere og kolleger.

  • Deltage aktivt i den daglige omsorg, støtte og pleje.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Er uddannet sygeplejerske eller social- og sundhedsassistent med dansk autorisation.

  • Har et solidt kendskab til medicinhåndtering og sundhedsfaglig dokumentation.

  • Har forståelse for gældende sundhedsfaglige krav, instrukser og patientsikkerhed.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og ansvarsbevidst.

  • Kan bevare overblikket og træffe fagligt velbegrundede beslutninger.

  • Har gode samarbejdsevner og bidrager positivt til et tværfagligt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Er fleksibel og indstillet på skiftende vagter samt arbejde hver anden weekend.

Vi tilbyder

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor faglighed, omsorg og kvalitet går hånd i hånd.

  • Mulighed for at få indflydelse på udviklingen af vores sundhedsfaglige praksis.

  • Et tæt samarbejde med engagerede kolleger.

  • En hverdag med både ansvar, variation og meningsfulde opgaver.

  • Mulighed for faglig sparring og udvikling.

Ansættelsesvilkår:

Arbejdstid: Skiftende vagter med arbejde hver anden weekend.

Tiltrædelse: 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale, gerne tidligere.

Arbejdssted: Enfamilie ApS.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår: Efter aftale og kvalifikationer.

Vil du være en del af Enfamilie ApS?

Vi søger en kollega, der har hjertet på rette sted, og som samtidig brænder for at sikre høj sundhedsfaglig kvalitet og patientsikkerhed.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til: info@enfamilie.dk

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen? Kontakt Majbritt Jensen direktør, telefonnummer 22 85 98 33

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Försäljare, Varuboden-City
jobs.description: Primary location:MAARIANHAMINAVI SÖKER FÖRSÄLJARE TILL VARUBODEN CITY FÖR FAST ANSTÄLLNING PÅ 15 H/VECKAVaruboden City söker nu en försäljare på deltid för ett fast anställningsförhållande på 15h/veckan. Detta arbete passar en person som trivs i en fartfylld vardag, tycker om kundservice och möter både kunder och kollegor med hjärtat på rätt ställe.Många jobb beskrivs med stora ord och fina titlar. Här på Varuboden City gillar vi att hålla det enkelt. Vi har jobb som får vardagen att fungera, både för våra kunder och för oss själva. Det betyder inte att dagarna ser likadana ut eller att jobbet är tråkigt. Tvärtom! Ingen dag är den andra lik, och vi är ett gäng som gillar att ha kul tillsammans, hjälpa varandra och skapa bra stämning på jobbet. För oss behöver jobbet inte vara krångligare än så. Det är en viktig del av vardagen, där man lär sig nytt, träffar människor och utvecklas tillsammans med sina kollegor. Och när det finns något att fira, då gör vi gärna det också.I den här rollen- arbetar man med människor överallt – i kassan, i lagret och mellan hyllorna- rör man på sig och lyfter mycket, så god grundkondition är en fördel- jobbar man i alla skift under butikens öppettider, med tyngdpunkt på kvällar och helger- behöver man vara myndig, eftersom vi säljer åldersbegränsade produkter- betjänar man kunden med hjärtat på rätt ställeVad innebär ett jobb hos oss?- Ett jobb som är en naturlig del av vardagen och som ger energi snarare än tar den. Vi behöver inte vara en enda stor familj, men bli inte förvånad om kollegor blir vänner på vägen.- En lön på 10,89– 14,57 euro per timme, beroende på tidigare erfarenhet, utbildning och språkkunskaper. Och dessutom en resultatpremie på upp till 1,70 euro för varje arbetad timme, om och när vi uppnår våra årliga mål.- Personalrabatt på S-gruppens produkter och tjänster, till exempel på mat, dryck, smink, elektronik, restauranger, hotell och mycket annat trevligt.- Motions-, välmående- och kulturförmåner via Friskvård.ax som stöd för en aktiv och balanserad vardag.Intresserad?Skicka din ansökan helt senast söndag 22.11.2026 - men vänta inte i onödan, för vi behandlar ansökningar redan under ansökningsperioden.För mer information om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta enhetschef Ida Olsson (ida.olsson@sok.fi). Arbetsstart enligt överenskommelse.

jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0About the position

For a position as a PhD Candidate, the goal is a completed doctoral education up to an obtained doctoral degree.

We are looking for a PhD candidate for one of 13 PhD positions in Marie Sklodowska-Curie Action (MSCA) CHARM (Conservation of Heritage Architecture, buildings and sites by Resilient Methods: hydro-climate factors) project. The main objective of CHARM MSCA Doctoral Network project is to develop new sustainable conservation and restoration solutions, adapted to the current and future climate conditions, designed in a circular economy philosophy, having a low environmental footprint and high handprint. CHARM also responds to socio-economical requirements of wellbeing and proposes conservation/restoration solutions economically acceptable and respecting the cultural value of buildings.

CHARM proposes a holistic approach including:

  • Site observation and data collection
  • Data preparation to be used by AI, models, etc
  • Methods for understanding and modelling past and future degradation of architectural heritage
  • Sustainable conservation solutions to several observed problems
  • Assessment of the impact of architectural conservation on the environment and of the environment (past, present and future) on architectural heritage
  • Bidirectional interactions with society proposing risk management plans but also taking into account the society wills and needs

The vision of CHARM MSCA project is to educate young and talented scientists towards a combined high-level experimental and data driven approach for the early-stage accurate, precise detection of hydro-climate impact on cultural heritage, to answer to recruitment needs in time of climate change and natural hazards impact about research and innovation in the sector of cultural heritage conservation and restoration. 

CHARM network gathers excellent academic centers that have decennial experience in the field of risk assessment, adaptation and mitigation solutions to the climate change impact, conservation of cultural heritage and restoration, documented by scientific papers published in high impact-factor journals, and by previous EU funded research projects. CHARM puts together researchers from universities and research organisms, national and local organizations in charge of Cultural Heritage conservation, Small and Midsize Enterprises, industrial producer of building materials, and Non-Governmental Organization, from 9 European and 1 South American countries.

Description of DC2 PhD position

Project title: Understanding conservation condition and rehabilitation needs at district scale in time of energy saving and climate change via machine learning driven method

Topic in brief:

The aim is to implement an approach based on artificial intelligence (AI) in the form of CNN to automatically detect cracks and morphological indices in order to manage the large amount of data obtained from photogrammetry and earth observations images.

Objectives:

This doctoral project aims to develop deep learning neural networks to investigate data in available database (e.g., EU building stock observatory and other similar database) to:

  1. classify building stock at district scale more prone to decay based on buildings construction year, location, main constitutive material, exposure, use and
  2. to predict potential maintenance and restoration priority based on (i) and existing energy retrofit directive and/or risk maps 

Expected results:

(i)to build high-quality dataset highlighting the façade that is more prone to decay at district/city level from existing raw database; 

(ii) to apply deep learning neural networks (e.g., convolutional neural network) to perform semi-automatic decay pattern segmentation and associated mapping; 

(iii) to correlate the maintenance of buildings at district/city level with decay patterns/features at district scale to prioritize large scale intervention; and 

(iv) to optimize the maintenance activities by leveraging these correlations learned by machine-learning based approaches. 

Supervisory Committee:

  • Main supervisor: Full prof. Chiara Bertolin, Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering (MTP) (Academic)
  • Co-supervisor: Associate prof. Chao Gao, Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering (MTP) (Academic)
  • Mentor: Dr. Marie Louise Anker, Department Director at Nidaros Cathedral Restoration Works. (Non.Academic)

 

Planned secondments

SECONDMENT 1 - Prof. P. Fafalios (FORTH Foundation for Research and Technology – Hellas, Crete) M12, duration: 4 weeks, AI and ML algorithms,

SECONDMENT 2 - Prof. Carradò (CY Cergy Paris University) Karima El Ganaoui, ESTI Pau CY Tech, M24, duration: 4 weeks, AI materials

Duties of the position
  • Take part in the mandatory PhD research education programme
  • Develop a quantitative deep-learning-based framework to detect the micro-cracks and validate the developed framework
  • Define micro-scale indices to evaluate crack morphological characteristics and validate developed the indices
  • Classify the micro-morphologies and damages of undamage and damage materials and/or hazard prone or not buildings and landscape
  • Participate in other relevant research and dissemination activities through our international collaborators
  • Conduct and publish high-level research at peer-reviewed journals and international conferences
  • Carry on condition monitoring campaigns and surveys in situ
  • Write and defend a PhD thesis

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required selection criteria
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Statistics, Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering or equivalent. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level. Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position.
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you maybe considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme
  • Excellent written and oral English
  • Strong background in applying deep learning neural networks on image segmentation associated with materials and the built environment
  • Excellent programming skills in Python and Matlab

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Experience in processing-imaging techniques (e.g. 3D Data Processing, point clouds, geospatial Analysis)
  • Knowledge and technical skills of condition monitoring, analytical damage functions and/or analytical methods/models
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Strong interest and self-motivated attitude to explore scientific questions
  • Think and work independently
  • Team player with cooperative attitude
  • Good communication skills

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer
  • Opportunity to carry our cutting-edge research in the area of applying machine learning technique to detection, classification and prediction of material degradation and get multidisciplinary and multisectoral training by experts and experienced supervisors from academic world
  • Opportunity to publish your research findings in working team and participate the national and international conferences
  • Opportunity to stay at our academic partners at FORTH Foundation for Research and Technology – Hellas in Crete (Greece), and Cergy Paris University in Paris, France.
  • Opportunity to work in an international team and be part of a network of 13 PhD students
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding from Marie Sklodowska-Curie Action (MSCA) for CHARM project.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Motivation letter justifying your interest and fit for the position
  • Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Chiara Bertolin, e-mail: chiara.bertolin@ntnu.no.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Senior Consultant Hedda Winnberg, e-mail: hedda.winnberg@ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 26.11.2026

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality.

jobs.title: Capacitaire / Référent du projet animalier (H/F)
jobs.description: Le Parc Animalier de Sainte-Croix entre dans une nouvelle étape de son histoire. Après 45 ans d'engagement pour le vivant, le parc a souhaité restructurer en profondeur son pôle animalier afin d'en faire un modèle de transmission, de conservation et de bien-être animal, fruit d'une nouvelle d'organisation. Depuis 2 ans nous restructurons le service avec un nouveau cadre managérial de proximité engagé et compétent, des équipes stables et un projet en construction.   Notre ambition est claire : Reconnecter toutes les générations au vivant, dans le respect des animaux et des écosystèmes, pour transformer le regard de nos visiteurs sur la nature. Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un capacitaire capable d'accompagner cette transformation, non pas uniquement comme garant réglementaire, mais comme référent structurant d'un projet animalier ambitieux. Le projet :Le pôle animalier de Sainte-Croix a engagé un travail de restructuration autour de plusieurs priorités : - Clarifier les rôles et responsabilités de chacun - Renforcer l'autonomie des responsables de secteur et des équipes - Structurer les procédures, les circuits de décision et les validations - Faire monter les équipes en compétence - Développer une culture forte du bien-être animal - Mieux intégrer les projets d'élevage, de conservation et de réintroduction ; - Accompagner l'évolution des infrastructures et des enclos ; - Donner davantage de sens, de cadre et de fluidité au quotidien animalier. Ce travail s'inscrit dans la continuité de l'accompagnement mené avec Brice Lefaux, qui a permis de poser un diagnostic, d'identifier les axes de progrès et d'engager une nouvelle dynamique collective.  La mission :- être le garant du cadre réglementaire, sécuritaire et animalier du parc. - veiller à ce que les décisions prises soient conformes aux obligations liées à la détention et à la présentation au public d'animaux sauvages, tout en permettant à l'organisation de gagner en maturité et en autonomie.    Sous la responsabilité directe de la Direction du parc, vous rejoindrez le pôle animalier, une équipe pluridisciplinaire d'une trentaine de collaborateurs composée de vétérinaires, d'un chef de service, de managers de proximité et de soigneurs animaliers. Le poste ne comporte pas de missions de gestion administrative ni d'encadrement d'équipe.  Votre rôle est de poser le cadre, sécuriser les décisions importantes, transmettre votre expertise dans des réflexions collectives et accompagner la montée en compétence et responsabilité des équipes. Et notamment : - Faire partie du comité de direction avec votre expertise et un bon niveau d'autonomie. - Participer à la conception du Master Plan. Nous recherchons une personne capable de conjuguer exigence réglementaire, expertise zoologique et intelligence collective. Vous devrez accompagner Sainte-Croix dans la nouvelle étape du pôle animalier : être une équipe exemplaire, structurée, responsable et pleinement alignée avec la raison d'être du parc. Vous devrez également :- être titulaire du Certificat de capacité adapté aux espèces concernées. - justifier d'une solide expérience en parc zoologique. - posséder un bon niveau d'autonomie. - Très bonne connaissance du bien-être animal, de la sécurité et des obligations réglementaires. - Capacité à travailler de manière transverse avec une direction, une responsable zoologique, des responsables de secteur et des équipes terrain. - Goût pour la transmission, la structuration et l'accompagnement du changement. - Capacité à déléguer et à faire grandir les équipes. - Sensibilité forte aux enjeux de conservation, d'éducation et de reconnexion au vivant. Vous ne serez pas seulement le garant d'un cadre, vous serez l'un des artisans d'une nouvelle organisation au service des animaux, des équipes et de la mission du parc.

jobs.title: Communications Student Assistant – Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team
jobs.description:
About ICARS The International Centre for Antimicrobial Resistance Solutions (ICARS) is an independent international organisation established by the Danish Government to support low- and middle-income countries in developing evidence-based and context-appropriate solutions to antimicrobial resistance (AMR). Working across the One Health spectrum, ICARS collaborates with governments, research institutions and global organisations to bridge research, policy and implementation. About the role We are looking for a Student Assistant to join our Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team. This is a great opportunity for a student interested in digital communications, creative media, data management and global health and development. You’ll support our day-to-day activities and help communicate ICARS’ work on AMR in LMICs. We’re looking for someone with strong technical skills who also takes initiative to bring fresh ideas to the team. Alongside delivering assigned tasks, you will be encouraged to suggest improvements and take ownership of agreed activities, with support and feedback from colleagues. Key responsibilities Website management:
  • Maintain and update content on ICARS’ WordPress website, keeping it accurate, accessible and user-friendly.
  • Track website performance using analytics tools and suggest improvements based on the findings.
  • Proactively identify outdated content, gaps and opportunities to better showcase our work.
Graphic design & visual content:
  • Create engaging infographics, social media graphics and report layouts that align with ICARS’ brand.
  • Help develop templates and designs for reports and presentations, bringing fresh ideas for communicating complex information clearly.
  • Video editing & multimedia:
  • Edit videos for ICARS’ social media, presentations and events.
  • Support video production and identify opportunities to turn existing footage into useful, engaging content.
Social media support :
  • Support ICARS’ LinkedIn presence through content creation and community engagement.
  • Keep an eye on relevant conversations, project updates and sector developments, suggesting timely stories and opportunities for ICARS to contribute.
Internal communications support:
  • Maintain our internal SharePoint, including keeping our media library organised and up to date.
  • Support colleagues with designing clear, engaging PowerPoint slides and formatting Word documents.
Press Office and external communications support:
  • Assist with event promotion and Mailchimp newsletter creation.
  • Monitor our communications mailbox, respond to routine enquiries and coordinate with colleagues on requests from stakeholders, including regional and national press.
  • Flag relevant media and communications opportunities for the team to consider.
Data and stakeholder information management:
  • Support the team in entering and maintaining accurate, up-to-date data and contact information in ATLAS, our CRM system.
  • Other tasks related to deliverables of the Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team.
Desired profile We are seeking an organised and curious student who enjoys both developing ideas and getting things done in a pro-active and structured manner. You take the initiative to find information, ask useful questions and suggest practical next steps. You can work independently, recognise when to seek guidance and lead tasks through to completion, while keeping colleagues informed. You are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly, and you bring strong digital fluency, technical skills and the ability to pick up new tools with ease. Required qualifications:
  • Currently studying for a Master’s degree in IT, Media Studies, Marketing, Graphic Design or a related field.
  • Proficiency in WordPress and basic website management.
  • Experience using MS Office, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with graphic design tools, such as Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Basic video editing skills, using Premiere Pro, Final Cut or similar software.
  • Strong organisational skills, working in a structured manner and with attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks.
  • Ability to identify opportunities, propose ideas and take responsibility for delivering agreed tasks.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in perfect and fluent English, including the ability to adapt content for different audiences.
Preferred qualifications:
  • Knowledge of Google Analytics, or a willingness to learn.
  • Experience using CRM platforms (Dynamics 365)
  • Skills and interest in drafting technical and scientific communication material.
What we offer
  • Hands-on experience: Contribute to drafting communications material, external stakeholder management and partnerships, developing your skills through practical work and feedback.
  • Impact: Help communicate solutions to one of the world’s most critical global health and development challenges, with space to contribute your own ideas and see them put into practice.
  • Flexible working hours: Our working hours between 8 am and 5 pm with accommodation of your academic schedule.
  • International environment: Work alongside experts and colleagues from diverse backgrounds in a global organisation.
If you enjoy turning ideas into action and want to use your communications skills to support global health, we would love to hear from you! Terms of employment The position as student assistant will be covered by the terms of the collective agreement between The Danish Finance Ministry and the Organisation of Public Employees (OAO-S-Fællesoverenskomsten) and the organizational agreement between The Danish Finance Ministry and the Organisation for Salaried Employees HK/Stat (Organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK)), according to chapter 6 in the agreement concerning hourly paid employees. The successful candidate is enrolled at graduate level in a Danish University with at around two years of studies remaining. They will predominantly work from the ICARS HQ office, based at the Statens Serum Institut in Copenhagen, Denmark. Application and recruitment process Press “apply for the position” and submit your CV along with a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role and motivation for applying. We would like to receive your application by 20 November 2026 and expect to conduct interviews 24-27 November 2026. For questions about the role, please contact Communications Officer Chloe Modvig-Cole (checo@icars-global.org) and for other questions about the position you may contact Head of Partnerships and Global Relations Theresa Hogenhaug (tcah@icars-global.org). We are committed to cultivating a fair and healthy environment, where everyone can be themselves and thrive. We are happy to discuss flexible working options for all roles. We work to ensure that our recruitment processes are as inclusive as possible to everyone. This includes adjusting for people who have a disability or long-term condition. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Demonstratør: Et fleksibelt job, der passer ind i din hverdag
jobs.description:
Demonstratører / Demonstratricer søges til hele landet

Et fleksibelt job, der passer ind i din hverdag

Søger du et meningsfuldt og socialt job, der passer ind i netop din hverdag?

Hos IN-STORE søger vi kollegaer til en spændende stilling som demonstratør. Som demonstratør bliver du vores ansigt udadtil og er med til at skabe gode oplevelser for både kunder og butikker. Du uddeler smagsprøver, fortæller om produkterne og giver kunderne lyst til at prøve noget nyt. Her kommer din livserfaring og evne til at tale med mennesker dig til gode.

Uanset om du er pensionist, der ønsker at supplere din indkomst, selvstændig, der søger et fleksibelt bijob, eller noget helt tredje, kan dette være det perfekte match for dig. Du bliver vores ansigt udadtil og er med til at skabe gode oplevelser for både kunder og butikker. 

Dine opgaver indebærer:

  • Let tilberedning og uddeling af smagsprøver. 

  • Engagerende samtaler og salg af produkterne.

  • Opsætning af en pæn og indbydende stand.

  • Skabe en god relation til de butikker, du besøger.

Vi tilbyder et job, der passer til dig

Vi ved at fleksibilitet og frihed er vigtigt - derfor tilbyder vi: 

  • Frihed til at planlægge: Du bestemmer selv, hvor mange vagter du ønsker om måneden. Vores vagter er 6-8 timer ad gangen og spredt over hele ugen - fredage og lørdage er dog altid vores mest aktive dage. 

  • Social og aktiv arbejdsdag: Du bliver en del af et team af kollegaer, der ligesom dig selv, sætter pris på at holde sig aktiv og social.

  • Udstyr derhjemme: Du opbevarer dit udstyr hjemme og tager det med, når du skal på arbejde.

  • Kørsel i egen bil: Du får skattefri kørselsgodtgørelse efter gældende regler.

 

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du er imødekommende, ansvarsfuld og glad for at tale med mennesker. Din livserfaring er en stor fordel, da du er god til at tale med alle slags mennesker og skabe tillid. Erfaring som demonstratør er ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at præsentere produkter og give kunderne en god oplevelse.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at:

  • Du er god til at kommunikere og er god til at formidle et budskab.

  • Du er ansvarsfuld og mødestabil.

  • Du trives med at arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Du er fortrolig med IT (smartphone, e-mail) og har bil til rådighed. 

 

Sådan søger du jobbet:

Send os din ansøgning med CV og et vellignende billede af dig selv via vores hjemmeside www.in-store.dk.

Du er velkommen til at kontakte vores HR Koordinator, Emilie Braagaard, på tlf. 52 18 64 09 eller mail embra@in-store.dk, hvis du har spørgsmål til jobbet.

 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Credit Union Member Service Officer (MSO)
jobs.description: The Member Service Officer (MSO) is a key front-line role responsible for delivering a friendly, efficient, and professional service to members. This includes handling financial transactions, supporting lending operations, advising on credit union products, and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, including those set by the Central Bank of Ireland. Key Responsibilities● Serve as the first point of contact for members across all channels (in-branch, phone, email).● Process daily transactions such as lodgements, withdrawals, loan payments, and direct debits accurately.● Provide members with accurate information about products and services, including savings and loans.● Support members through the loan application process, including documentation gathering and system entry.● Promote credit union products and services to members in line with their financial needs and goals.● Ensure all activity complies with AML, CFT, and GDPR regulations, as well as Central Bank of Ireland guidelines.● Maintain accurate member records and update account information securely and confidentially.● Assist with balancing cash, preparing reports, and performing reconciliations.● Work closely with other departments to resolve member queries and deliver excellent member service.● Participate in training, upskilling, and CPD requirements related to your qualifications. Essential Skills & Qualifications● Minimum of Leaving Certificate or equivalent.● Holds a relevant qualification such as QFA (Qualified Financial Adviser) or APA (Accredited Product Adviser) as per Central Bank of Ireland Minimum Competency Code (MCC) requirements.○ Note: Candidates working towards APA/QFA may be considered depending on experience.● Previous experience in customer service, preferably in financial services, banking, or credit unions.● Strong IT skills, including competence in Microsoft Office and member/accounting systems.● Excellent communication, organisational, and interpersonal skills.● High level of accuracy and attention to detail.● Ability to work on own initiative and as part of a team. Desirable● Experience with loan processing, AML procedures, or GDPR compliance.● Knowledge of the credit union movement and its values.● Understanding of the regulatory environment in Irish financial services. Key Competencies● Member-first mindset● Accuracy and attention to detail● Teamwork and collaboration● Communication and interpersonal skills● Problem-solving ability● Compliance awareness● Initiative and accountability Other Requirements● Flexibility to work additional hours when required.● Commitment to ongoing CPD in line with MCC requirements (if APA/QFA is held).● Willingness to complete further relevant training (e.g., CUCP courses). Apply now: aidan@prorecruitmentireland.ie

Hos Dansk Tavle Teknik A/S oplever vi stor aktivitet, og derfor søger vi en montør med erfaring inden for opbygning og montage af fordelingstavler i Helsingør.

Har du en stærk mekanisk og el-teknisk forståelse, og motiveres du af at levere kvalitetsløsninger? Trives du i et fagligt stærkt miljø, hvor godt håndværk, samarbejde og høj kvalitet er i fokus? Så er du måske vores nye tavlemontør.

Du er faglært mekaniker, smed, elektriker, automatiktekniker eller har en anden relevant mekanisk eller el-teknisk baggrund.

jobs.title: Lead Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: Are you an electrical engineer who wants to be the one who decides how an automation system is built, not just the one who draws it?This role is built for engineers who want to own the electrical side of a project from the first customer conversation to the final sign-off. You define the system architecture, size and specify the components, design the solution in Eplan, and then follow it through the build: reviewing the installation in our own Vantaa facility and, when the system is ready, supporting commissioning on site.You will work side by side with a tight-knit automation team of PLC engineers, mechanical designers and installers. They build and program what you design, and you stay close enough to the shop floor to see how your design performs in practice. Our projects live under Etteplan's delivery umbrella, so you get the engineering depth of a large organization together with the full weight and satisfaction of an end-to-end project.If you have years of industrial electrical design behind you, know Eplan inside out, and want technical leadership without leaving hands-on engineering, this is the seat for you. Each project brings something new: PLCs, robotics, AMRs and data systems integrated into complete customer solutions.Deep expertise, genuine ownership, and the kind of variety that keeps the work interesting. That is what we are offering.Key Responsibilities - Define the electrical and automation system architecture together with customers and the project team - Lead the electrical design of automation systems in Eplan, and maintain Eplan standards, macros and templates - Integrate PLCs, drives, robots, AMRs, safety and network devices into complete solutions - Specify components with suppliers and size the system: power, protection, cabling and cabinet thermal design - Supervise installation and wiring in our Vantaa facility and on customer sites, and support FAT, commissioning and troubleshooting - Ensure standards compliance and documentation (e.g. SFS-EN IEC 60204-1, IEC 61439, EMC), and guide and review the work of other electrical designersWhat We Expect from You - M.Sc. or B.Sc. (or equivalent) in electrical engineering or automation - Solid experience (typically 8+ years) of electrical design for industrial automation, machinery or production lines - Deep Eplan expertise; Pro Panel and macro automation are a plus - Experience in system architecture and electrical sizing, and good understanding of PLC systems (Siemens, Beckhoff or B&R) and industrial networks - Hands-on understanding of installation work: you can read a cabinet on the shop floor and find the fault - Leadership attitude: ability to guide others and make well-founded technical decisions - Interest in robotics, AMRs and simulation is a plus - Fluency in English and Finnish - Willingness to travel occasionally and ability to work regularly on site in VantaaThis is a permanent, full-time position. Applicants must have valid authorization to work in Finland. Please note that Etteplan does not provide relocation support or compensation.At Etteplan we ensure that your compensation is fair and transparent. Your salary reflects your competencies and contributions. For this role, the typical monthly salary is 4800–5500 €/month, depending on your background.Sounds like the right opportunity for you? Please submit your application through our recruitment system by end of November at the latest. For more information about the role, you can contact Director Jari Luotonen, jari.luotonen@etteplan.com.

jobs.title: (Senior) Legal Counsel @ Finnfund
jobs.description: **Hey lawyer!**Would you like to contribute to shaping a more sustainable future? Would you like to help drive sustainable growth and create opportunities through investments in developing countries?We are now looking for **a (Senior) Legal Counsel** to join **Finnfund's** team. This is a full-time, permanent position based in Helsinki._Finnfund is a Finnish development financier and impact investor. Finnfund builds a sustainable future and generates lasting impact by investing in businesses that solve global development challenges with Finnish added value. Each year, Finnfund invests 200–250 million euros in 20–30 companies in developing countries. Finnfund's focus is particularly on digital infrastructure and solutions, clean energy, forestry, agriculture, and on providing funding for small and medium-sized enterprises through financial institutions. Today, Finnfund's investments, commitments, and investment decisions total about 1.2 billion euros. Finnfund has about 100 employees based in Helsinki and Nairobi. For more information, please visit the company's website at https://www.finnfund.fi/en/._Finnfund is mandated to provide long-term financing for economically feasible private sector projects in emerging markets. Finnfund's financing is channelled either as debt, equity, or mezzanine instruments and they also invest through private equity funds.**As a (Senior) Legal Counsel,** you will act as a member of project teams and identify, assess, and manage legal risks related to projects. You will oversee project documentation and legal matters, coordinate external legal assignments, and provide support on responsible taxation.You will also assist with other legal matters, including internal decision-making processes and approval levels. You will maintain and develop the legal function by, amongst other things, keeping up to date with regulations related to project work and communicating new or revised regulations to project teams and, when needed, by participating in implementing such regulations into Finnfund's processes. You will also participate in drafting and updating templates and guidelines and other development work of Finnfund's operations.The role offers opportunities to contribute to diverse projects and legal matters beyond the core responsibilities outlined above. You will join a ten-person Legal Affairs team and report to the Director of Legal Affairs.**This position is a great fit for a lawyer who:**- has a Master of Laws degree (preferably Finnish or English) or an equivalent legal degree and a minimum of 5 years of applicable professional experience from either a law firm or a financial institution. Please note that applicants must already have the legal right to live and work in Helsinki (Finland). Due to time constraints, Finnfund is unable to sponsor work permits or support relocation-related immigration processes for this role; - has experience in debt financing - expertise in complex restructuring situations would be considered an advantage. Experience in cross-border transactions, equity investments and/or project finance would also be an asset; - is proactive, has excellent teamwork skills, takes full ownership of their work, and can work independently under time pressure; - has excellent IT skills, which are essential in today's hybrid working environment; and - has excellent writing and communication skills in English – fluency in other languages and international experience are considered assets. **What Finnfund offers you:****Work that makes a difference**: Finnfund's mission is to build a sustainable future and generate lasting impact by investing in businesses that solve global development challenges with Finnish added value. Their vision is that people and the Planet are at the core of every investment decision.**Challenging yet rewarding role:** You'll step into a role where you'll contribute to exciting and challenging international projects as part of a multinational team.**A modern office space in Helsinki**: The office has been designed in collaboration with Finnfund's employees. jobs.title: Swedish speaking telesales agent (insurance sales)
jobs.description:
Do you like to challenge yourself and are you comfortable with some healthy competition?- Then you could be the one we are looking for to join our Sales Representative department at Nordiccom!Nordiccom is a Danish company located in Copenhagen. With offices in both Copenhagen, Malmö and Helsinki, our Swedish team is working hard and would love some new energetic colleagues joining them on their sales team, who’s responsible for selling insurances over the phone. We partner with banks and insurance companies, and we only sell to existing customers of our partners, so there is no cold calling.

- Guaranteed wage combined with attractive bonus & commission agreements and prizes

- A social working place in a comfortable & productive environment

- A multinational working environment with an informal tone and high job satisfaction

- Helpful and motivated colleagues

- Advantageous working hours and traffic connections near Copenhagen city

Who are we and what do we do?

Nordiccom ApS is a growing Nordic company located in the heart of Copenhagen and Helsinki. The companies we represent are major banking and insurance companies in Europe. With the entire Northern Europe market as our workplace, and the phone as our tool, we provide solutions for sales and customer service for a wide range of companies in the financial business. Therefore, we comply with the banks’ standards and code of conduct, so quality is ensured. In Nordiccom you will meet both Danes, Norwegians, Finns and Swedes. Our goal is that we shape our employees for success. That they become skilled at their work and achieve good results. All training is practiced in your own language.

jobs.title: Dygtig freelance mødebooker
jobs.description:
Freelance mødebooker søges til B2B-mødebooking

Har du solid erfaring med mødebooking og kold kanvas – og motiveres du af frihed, ansvar og resultater?

Hjælp til salg søger en dygtig og stabil freelance mødebooker til booking af kvalificerede B2B-møder for vores kunder.

Stillingen er for dig, der allerede ved, hvad der skal til for at komme igennem til den rette beslutningstager, skabe en god dialog og booke et relevant møde.

Arbejdet udføres hjemmefra, og du kan derfor befinde dig hvor som helst i Danmark eller resten af verden.

Om arbejdet

Du kommer til at arbejde med udgående telefonisk mødebooking for forskellige danske B2B-virksomheder.

Opgaverne vil typisk bestå af:

  • Telefonisk kontakt til potentielle erhvervskunder

  • Kold kanvas og dialog med relevante beslutningstagere

  • Præsentation af kundens løsning på en professionel og troværdig måde

  • Booking af kvalificerede møder

  • Løbende opfølgning og registrering af aktiviteter

  • Tæt dialog med Hjælp til salg omkring kvalitet, resultater og kundernes ønsker

Vi leder efter dig, der

  • Har dokumenteret erfaring med B2B-mødebooking, telefonsalg eller kold kanvas

  • Har eget CVR-nummer og arbejder som selvstændig freelancer

  • Er stabil, selvkørende og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Kan arbejde struktureret og følge op på dine leads

  • Er god til at skabe tillid og føre en naturlig samtale

  • Taler og forstår dansk

  • Har en professionel telefonstemme og en god forretningsforståelse

  • Kan håndtere afvisninger uden at miste motivationen

  • Har de nødvendige rammer til at arbejde hjemmefra, herunder en stabil internetforbindelse og rolige omgivelser

Erfaring er et krav

Dette er ikke en oplæringsstilling.

Det er et krav, at du allerede har praktisk erfaring med mødebooking, kold kanvas eller opsøgende B2B-telefonsalg. Har du ikke denne erfaring, er stillingen desværre ikke det rette match.

Vi forventer ikke, at du kender alle vores kunder eller brancher på forhånd. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du kender håndværket, kan sætte dig ind i nye løsninger og hurtigt omsætte et manuskript til en troværdig samtale.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fleksibelt freelancearbejde hjemmefra

  • Mulighed for at arbejde fra hele verden

  • Aflønning pr. godkendt og kvalificeret møde

  • Forskellige B2B-kunder og brancher

  • Grundig introduktion til den enkelte kunde og opgave

  • Sparring, feedback og løbende dialog

  • Mulighed for et længerevarende samarbejde for den rette person

  • Frihed under ansvar og mulighed for selv at strukturere din arbejdsdag

Aflønning

Du aflønnes pr. booket møde, der lever op til den enkelte kundes aftalte kriterier.

Den konkrete pris pr. møde afhænger af opgaven og aftales inden opstart. Som freelancer fakturerer du Hjælp til salg fra dit eget CVR-nummer.

Om Hjælp til salg

Hjælp til salg har siden 2017 hjulpet danske virksomheder med professionel B2B-mødebooking.

Vi har fokus på møder med kvalitet. Derfor handler arbejdet ikke blot om at få en aftale i kalenderen, men om at booke relevante møder med de rette beslutningstagere og skabe et godt grundlag for kundens videre salgsdialog.

Vi lægger stor vægt på kvalitet, ærlighed, stabilitet og et professionelt samarbejde.

Sådan søger du

Send en kort ansøgning, hvor du beskriver:

  • Din erfaring med mødebooking og kold kanvas

  • Hvilke typer virksomheder eller brancher du tidligere har arbejdet med

  • Hvilke resultater du tidligere har skabt

  • Hvor mange timer du forventer at kunne arbejde om ugen

  • Hvornår du kan starte

  • Bekræftelse på, at du har eget CVR-nummer

Vedlæg gerne dit CV eller et link til din LinkedIn-profil.

Vi kontakter kun ansøgere, der har relevant erfaring og matcher kravene til stillingen.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Hjælp til salgMøder med kvalitethjaelptilsalg.dk

jobs.title: Site Administrator
jobs.description: Site Administrator**Location:** Hamina, Finland **Employment Type:** Full-time, average 40 hours per week **Working Schedule:** 6-week working rotation followed by 2 weeks off, subject to applicable working time regulationsAbout the RoleWe are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Site Administrator to support operations at a large-scale industrial construction project in Hamina, Finland.The successful candidate will coordinate international employee onboarding, maintain site documentation, and facilitate effective communication between project management, contractors, and international technical teams.Key Responsibilities- Coordinate and manage onboarding procedures for international workers arriving at the construction site. - Maintain, update, organize, and archive project documentation in accordance with company and client requirements. - Facilitate communication the client, and international technical teams. - Assist with monitoring employee working hours, shift rotations, and personnel records. - Prepare and maintain administrative reports and site records. - Support compliance with site access, confidentiality, data protection, and occupational safety procedures. Candidate Requirements- **Relevant Experience:** 1–2 years of experience in site administration, industrial project administration, or a comparable role. - **Industry Experience:** Previous experience in large-scale industrial construction, data centre projects, or similar technical environments is highly desirable. - **Language Skills:** Advanced English proficiency (C1 level or equivalent) in both written and spoken communication is required. Candidates must be able to communicate effectively with international technical teams and prepare accurate administrative reports and documentation.  Applicants are encouraged to provide a recognized English language certificate (IELTS, TOEFL, Cambridge English, or equivalent) or other evidence of their English proficiency. - **Specialized Knowledge:** Practical understanding of working time records, shift rotations, overtime arrangements, and administrative procedures in industrial environments. - **Site Compliance:** Familiarity with occupational safety procedures, site access requirements, and worker onboarding processes. - **Technical Skills:** Good organizational skills, document management abilities, and proficiency in standard office software. - **Personal Skills:** Strong communication skills, attention to detail, discretion, and the ability to work under deadlines. We welcome applications from candidates who meet the requirements and can demonstrate the necessary skills and experience.

jobs.description: Primary location:KAJAANIEtsimme joukkoomme kahta (2) MYYJÄÄ ihan tavallisiin töihin, poikkeuksellisen timanttiseen tiimiinS-market Kajaani Kauppakatu löytyy Raatikeskuksesta, Kajaanin keskustan ytimessä. Meillä tehdään ihan tavallisia töitä, poikkeuksellisen timanttisessa tiimissä. Tavallisuus ei ole tylsää, vaan sitä arkea ja välillä myös juhlaa, mitä haluamme asiakkaillemme luoda. Haluamme tarjota sujuvaa palvelua, tavoitteellisesti ja laadukkaasti. Myyjänä tehtäviisi kuuluu asiakaspalvelun lisäksi monipuolisesti kaupan eri työtehtävät, kuten kuorman purkaminen, kassatyö sekä verkkokaupan ja ruokarobottien parissa työskentely. Työ sisältää aamu-, ilta- ja viikonlopputyötä.Tehtävät ovat vakituisia ja osa-aikaisia (vähintään keskimäärin 20 h/viikko). Voit myös halutessasi tehdä lisätyötä Osuuskauppa Maakunnan muissa yksiköissä.Etsimme kahta (2) toimeen tarttuvaa, positiivisella asenteelle työtään tekevää tiimityöntekijää. Työssä tarvitaan paineensietokykyä sekä joustavuutta, samalla mahdollistaen asiakkaillemme laadukkaita palvelukokemuksia. Kaupallinen koulutus antaa pohjan työlle, mutta ennen kaikkea arvostamme aitoa halua sekä innokkuutta oppia uutta.Osuuskauppa Maakunnassa huolehditaan työntekijöiden hyvinvoinnista ja työturvallisuudesta: Meillä on poikkeuksellisen kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten alennukset S-ryhmän kaupoissa, ravintoloissa ja hotelleissa. Käytössäsi ovat laajat työterveyshuollon palvelut, vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus, mahdollisuus henkilöstörahastoon sekä ePassin tuoma tuki liikuntaan, kulttuuriin ja hyvinvointiin.Panostus henkilöstön hyvinvointiin näkyy myös tunnustuksina: Osuuskauppa Maakunta on tänä vuonna palkittu Suomen Innostavimmat työpaikat -kilpailun keskisuurten yritysten sarjassa, sijoituksen perustuessa henkilökunnan työtyytyväisyyskyselyn tuloksiin.Palkka perustuu kaupan alan työehtosopimukseen ja on kokemusvuosiin perustuen 10,68–14,93€/tunti. Vuorotyössä peruspalkan päälle maksetaan ilta-, lauantai- ja sunnuntai -lisät. Meillä työryhmillä on myös mahdollisuus tulospalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1 €/tehty työtunti.Lisätietoja antaa marketpäällikkö Maarit Leiviskä p. 010763 6508Hae pian, viimeistään 30.11.2026Osuuskauppa Maakunta on kainuulaisten asiakasomistajien omistama alueosuuskauppa.
