jobs.title: Lead Game Programmer
jobs.description: Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let's talk.Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.Here's what that looks like day to dayIn collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you'll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editorYou'll set and communicate the project's technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical prioritiesYou'll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needsYou'll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneckYou'll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right timeOverall, you'll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build onThis includes things like...Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibilityImplementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friendsProfiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connectionsBreaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affectStaying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolvesYou're a great match ifYou have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a projectYou have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative productionYou're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editorYou've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alikeNice to havesYou have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and SwiftExperience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online gamesInterest in multiplayer game design and social featuresExperience working with automated build pipelines such as JenkinsExperience building systemic or open-world gamesWhat always matters to us at TribandYou thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forwardYou're motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that cultureYou believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyoneYou bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test themYou love exploration and experimentation but don't get too precious when the evidence tells you you're wrongYou value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to bePracticalitiesWe work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.Our working language is English.We offerSilly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.A professional development budget to invest in your growth.Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.Pension plan and private health insurance.Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

jobs.title: Train for a New Career as an HSE Professional
jobs.description: **How would you like the opportunity to train for a new career while working in permanent employment?**This opportunity is ideal for a technical professional with a strong motivation to pursue a career in construction site safety.The training recruitment programme will begin in late 2026, and two candidates will be selected. The selected candidates will be offered permanent employment, including the required training and practical on-site induction with the support of the site organisation.**What will you be doing?**In this role, you will participate in the day-to-day monitoring of safety on the construction site. You will review the risks associated with different work phases together with employees and site management, participate in safety inspections and document observations made on site. You will monitor the implementation of agreed safety measures and help ensure that all work is carried out safely and in accordance with the sites requirements.Your duties will also include preparing and updating risk assessments, conducting pre-work inspections for upcoming activities and managing safety documentation. As your training progresses and your expertise develops, you will take a more independent role in preparing RAMS documentation and method statements, as well as participating in site safety and coordination meetings. You will work closely with site management, other contractors and the principal contractor.**What do we expect from you?**The position is suitable for candidates with a relevant bachelors degree in Construction Engineering or Construction Site Management, together with practical experience in the construction industry. Previous experience in a dedicated HSE role is not required, but we expect you to have a practical understanding of construction site safety and a strong motivation to train and develop into an HSE professional.At the beginning of your employment, you will complete an OSHA Construction Safety course delivered in English. The course will provide you with the knowledge and skills required to work in construction site safety. As your expertise and experience develop, you will have the opportunity to complete the NEBOSH International General Certificate and progress towards more demanding HSE responsibilities.You will need a good command of English, as you will work in an international environment, prepare safety documentation and complete the initial safety training in English. We expect you to have a systematic and responsible approach to your work, strong attention to detail and the confidence to address any safety issues you identify in a constructive manner.**What do we offer?**We offer permanent employment through Biisoni and a long-term role on a major project in Seinäjoki. You will have the opportunity to build a new career in construction site safety and develop your expertise through professional training, practical induction and the support of an experienced organisation. Your responsibilities will expand as your training progresses and your expertise develops.Your salary will be agreed based on your qualifications, previous experience and the level of responsibility at the beginning of the role. Your salary will be reviewed as you complete the required training and develop in the role.You will receive comprehensive induction covering the sites operating practices, safety requirements, documentation and systems. After the current project, the work continue at other construction sites in Finland or abroad. We therefore value a willingness to travel for work.**Interested?**If you would like to pursue a career in construction site safety, we would be delighted to hear from you. Please submit your application through the application link as soon as possible, but no later than 19 November 2026. We will review applications throughout the application period.For further information about the position, please contact Biisoni: Roope Takala, **roope.takala@biisoni.fi** Susanna Tallbacka **susanna.tallbacka@biisoni.fi**

jobs.title: Customer Service Specialist, Efla – Porvoo
jobs.description: About the roleEfla Oy, part of the Ensto Group, is an international company based in Porvoo and specialized in airfield lighting solutions. The companys business has grown strongly in recent years, and we are now looking for a Customer Service Specialist to support Eflas increasing order volume, international customers and the smooth handling of orders from start to finish.In this role, you will not be working in traditional inbound or outbound customer service. Instead, you will be responsible especially for order handling, order deliveries, export documentation, invoicing and shipping documents. You will work in an important role between customers, sales, production, logistics and the internal customer service team.The role is well suited for someone with a background in business, logistics, international business or a similar field, who has strong English skills, good ability to work under pressure and a desire to develop in an international order delivery environment. Previous experience in order handling, customer service, export, logistics or ERP systems is considered an advantage, but the most important things are the right attitude, willingness to learn and the ability to take initiative.What we offerEfla offers you the opportunity to become part of an international, growing and hands-on company where you get to see the full order delivery chain as a whole.In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop your skills in areas such as:- international customer service- order handling and order management- export documentation and shipping documents- invoicing and the use of ERP systems- cooperation between production, logistics and sales- working with global customers and different culturesThis is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow into specialist roles in customer service, supply chain, export, sales support or international business.Work tasksAs a Customer Service Specialist, you will be responsible for the smooth processing of customer orders and the progress of deliveries. In practice, your work begins once sales has agreed on the order with the customer. After that, you ensure that the order proceeds correctly in the systems, production, delivery and documentation.The role includes a lot of email communication with international customers, as well as internal communication with sales, production and logistics partners. Since the customers are international and the orders can vary significantly, the role requires a strong ability to understand the bigger picture, use common sense and solve situations case by case.- processing and managing customer orders from start to finish- monitoring and coordinating order deliveries- communicating with international customers, mainly by email- cooperating with the sales team, production, logistics and customer service team- preparing export documentation and shipping documents- handling invoicing-related tasks- using the ERP system and other internal systems- resolving questions related to deliveries, schedules and customer cases- solving different customer cases and order-related issuesWe are looking for you who hasWe are looking for a person who is interested in international customer service, order handling and supply chain coordination. You may be a recent graduate or at the beginning of your career, or you may already have previous experience in similar tasks.We hope you have:- fluent English skills, as customer communication is mainly in English- readiness to work mainly from the office in Porvoo- previous work experience in customer service, order handling, sales support, logistics, export, invoicing or supply chain-related tasks- ability to understand broader processes and move things forward in a structured way- a proactive and flexible working style- good problem-solving skills and practical thinking- ability to work in a busy and changing environment- good cooperation and communication skillsConsidered an advantage- Finnish language skills, as communication with production and local stakeholders may also take place in Finnish- experience with ERP systems- studies in business, logistics, international business or another relevant fieldTo succeed in this role, you are- proactive and hands-on- accurate and systematic- flexible and able to handle pressure- cooperative and open- curious and willing to learn- ready to ask questions, investigate and get things done- interested in an international working environmentYou do not need to know everything in advance. What matters more is that you want to learn, are willing to take initiative and can work in situations where all answers cannot be found from ready-made templates.Practical informationLocation: PorvooWorking hours: Full-timeEmployment type: Permanent employment through Academic WorkStart: As soon as possibleRemote work: Limited possibility for remote work after the onboarding period. The role requires a high level of presence at the Porvoo office, especially due to onboarding and close teamwork.We will proceed with suitable applicants as soon as they apply, so please submit your application as soon as possible.Our recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Ekonomi- och verksamhetscontroller
jobs.description: Som ekonomi- och verksamhetscontroller har du en bred och omväxlande roll där ekonomi, redovisning, fastighetsadministration och verksamhetsstöd möts. Du arbetar med den löpande ekonomihanteringen för våra olika enheter och delar ansvaret för redovisningen med övriga inom ekonomiavdelningen. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår bland annat leverantörs- och kundreskontra, fakturering, avstämningar, moms- och skattedeklarationer samt medverkan i kvartals- och årsbokslut och administration av våra bostadsaktiebolag.En viktig del av uppdraget är också att fungera som controller och administrativt stöd för organisationens verksamheter. I takt med verksamhetens utveckling kan tjänsten även komma att omfatta stöd till Folkhälsan på Ålands lokalföreningar. Du följer upp verksamheternas ekonomi, nyckeltal och resursanvändning samt tar fram analyser, rapporter och beslutsunderlag som stöd för planering och uppföljning. Du fungerar som ett stöd för chefer i ekonomiska och administrativa frågor och bidrar till att utveckla och effektivisera rutiner och arbetssätt.För att trivas i rollen behöver du vara strukturerad, noggrann och självgående. Du har god analytisk förmåga och tycker om att arbeta med både detaljer och helheter. Arbetet innebär många kontaktytor och varierande uppgifter, vilket förutsätter god samarbetsförmåga, flexibilitet och ett serviceinriktat arbetssätt.Vi söker dig som har en tradenom examen eller annan lämplig högskoleutbildning inom ekonomi samt erfarenhet av bokföring och redovisning. Du har god datorvana, är trygg i att arbeta med ekonomiska underlag och har intresse för verksamhetsuppföljning och utveckling. Vi fäster stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.Tjänsten är ett moderskapsvikariat på heltid, cirka 12 månader. Då organisationen är under utveckling och tjänstens ansvarsområde kan komma att utökas finns möjlighet till förlängning eller fortsatt anställning efter vikariatets slut.Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Intervjuer kan ske löpande under rekryteringsperioden.Folkhälsan är en rökfri arbetsplats.

jobs.title: Early Childhood Education Teacher (recruitment from abroad, permanent position in public sector daycare))
jobs.description: Hello, Early Childhood Education Teachers! Are you interested in working in a public daycare in Finland, known for its high-quality education system? We offer a permanent full-time position, competitive salary, great employee benefits, free Finnish language training, apartment, relocation support, and a clear pathway to living and working in Finland. Whether you are an experienced Early Childhood Education Teacher or newly qualified, we at the City of Helsinki would be delighted to hear from you!In Finland, ECE teachers are highly trusted professionals. You have significant autonomy in planning pedagogical activities and are encouraged to use your professional expertise in everyday work. You support the holistic development of children aged 0-6 in an inclusive, child-centred environment. You work in a multi-professional team, sharing responsibility for childrens wellbeing and learning.In Finland, ECE is part of the national education system and follows the Educare model, integrating care, education and teaching (read more from the Finnish National Agency for Education: https://www.oph.fi/en/education-system/early-childhood-education-and-care-finland). In practice, this means that: Every moment is pedagogical Play is the foundation of learning Learning happens throughout the whole day Nature and outdoor environments are used yearround Childrens interests and questions guide learningYour core responsibilities: Plan, implement and assess play-based learning activities Lead your groups pedagogical work together with childcare nurses Observe and document childrens learning and development Create and update individual learning plans in collaboration with families Collaborate with colleagues and multidisciplinary professionals Design inspiring learning environments indoors and outdoorsOur daycare units' opening hours range between 6:15-17:30, depending on families needs. As a full-time teacher you work 38.25 hours per week Monday-Friday.We are looking for professionals who connect well with others and are open to learning and professional growth. You value teamwork and recognise that high-quality pedagogy is built together. You will enjoy this role if you want to fully use your pedagogical expertise and appreciate professional trust and autonomy. You are an advocate of play-based learning and see learning opportunities in everyday moments. As a professional you are reflective, curious and resilient.Qualification and other requirements to start the Finnish language course in February 2027: Right to work in Finland, for example, on the basis of EU/EEA citizenship At least Bachelors degree in Early Childhood Education Your qualification gives you the right to work as an Early Childhood Education Teacher for children aged 0-6 years in the country where the degree was obtained. At least level B2 in English language Willingness and ability to commit to learning Finnish language prior to employment contract and relocation. The working language in our daycares is Finnish. During the language course we test your language skill development regularly. Requirements to enter into a permanent employment contract in January 2028: Reaching target level B1 in Finnish language Decision from the Finnish National Agency of Education demonstrating eligibility to work as an ECE teacher in Finland Criminal record extract from the Legal Register Centre Proof that you do not have respiratory tuberculosis We can only enter into a permanent employment contract with you if you meet all the above requirements.We provide comprehensive support to make your relocation to Finland as smooth as possible: Assistance with degree recognition process Remote Finnish language training (10 months, part-time, 4x90min lessons every week + 4-8h/wk independent study, homework and assignments) which you can complete alongside your current employment Pre-departure training also includes practical information about working and living in Finland Support in registrations with Finnish authorities upon arrival (also for relocating family members) Assistance in finding an apartment. As a City of Helsinki employee, you can rent a City-owned apartment and no rental deposit is required.Language training and relocation schedule: Feb'27-Dec'27: Finnish language training remotely. Attendance and active participation is essential. jobs.title: Experienced forklift driver for cold storage production
jobs.description:
Are you comfortable working at -20°C and have strong forklift skills?

We are currently looking for an experienced and reliable forklift driver to drive the forklift in a cold storage production, handling fresh and frozen poultry products.

You will be working in a storage facility with temperatures around -20°C, and it is important that you are comfortable working in a cold environment throughout your shift. We are looking for someone who thrives in these conditions and understands the importance of maintaining both safety and efficiency while working in cold temperatures.

The warehouse has narrow aisles and limited operating space, making forklift experience essential. Precision, awareness, and safe operation are critical to success in this role.

Your Responsibilities

  • Receiving fresh poultry products from production

  • Transporting fresh products into the freezer for freezing

  • Moving frozen products throughout the warehouse using a forklift

  • Preparing products for shipment and distribution

  • Handling shipping documents, labels, and product identification

  • Ensuring correct traceability and documentation

  • Maintaining order and cleanliness throughout the freezer warehouse

  • Assisting with daily warehouse and logistics operations

  • Following all food safety, quality, and safety procedures

We Are Looking For Someone Who

  • Holds a valid forklift certificate/license

  • Has solid forklift driving experience from warehouse, logistics, or production companies.

  • Is comfortable working in temperatures of approximately -20°C

  • Thrives in a cold working environment and can maintain a high level of performance throughout the day

  • Has experience operating forklifts in narrow aisles and confined spaces

  • Understands the importance of safe and accurate forklift operation

  • Works independently and takes responsibility for assigned tasks

  • Is structured, quality-conscious, and reliable

  • Has experience working with shipping documents, labels, and warehouse procedures

  • Takes pride in keeping the warehouse organized and efficient

Working Hours

  • Monday to Thursday: Start at 08:35 AM and work until all scheduled tasks are completed

  • Every 6th & 7th Friday: Start at 08:35 AM

  • 37 hours a week, overtime should be expected.

We Offer

  • A stable full-time position in a growing company

  • Long-term employment opportunities

  • A professional and supportive working environment

  • An important role within the warehouse and logistics operation

  • Salary based on qualifications and experience

  • Immediate start for the right candidate

Location: Horsens, orsensDenmarkStart Date: As soon as possibleEmployment Type: Full-TimeSalary: Based on qualifications and experience

Apply Today

If you are an experienced forklift driver who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and can thrive in a -20°C freezer, we would like to hear from you.

Apply today, remember to upload your CV. Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled as soon as we find the right candidate.

jobs.description:
Are you looking for a stable job within fish production and enjoy hands-on work in a fast-paced and professional production environment? Do you have experience from the fish or food industry and take pride in delivering high-quality work? If so, we would like to hear from you.

We are currently looking for reliable and motivated employees to join a well-established fish production company. This is an excellent opportunity to become part of an international workplace where teamwork, quality, and food safety are highly valued.

Your daily tasks may include:

  • Sorting, processing, and preparing fish products

  • Filleting, trimming, and cutting fish

  • Quality control and inspection of products

  • Weighing, packing, and labeling finished products

  • Cleaning and sanitizing production areas and equipment

  • Assisting with various other production-related tasks as needed

Working Hours

Full-time position, 37 hours per week. Overtime may occur during busy periods.

Day Shift: 06:55 - 15:09Morning Shift: 05:55 - 14:09

Please note that there is a 1-hour self-paid break each day.

We are looking for candidates who:

  • Speak and understand English

  • Are physically fit and comfortable performing standing and repetitive work

jobs.title: Servicekoordinator til telte.nu – med ansvar for kvalitet og bemanding
jobs.description:
Kan du skabe overblik, fordele opgaver og sikre, at kvaliteten er i orden? Og trives du med en hverdag, hvor du både koordinerer og selv tager fat? Så er du måske vores nye servicekoordinator hos telte.nu.

Vi søger en struktureret og engageret kollega, der kan tage ansvar for den daglige koordinering i vores serviceafdeling. Du bliver central i at sikre, at medarbejdere, materialer og opgaver hænger sammen, så vi leverer et godt resultat til kunden.

Dine opgaver

Du planlægger dagens arbejde, følger op på opgaverne og hjælper med at få det hele til at fungere i praksis. Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

  • Planlægning og bemanding: Du fordeler medarbejdere og opgaver, så de rette folk er på de rette pladser.

  • Kvalitetskontrol: Du kontrollerer pladser og teltopsætninger og følger op på, at arbejdet lever op til vores standarder.

  • Klargøring og materialer: Du sikrer, at rengøring og kontrol bliver udført grundigt, og at de rigtige materialer bliver leveret.

  • Løbende koordinering: Du tilpasser planen, når behovene ændrer sig, og sørger for, at teamet ved, hvad der skal ske.

  • Praktisk arbejde: Du giver en hånd med på tværs af telte.nu, når der er brug for det.

Hvem er du?

Du sætter en ære i, at udstyret er rent og kontrolleret, at bemandingen er på plads, og at opgaverne bliver fulgt til dørs.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket, også når der er travlt.

  • Kommunikerer tydeligt og kan sætte retning for dagens opgaver.

  • Har øje for detaljerne og følger op, når noget skal rettes.

  • Tager ansvar og finder løsninger sammen med dine kolleger.

  • Trives med at kombinere koordinering med praktiske opgaver.

Erfaring med koordinering, drift, logistik eller lignende opgaver er relevant. Vi vil også gerne høre, hvordan du har skabt overblik og sikret kvalitet i andre sammenhænge.

En vigtig rolle i hverdagen

Hos telte.nu får du en rolle tæt på både teamet og den daglige drift. Din indsats har direkte betydning for, at kollegerne kan løse deres opgaver, og at kunderne får en god oplevelse.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Send os din ansøgning og dit CV, og fortæl, hvorfor du vil være servicekoordinator hos telte.nu. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Er du den rolige nattevagt, der skaber nærvær og tryghed? Botilbuddet Vedstedvej søger en vågen nattevagt
jobs.description:
Er du den rolige nattevagt, der skaber nærvær og tryghed? Botilbuddet Vedstedvej søger en vågen nattevagtHyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland ApS

Er du den nattevagt, der kan bringe ro, tryghed og nærvær ind i natten? Brænder du for at skabe de bedste betingelser for trivsel, tryghed og udvikling for mennesker med socialpsykiatriske udfordringer?

Vi søger en vågen nattevagt til fastansættelse i 7-7 vagtrul til Botilbuddet Vedstedvej. Botilbuddet Vedstedvej er en del af Hyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland, og er et mindre socialpsykiatrisk botilbud, hvor der bor i alt 4 borgere.

Om stillingen:

Stillingen indebærer en helt særlig rolle, hvor du er med til at skabe ro, tryghed, stabilitet og nærvær for mennesker med socialpsykiatriske udfordringer, når mørket falder på. Borgerne kan til tider have et højt stressniveau, hvor de har behov for at blive rummet og støttet af et roligt nervesystem i en pædagogisk og professionel kontekst.

Du vil indgå i et fast team omkring det pædagogiske arbejde med borgerne. Alle medarbejdere indgår på lige fod i dagligdagen, og er en vigtig del af den faglige indsats, hvorfor samarbejde, sparring og fælles udvikling vægtes højt.

Vi lægger stor vægt på at skabe en god arbejdsplads, hvor alle føler sig velkomne og værdsatte. Vores kultur er præget af medmenneskelighed, samarbejde og engagement. Vi brænder for at arbejde med mennesker og tror på, at vores fælles indsats og samarbejde er nøglen til vores succes.

Hvem er du?

·       Du er uddannet pædagog eller socialrådgiver - eller anden relevant socialfaglig uddannelsesbaggrund på bachelorniveau.

·       Du er rolig, ansvarsbevidst og har hjertet på rette sted.

·       Du evner at være til stede, også i de stille stunder, og du forstår, at natten kan være et tidspunkt, hvor behovene er anderledes, men lige så vigtige.

·       Du ser mennesket bag diagnosen og ved, hvor stor betydning dét at “være der” kan have.

·       Du har kendskab til metoden LA2.

Vi tilbyder:

·       En spændende arbejdsplads med mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling.

·       Et dedikeret og tværfagligt team, hvor samarbejde og refleksion er i fokus.

·       Fast supervision og personalemøder samt gode muligheder for løbende kompetenceudvikling.

·       Temadage og kurser i vores faglige metoder og tilgange.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold:

Du ansættes i en fast stilling i et 7-7 vagtrul, hvor du arbejder 7 vagter efterfulgt af 7 fridage. Tiltrædelse snarest muligt, og samtaler afholdes løbende. Stillingen lønnes efter kvalifikationer og kompetencer.

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan indhentes ved henvendelse til tilbudsleder Mehrdad Zamani, tlf. 40 40 39 24 og mail mez@h-l.dk.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning og CV på mail mez@h-l.dk.

Om Hyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland

Hyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland er en del af Hyldgaard & Larsen, som samarbejder tæt med kommuner om fleksible sociale løsninger for nogle af landets mest udsatte borgere. Vi er specialiserede i vedholdende pædagogiske indsatser til mennesker med komplekse psykiske, adfærdsmæssige, sociale og sundhedsmæssige udfordringer. Vores tilgang bygger på ro, relationer, faglighed og respekt for det enkelte menneskes behov, ressourcer og livssituation.

Vi lægger stor vægt på at skabe en god arbejdsplads, hvor alle føler sig velkomne og værdsatte. Vores kultur er præget af medmenneskelighed, samarbejde og engagement. Vi brænder for at arbejde med mennesker og tror på, at vores fælles indsats og samarbejde er nøglen til vores succes.

Hvem er du?

·       Du er uddannet pædagog eller socialrådgiver - eller anden relevant socialfaglig uddannelsesbaggrund.

·       Du er rolig, ansvarsbevidst og har hjertet på rette sted.

·       Du evner at være til stede, også i de stille stunder, og du forstår, at natten kan være et tidspunkt, hvor behovene er anderledes, men lige så vigtige.

·       Du ser mennesket bag diagnosen og ved, hvor stor betydning dét at “være der” kan have.

·       Du har kendskab til metoden LA2.

Vi tilbyder:

·       En spændende arbejdsplads med mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling.

·       Et dedikeret og tværfagligt team, hvor samarbejde og refleksion er i fokus.

·       Fast supervision og personalemøder samt gode muligheder for løbende kompetenceudvikling.

·       Temadage og kurser i vores faglige metoder og tilgange.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold:

Du ansættes i en fast stilling i et 7-7 vagtrul, hvor du arbejder 7 vagter efterfulgt af 7 fridage. Tiltrædelse snarest muligt, og samtaler afholdes løbende. Stillingen lønnes efter kvalifikationer og kompetencer.

jobs.description: Vi lediganslår ett jobb som timlärare inom entreprenörskap, på deltid (47,5% av heltid), för tiden 1.1.2027 - 31.12.2027.Högskolan på Åland har under flera år byggt upp ett koncept som heter Business Lab som är en form av kuvösverksamhet för blivande och redan aktiva entreprenörer och företag. Högskolan vill nu driva Business Lab vidare med både egna och HÅs samarbetsuniversitets studerande och företag som målgrupper.Som lärare vid HÅ planerar, genomför och utvärderar du undervisningen tillsammans med övriga lärare och andra medarbetare. Du jobbar utgående från moderna högskolepedagogiska principer där ett handledande grepp i relation till de studerande är centralt och digitala lösningar är en del av vardagen. Inom universitetsalliansen EUNICoast kommer du även att verka i ett internationellt sammanhang.Du är bra på att samarbeta och är beredd att som en i ett team stödja i första hand studerande i deras studier men också samarbeta i lärarlag där lärarna stödjer varandra i arbetet. HÅ är en högskola i förändring och det är något du motiveras av. Vid Högskolan på Åland är det inte bara de studerande som ständigt får lära sig nytt utan också medarbetarna, därför behöver du brinna för att också själv utvecklas och förnyas. Som lärare rapporterar du till vicerektor. Vi erbjuder dig ett socialt arbete i en dynamisk arbetsmiljö med aktivt tempo i ett engagerat team.**Anställningen delfinansieras med externa medel via EUNICoast.**ARBETSUPPGIFTEREn central arbetsuppgift blir att vidareutveckla konceptet BusinessLab och dess moduler, samt att hålla kurser i entreprenörskap inom alla program på HÅ. Andra uppgifter är att skapa mikromeriter inom den Europeiska universitetsalliansen EUNICoast, som HÅ är en del av. Detta sker i samarbete med externa partners och du kommer att ha möjlighet att verka också internationellt. Att söka framtida finansiering för utveckling av BusinessLab är också en viktig del av arbetet. Aktiv marknadsföring och kommunikation av BusinessLabs verksamhet samt synlighet inom EUNICoast hör till jobbet, detta genom bl.a.sociala medier, deltagande i evenemang, nätverksmöte etc. Under Högskolan på Åland verkar Drivhuset Åland som är en del av Drivhuset Norden. Att inom ramen för Drivhuset Åland inspirera till innovation blir en del av din arbetsbild.Du bidrar till att skapa anställningsbarhet hos studerande som deltar i BusinessLab. Du arbetar också aktivt för att höja konkurrenskraften hos såväl åländska företag som för högskolans studerande som deltar i verksamheten.Arbetet innebär i någon mån resande, främst till våra kustnära partners inom EUNICoast.KOMPETENSER VI SÖKER- Erfarenhet av att driva kuvösverksamhet för den som är intresserad av entreprenörer och företag - Kompetens och erfarenhet av att handleda, stödja och coacha studerande - Förtrogenhet med utbildningsplanering och -design, distanspedagogik och nätbaserat lärande på högskolenivå - Erfarenhet av att söka projektfinansiering - Samarbetsförmåga och vilja att jobba i team, men också förmåga till självständigt arbete t.ex. när det gäller att utveckla regionala, nationella och internationella nätverk - Förändringsberedskap, flexibilitet samt kunskap om förändringsprocesser. Förmåga att engagera och entusiasmera - Förmåga att utveckla entreprenöriellt tänkande hos studeranden samt entreprenöriella förmågor hos företag. - Kommunikationskompetens och digital kompetens i vilken ingår förmåga att kontinuerligt informera om verksamheten i såväl sociala- som traditionella medier samt internt på högskolan. Även att skapa undervisningsmaterial på lärplattformen är en viktig del i jobbet. - Nätverka och representera Högskolan på Åland inom arbetslivet, utbildningssektorn och övriga samarbetspartners både på Åland och utanför Åland - Goda språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska. Övriga språkkunskaper är meriterande. BEHÖRIGHETSKRAVBehörighetskrav för tjänsten är vid universitet eller därmed jämförbar högskola, som är erkänd av nationell utbildningsmyndighet, avlagd lämplig högre högskoleexamen (EQF-nivå 7). Minst tre års praktisk erfarenhet i uppgifter som motsvarar examen samt yrkeslärarbehörighet eller beredskap att vid sidan av jobbet ta itu med behörighetsgivande studier.VI ERBJUDER DIGSom arbetsgivare är vår högsta prioritet att erbjuda en inspirerande arbetsmiljö där alla medarbetare trivs och mår bra. Vi erbjuder dig ett mångsidigt, socialt arbete i en dynamisk arbetsmiljö med aktivt tempo i ett engagerat team. Vid Högskolan på Åland har du möjlighet att utveckla din egen kompetens samt delta i utvecklandet av utbildningsprogrammen. Som anställd får du ta del av många fina förmåner såsom omfattande friskvårdsförmån (motion, kultur och massage), utökad företagshälsovård och lunchförmån. Som lärare vid högskolan har du 12 lediga veckor under året och möjlighet att själv välja tid och plats för ditt arbete under 28% av arbetstiden.LÖNEnligt Årsarbetstidsavtal för Högskolan på ÅlandARBETSTIDArbetstiden är 47,5% av en heltidsanställning som är 1600 h/läsår.

jobs.title: Are you passionate about crisis management, emergency preparedness and building organizational resilience in a global organization?
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and motivated Global Security Manager – Crisis Management to strengthen our global security and resilience capability.

In this role, your main responsibility will be crisis management and business continuity, you will work close with our team, and also be involved in a variety of security areas such as personnel security, physical security, information security and travel security. 

You will have a key responsibility for further developing our global approach to crisis management and emergency preparedness. You will work closely with management, security professionals, business units and functions across the organization to ensure that we are prepared to respond effectively when serious incidents occur.The position combines strategic development, governance and hands-on operational crisis management, and requires someone who is comfortable working both proactively and in situations where time, information and predictability may be limited.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain and continuously improve the company’s global Crisis Management framework, including governance, processes, plans and supporting tools.
  • Support and further develop the organization’s Emergency Response and Crisis Management structure globally.
  • Support the establishment and development of local and regional emergency response capabilities, crisis management exercises and training for management teams and relevant functions.
  • Contribute to the broader development of Business Continuity Management and organizational resilience.
  • Together with the Security team you will monitor relevant global developments and emerging risks that may affect our people and operations.
  • Participate in operational crisis response when required, as a important coordinating role in the global crisis management team.
  • Collaborate with the Travel Security Board team. 
We are continuously reviewing applications, apply today!At Kongsberg Maritime, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement. Your unique perspective is valuable to us. Your skills, attitude and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for! 

What we are looking for:

We believe you have solid experience within crisis management, emergency preparedness, security, resilience or related disciplines, combined with the ability to translate frameworks and requirements into practical solutions.Relevant experience may come from international industry, corporate security, emergency preparedness, defence, police, public authorities or consulting.We are particularly interested in candidates who have:

  • Experience with crisis management and emergency response in a complex organization.
  • Experience developing crisis management plans, frameworks and response structures.
  • Experience planning and facilitating exercises, training and scenario-based crisis management activities.
  • Experience supporting management during serious incidents or crises.
  • Strong understanding of crisis leadership, decision-making and coordination under pressure.
  • Ability to work across organizational, geographical and cultural boundaries.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Experience from an international organization with global operations will be considered an advantage.Knowledge of recognized standards and good practices within crisis management and business continuity, including ISO 22301 and ISO 27001, will also be beneficial. 

This employment may require a pre-employment check procedure in accordance with company security standards, role or site requirements. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment.This employment requires security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority. The successful candidate may start work with limited accesses whilst the clearance is being processed. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment. Personal qualitiesTo succeed in this role, you are structured and analytical, while also being pragmatic and operational when the situation requires it.You:
  • remain calm and focused in demanding situations;
  • are comfortable making progress when information is incomplete;
  • communicate clearly with both management and operational teams;
  • build trust and strong professional relationships;
  • take initiative and drive improvement;
  • are curious and continuously look for ways to strengthen preparedness;
  • understand that effective crisis management is ultimately about people, leadership, preparation and the ability to act.

You should also be comfortable working in an international environment and travelling when required.

Why join us?

Serious incidents rarely follow the plan. - Good crisis management therefore depends not only on having procedures in place, but on having an organization that is prepared, trained and capable of making good decisions when it matters most.As Global Security Manager – Crisis Management, you will have the opportunity to influence how a global organization prepares for and responds to critical events, working across countries, functions and management levels.You will be part of a professional security environment where preparedness, learning and continuous improvement are important elements in protecting our people, operations and business. 

 Work location:Any of Kongsberg Maritimes locations in Norway, though Kongsberg, Horten or Lysaker is preferred.We are flexible on working arrangements. Point of contact:Hanne Marit SchultzDirector Security & Crisis ManagementTel: +47 913 42 479 Link til søknadsskjema: Send application

jobs.title: Construction Labourer (Data Centre Project)
jobs.description: **Location:** Lohja, Finland**Position:** Construction Labourer**Industry:** Construction / Data Centres**Job Description**We are looking for experienced and reliable Construction Labourers to join our team on a large-scale data centre construction project in Finland.Our company maintains **very high standards of Occupational Health & Safety (OHS)**, and the safety and wellbeing of everyone on site is our top priority.The successful candidate must have previous experience working on data centre construction projects and demonstrate a strong understanding of site safety procedures.**Key Requirements**- **Previous experience working on data centre construction projects is essential.** - Previous experience as a Construction Labourer on large-scale construction projects. - A strong understanding of Occupational Health & Safety requirements and the ability to follow site safety procedures at all times. - **Good communication skills in English and/or Albanian are highly desirable**, as these are the main languages used on site, including during daily morning briefings and safety instructions. - Candidates must be able to fully understand and follow all health and safety instructions communicated on site. - Ability to work effectively as part of a multicultural team. - Reliable, punctual and committed to maintaining a safe working environment. **Health & Safety Requirements**Our company operates under strict Occupational Health & Safety standards.Daily safety briefings, toolbox talks and important site instructions are primarily delivered in English and Albanian.**It is essential that all employees fully understand the safety instructions provided.** We cannot compromise on health and safety or risk misunderstandings that could put employees or others on site in danger.**Key Responsibilities**- Carry out general construction labouring duties. - Assist skilled tradespeople and other site personnel. - Maintain clean, organised and safe working areas. - Follow all site rules, safety procedures and instructions. - Attend daily safety briefings and toolbox talks. - Report hazards, unsafe conditions and incidents immediately. **Employment Details**- **Employment Type:** Fixed-term contract - **Working time:** Full time (40 hours per week) - **Start Date:** 04.01.2027 - **End Date:** 19.07.2027 - **Salary:** In accordance with the applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) for the construction sector in Finland. **Application Process**Interested candidates should submit their CV and job application to Aleksandra Codrea **a.codrea@vkegroup.com**.**Interview Period:** 06.11.2026 – 23.11.2026Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

jobs.title: Kiinteistönhoitajaksi Kiinteistö Oy Kajaanin Pietarille
jobs.description: Kiinteistö Oy Kajaanin Pietari etsii aktiivisen työotteen ja palveluasenteen omaavaa, ammattitaitoista kiinteistönhoitajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Valittava henkilö tulee hoitamaan nimettyjen asuntokohteiden kiinteistönhoitajan tehtäviä. Tehtävän keskeinen sisältö alla:A. Palkkaus: Kiinteistöhoitajan mediaanipalkka on noin 2.500 euroa/kk (keskiarvo on palkkatilaston mukaan noin 2.785 euroa/kk). Palkka tarkentuu valittavan henkilön koulutuksen ja kokemuksen perusteella. Jos henkilö osallistuu päivystystehtäviin, maksetaan päivystämisestä erilliskorvaus TESin mukaisesti (varallaolo ja ylityöt).B. Noudatettava työehtosopimus: Kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimus, jossa palkka määräytyy tehtävän vaativuusluokan (PR-ryhmät 1–10) mukaan. Kajaanin Pietarilla työntekijöillä on ns. pitkät lomat, eli lomaa kuluu 5 arkipäivää/viikko (muutoin yksityissektorilla 5+1 päivää/viikko).C. Tehtävään vaadittava koulutus: Puhtaus- ja kiinteistöpalvelualan perustutkinto, jonka laajuus on 180 osaamispistettä ja kesto yleensä 2–3 vuotta. Tai vastaava koulutus.D. Osaamisvaateet: LVI-järjestelmien (lämmitys, vesi, ilmanvaihto) kunnossapito ja seuranta; huolto- ja korjaustyöt = rakennustekniset korjaukset, koneiden käyttö ja pienehköt kunnossapitotyöt; ulkoalueiden hoito: piha-alueiden puhtaanapito, käsilumityöt; asiakaspalvelu = asukkaiden ja kiinteistön käyttäjien opastus (edellyttää hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja); IT-taidot (toimisto-ohjelmien ja huoltokirjan (Tampuuri) käyttö.E. Ajokortti ja valmius oman auton käyttöön: Tehtävä sisältää työajoja Kajaanin kaupungin alueelle sijaitsevien asuntokohteiden välillä päivisin. Työajoista maksetaan kilometrikorvaus verottajan hyväksymien ohjeiden mukaisesti.Tästä paikasta on julkaistu RekryAreena-lähetys. Pääset katsomaan lähetyksen täältä:https://rekryareena.fi/kiinteistonhoitaja-kajaanin-pietarille/Yhtiö tarjoaa työntekijöilleen laajat työterveyspalvelut, virkistyssetelin (E-passi) 200 euroa (vuonna 2026), kouluttautumismahdollisuuksia soveltuvin osin sekä asianmukaiset työvaatteet. Kiinteistönhoitajalla on selkeät kohdevastuut. Teet työtä mukavien työkavereiden kanssa ja sinulle on esimiehenä nimetty kiinteistöhoidon työnjohtaja. Kiinteistö Oy Kajaanin Pietari on savuton työpaikka ja 1.10.2026 alkaen noudatamme tupakkalain 2026 määräyksiä kaikissa asuntokohteissamme.Tervetuloa mukaan tekemään tärkeätä työtä kohtuuhintaisen asumisen parissa Kajaanissa! Ryhdymme käymään läpi saapuneita hakemuksia heti! Kerro meille hakemuksessasi, miksi juuri sinä olet hakemamme henkilö ja mitä osaamista tarjoat meille.

jobs.title: Majstri (supervízori) v priemyselnej výrobe
jobs.description:
Hľadáme skúseného a technicky zdatného kolegu na pozíciu výrobný majster – zástupca vedúceho prevádzky, ktorý bude zodpovedný za organizáciu, riadenie a kontrolu výrobných a opravárenských činností v oblasti železničného opravárenstva.

Hľadáme človeka s prirodzenou autoritou, praktickými skúsenosťami zo strojárskej výroby alebo údržby, schopnosťou viesť tím a záujmom o zvyšovanie efektivity, kvality a produktivity práce. Dôležitá je schopnosť prepájať každodenné riadenie výroby s princípmi Lean managementu, 5S a neustáleho zlepšovania procesov.

Náplň práce:

    Organizovanie, koordinácia a kontrola každodenných výrobných a opravárenských činností.

    Riadenie a operatívne vedenie výrobných majstrov, prideľovanie úloh a kontrola ich plnenia.

    Zabezpečenie dodržiavania technologických postupov, pracovných inštrukcií, kvalitatívnych požiadaviek a termínov.

    Dohľad nad efektívnym využívaním pracovníkov, strojov, zariadení, materiálu a výrobných kapacít.

    Spolupráca s vedúcim prevádzky, technológmi, oddelením kvality, údržbou a logistikou.

    Operatívne riešenie výrobných problémov, prestojov, nezhôd a nedostatkov v pracovných postupoch.

    Aktívne zavádzanie a udržiavanie princípov Lean managementu, 5S a štandardizácie práce.

    Identifikácia plytvania, úzkych miest a príležitostí na zlepšenie výrobných procesov.

    Sledovanie produktivity, kvality, plnenia plánov a efektívnosti výroby.

    Dohľad nad dodržiavaním BOZP, požiarnej ochrany, poriadku na pracovisku a bezpečnej práce so strojmi a zariadeniami.

    Spoluúčasť na plánovaní kapacít, optimalizácii pracovných postupov a zlepšovaní organizácie pracovísk.

    Zastupovanie vedúceho prevádzky v čase jeho neprítomnosti a podpora pri riadení prevádzky.Výhody:ubytovanie, - práca v stabilnej spoločnosti s dlhoročnou tradíciou

jobs.title: Pánski a dámski krajčíri, kožušníci a klobučníci
jobs.description: Hľadáte prácu, kde sa vaša precíznosť premení na jedinečné módne kúsky? Pre úspešnú slovenskú módnu návrhárku hľadáme šikovnú a detailne orientovanú krajčírku, ktorá má vášeň pre módu a nebojí sa krajčírskeho remesla na najvyššej úrovni.Ak radi pracujete s kvalitnými materiálmi a chcete vidieť výsledky svojej práce na prehliadkových mólach či exkluzívnych klientoch, poďte pracovať do nášho ateliéru!Náplň práce: v čom budete vynikať?•    Kompletné šitie modelov (od spoločenských šiat až po limitované každodenné kolekcie) podľa návrhov a strihových predlôh.•    Práca s luxusnými a jemnými materiálmi (hodváb, čipka, vlna, satén).•    Úprava a dopasovanie modelov priamo na mieru zákazníčkam počas skúšok.•    Spolupráca s módnou návrhárkou pri realizácii nových nápadov a detailov.•    Ručné práce a precízne finálne úpravy (našívanie aplikácií, gombíkov, začisťovanie). Čo od vás očakávame?•    Vzdelanie alebo prax v odbore (vyučenie v odbore krajčír/ka alebo preukázateľné skúsenosti so šitím).•    Skúsenosť s prácou v módnom ateliéri alebo so zákazkovým šitím (veľkou výhodou).•    Znalosť technológie šitia a ovládanie priemyselných šijacích strojov (overlock,rovnosteh)•    Zmysel pre detail, presnosť a trpezlivosť – každý steh u nás musí byť dokonalý.•    Flexibilita a cit pre estetiku. Čo vám ponúkame?•    Inšpiratívne prostredie moderného a kreatívneho módneho ateliéru.•    Práca na jedinečných projektoch, žiadna stereotypná pásová výroba.•    Prístup k najnovším módnym trendom a exkluzívnym materiálom.•    Flexibilný pracovný čas (podľa dohody).•    Motivujúce finančné ohodnotenie závislé od vašich skúseností a kvality odvedenej práce.•    Zamestnanecká zľava na modely z našej dielne.Miesto výkonu práce: Rimavská SobotaDruh pracovného pomeru: TPP / Skrátený úväzokMzdové podmienky: Dohodou (v závislosti od skúseností)

požičiavanie a servis lyžiarskej výstroje a športových potrieb,

jobs.title: Inštruktori a cvičitelia športových rekreačných aktivít
jobs.description:
Predstavte si, že nastúpite do tímu 30 mladých ľudí a vašou najťažšou pracovnou úlohou bude... nájsť si medzi nimi nových kamarátov a kolegov. Cez deň budete v Ski school Strachan učiť ľudí prvé (alebo posledné pred pádom) oblúky na lyžiach či snowboarde, a večer, keď sa lekcie skončia, sa z vás aj z celého personálu Strachan Resortu stanú hviezdy parketu, teda skôr stola, v Medveďom brlohu.

Inštruktorom lyžovania alebo snowboardingu sa môžete stať aj bez skúseností, po kurze, na ktorý vám finančne prispejeme, pretože veríme, že najlepšia motivácia je zalyžovať si zadarmo na svahoch Ski centra Strachan aj Ski centra Strednica (a nie len teoreticky vedieť, kde je tá modrá zjazdovka). Máte radi voľnosť a flexibilitu? Do práce vás u nás nikto naháňať nebude, k nám sa chodí s nadšením, a to je presne to, čo na vás naši hostia uvidia už na prvom kruhu.

Zamestnanecké výhody a benefity:

práca v tíme mladých ľudí, s ktorými sa dá prežiť aj lyžovačka, aj afterpárty,

nádherné prostredie Belianskych Tatier, kancelária s výhľadom, o akom sa iným môže len snívať,

flexibilný pracovný čas, žiadne nútené vstávanie, len dobrovoľné,

mzda od 8 €/hod. v čistom

zľavy na služby v Strachan Resorte,

možnosť absolvovať inštruktorský kurz s dotáciou a zvýhodnením, takže sa naučíte lyžovať aj zarábať súčasne.

Ak vás táto predstava neodstrašuje, ale naopak láka, poznáte odpoveď. Prihláste sa k nám a staňte sa súčasťou tímu, ktorý cez deň učí a večer tancuje.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti reklamy a marketingu
jobs.description:
☎️ „Dobrý deň, máme problém.“

„Aký?“

„Technický.“

„A čo presne nefunguje?“

„No... ono.“

Výborne. Máme prvú stopu. 

Ak dokážeš z takéhoto rozhovoru dostať použiteľné informácie, možno máme prácu presne pre teba.

Prijímanie technických incidentov – „Môžete mi to stručne opísať?“ Nasleduje audiokniha.

Kontrola monitorovacích systémov – sleduješ, čo funguje, čo nefunguje a čo sa len veľmi presvedčivo tvári, že funguje.

Riešenie jednoduchších technických problémov – keď problém vyriešiš za minútu, zvyšných 59 nemusíš predstierať, že to bolo náročné.

Posúvanie zložitejších prípadov na vyššiu podporu – keď problém potrebuje väčšieho odborníka, pošleš ho ďalej. Nie však s popisom „nejde to, veľa šťastia“.

Komunikácia so zákazníkmi a technickými tímami – vieš zostať slušná/ý aj pri vete „Ale susedovi to funguje“.

Práca s Excelom a evidencia incidentov – keď ti Excel napíše #HODNOTA!, neodpovieš mu niečím, čo by HR muselo cenzurovať.

Sledovanie otvorených požiadaviek – nenecháš incident ležať v systéme tak dlho, až dostane nárok na dôchodok.

Dokumentovanie vyriešených problémov – aby sa rovnaká chyba nemusela vyšetrovať každý pondelok ako nový kriminálny prípad.

Výhody:Pracovný pomer bez dátumu spotreby – nie sme reality šou. Každý piatok nikoho nevyraďujeme.  Zmluva na dobu neurčitú 

Permanentka na dobrovoľné sebatrýznenie – fitko, bazén, sauna... Vyber si, kde sa budeš potiť a ešte za to poďakuješ.  MultiSport karta 

Decembrové úplatky za celoročné dobré správanie – darčeky dostaneš, aj keď si občas zanadávaš na pondelok.  Vianočné balíčky 

Keď je problém, nehráme schovávačku – kolegovia ti pomôžu. Nikto zázračne neodíde na obed na tri dni.  100 percent podpora zo strany firmy 

Kolektív bez povinného firemného úsmevu – môžeš byť normálny človek, nie nadšený komparzista z reklamy na jogurt.  Rodinná atmosféra 

Žiadna výroba zamestnancov cez kopirák – každý máme svoje muchy. Niektorí rovno celé safari.  Individuálny prístup

jobs.title: Onboarding Enablement Manager, APAC
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Onboarding Enablement Manager, APAC to play a key role in enhancing our sales productivity in our APAC region. This role will design, deliver, and continuously improve sales onboarding for our new hires. You will work closely with sales leadership, enablement, and product marketing to ensure our field salesforce is equipped with the skills, tools, and knowledge needed to achieve revenue targets and drive customer success.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Lead APAC Sales & Success onboarding by facilitating Notion’s Sales Bootcamp for new hires across the region

 - Own the APAC Onboarding Calendar end-to-end, ensuring a consistent, well-sequenced new-hire experience

 - Establish a clear communication cadence with APAC frontline leaders, setting expectations and ensuring visibility into each new hire’s onboarding plan and progress

 - Partner with APAC Sales Leadership, Enablement and Revenue Operations to iterate on and deliver high-impact live sessions with clear objectives and strong SME alignment that is aligned to the global program and tailored for regional nuances (Korea, Japan, and APACx)

 - Operationalize the pre-work, certifications, and continued learning path so assignments land at the right time and reinforce on-the-job performance

 - Measure onboarding effectiveness through qualitative inputs (e.g., surveys), and translate insights into clear recommendations and iteration plans

 - Create engaging, multimodal learning experiences (AI-assisted content, short-form video, podcasts, and activity-based materials) that help sellers succeed in their segment and reach their full potential with Notion

 - Embed and reinforce Notion’s culture, product value, and customer-first mindset across all field enablement programs

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 4+ years of SaaS sales experience
   
   - Including:
     
     - 2+ years full cycle selling

 - Demonstrate agency to lead enablement within team

 - Strong executive presence, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and stakeholder management abilities

 - Clear understanding of B2B sales cycles, strategies, and buyers—ideally product-led growth, sales-led growth journeys, and enterprise sales

 - Proficiency and ability to coach proven sales methodologies, including MEDDPICC, core sales competencies, and Command of the Message with practicality

 - Self-motivated problem solver who excels in ambiguous situations and takes complete ownership of projects

 - Creative thinker able to build engaging, outcome-focused content that drives behavioral change

 - Coaching mindset with high empathy for new hires and current sellers, driving effective change by challenging perspectives and focusing the team on value-based conversations

 - Proactive by nature, takes decisive action when identifying skill gaps or risks that could impact the success of enablement initiatives

 - Culture carrier, with a strong ability and desire to roll up their sleeves and make an impact in a high-growth environment

 - Fluency in Japanese and business-level in English

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Fluency in Korean
   
   #LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Quality Assurance Engineer

About Luxtrust

We are a multicultural and forward-thinking qualiﬁed Trust Services Provider based in Capellen, Luxembourg, with over 140 professionals and actively expanding our business internationally. As a Visionary Scout, we are constantly seeking out new opportunities for growth and innovation, always staying ahead of the curve in our industry.

Join us in our mission to drive innovation and co-create a better future!

We are currently looking for a motivated and driven Quality Assurance Engineer (m/f/x) under a permanent contract.

Summary

In the development of our projects, the Quality Assurance Engineer is the key person who ensures that the service produced is built following the requirements, with a high level of quality. That person is in charge of the quality of the product delivered to customers.
 
Missions of the role

Documentation:

-          Create QA documentation to describe processes
-          Update existing documentation or create new ones to document test findings

Agility:

-          Participate in Agile ceremonies
-          Understand and deliver on the product goals during sprints.
-          May lead Agile ceremonies

 Manual testing:

-          Create and documents manual test scenarios following specific guidelines
-          Continuously update manual test scenarios to ensure that all features are properly covered whenever a new use case arises
-          Ensure each feature is manually tested
-          Organize and execute testing activities on all environments.
-          Corner cases testing approach is expected for manual tests

Automatic testing:

-          Create automatic test scenarios following specific guidelines
-          Continuously update automatic test scenarios to ensure that all features are properly covered whenever a new use case arises
-          Develop test cases using guidelines (framework, languages…)
-          Corner cases testing approach is expected for automatic tests
-          Performance testing (stress tests…)
-          Security testing

Test strategy:

-          Contribute to the test strategy of the product
-          Design and develop:
o   Test plans
o   Test cases & Test data
o   Test execution
-          Maintain application coverage up to KPI standards.
-          Come up with new ideas regarding processes, tools etc. to improve the test strategy of the product

Test reporting & release process:

-          Provide reporting for all automatic tests, all manual tests, all non-regression tests performed on a new version
-          Perform smoke tests post release deployment
-          Provide Go/NoGo release status to the Tech Lead and Product Owner

Bug management:

-          Confirm bugs raised by third parties after thorough tests
-          Help define impacts of bugs with the help of stakeholders (BA, PO…) to classify the urgency of the fix

Product knowledge:

-          Complete knowledge of the solution is expected
-          Can deep-dive into the product and all features of the applications maintained by the affected functional team.

Team interaction & support:

-          Work closely with Customer Success team to confirm issues and provide quick support
-          Daily interaction with functional team (Product Owner, Developers, Business Analysts)
 
Required skills

Qualifications / diploma(s): bachelor's or master's degree in engineering or computer sciences or equivalent experience.

Experience:

-         Experience in Scrum methodology
-         Experience using JIRA / Confluence is an asset
-         Intermediate SQL level
-         Previous experience testing PKI/Banking/Mobile/Web applications
-         Experienced in QA with ISEB/ISTQB certification or similar experience
-         Experience in test design, risk management, defect management with a strong background in security
-         Solid knowledge of manual and automated software testing
-         Experience writing test documentation

Languages: French and English fluent. Any other language is an asset.

Technical / Specific skills:

-         Expected to be able to liaise with developers and assess their test automated scripts
-         Comfortable working in a fast paced Agile environment
-         Analytical mindset
-         Proactive and positive attitude with good Team-spirit
-         Good interpersonal relations and communications skills (written and oral)
-         Good time management and priority setting skills
-         Good at corner cases tests methodology
-          Ability to write or understand Bash, HTML/XML, SQL, JavaScript<>TypeScript, Java
-         Hands-on experience testing on the main software platforms: Web, Windows, Linux, iOS, OSX, Android
-         Familiarity with the following technical stacks used in our Quality Assurance processes: Selenium, Playwright, Postman, Rest Assured and BDD Framework /Page Object Framework
-         Corner case testing mindset
-         Automation expertise

Core competencies at LuxTrust:

-          Performance
-          Client service mindset

Our company is committed to fair recruitment, based on the skills of each candidate, regardless of gender nationality, sexual orientation, religion, or any other discriminatory criterion.
Please note that in order to comply with our regulatory requirements an extract of the criminal record is requested upon entry into service.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Infrastructure & Security Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT CIVILGRID

CivilGrid is the trusted civil design platform powering affordable infrastructure renewal and growth. We give utilities, civil engineers, and municipalities a single, collaborative source of truth for what's underground so teams can plan, design, and build faster, smarter, and safer.

Our platform consolidates utility records, geotechnical and environmental data, paving moratoriums, and jurisdictional requirements directly from 3,000+ utilities, agencies, and municipalities with full chain-of-custody documentation. Teams at PG&E, Mark Thomas, and dozens of leading engineering firms use CivilGrid to cut research time by up to 88%, reduce project costs, prevent dig-ins, and accelerate delivery on the projects that keep communities running.

We're a venture-backed Series A startup tackling a $4.7T US infrastructure market that has been underserved by software for decades. Founded by industry insiders, each with 10+ years in utilities and civil engineering, we move fast, ship work that matters, and stay close to the customers and field teams we build for.

WHY THIS ROLE

We're looking for a Security & Infrastructure Engineer to own our security posture and assist in supporting our cloud platform and reliability as we scale into large utilities and civil engineering firms. You'll take over and grow our security program, working across engineering, IT, and leadership. The role is on the Systems team that spans DevOps, SRE, and security. Your focus is security but you will contribute across the team.

This role reports to the Head of Engineering. It is a hybrid role with expectations that you are working from our Boston, MA office at least 3 days per week if hired.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Partner with engineering to embed reliability and security into the SDLC and infrastructure decisions

  • Run our security program: SOC 2 readiness and audits, vendor reviews, access controls, endpoint security, and threat modeling

  • Define and enforce policies for identity, secrets, data handling, and production access across the company

  • Lead incident response for both security events, and some reliability events, from detection through resolution and follow-up

  • Harden and monitor our GIS servers (Windows Server) alongside our AWS platform

  • Build and maintain our Trust Center, and lead security reviews with customers

  • Contribute to our AWS environment end to end: VPC architecture, ECS, RDS, secrets management, IAM, networking, and cost optimization

  • Contribute to improving reliability practices: SLOs, observability, alerting, on-call rotation, runbooks, and blameless post-incident reviews

  • The tech:

    • AWS ECS, Postgres on RDS managed with CDK

    • GitHub, Datadog, Slack, Notion, Drata

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • At least 5-8 years of experience across product security, platform security, or security engineering, with hands-on experience with DevOps or SRE of production AWS infrastructure

  • Experience running or supporting a SOC 2 program, including evidence collection, control design, and auditor coordination

  • Deep working knowledge of AWS (VPC, ECS, RDS, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or equivalent)

  • Experience running vulnerability management, from scanner findings and outside reports to fixes shipped

  • Track record of improving reliability in production: defining SLOs, building observability, running on-call, and leading post-incident reviews

  • Startup ready: autonomous, moves fast, takes initiative without being asked

  • Strong verbal and written communication, able to articulate ideas clearly and collaborate effectively

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience supporting B2B products sold into regulated industries (utilities, energy, public sector)

HOW WE WORK

We're a small, but rapidly growing team that ships. Expect direct feedback, real ownership from day one, and proximity to customers â huge utilities, public agencies, and engineering firms whose work depends on what we build. We default to in-person collaboration where it matters and remote-friendly flexibility otherwise. We hire people who care deeply about their craft and the communities our customers serve.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

The base salary range for this role is $137,318 - $192,960.

Base salary is only one part of your total compensation package at CivilGrid, which also includes meaningful early-stage equity, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity to shape a category-defining company. The base salary range listed above may encompass various levels and/or geographic locations; final offers are determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, level, and work location.

In addition to base and equity, we offer:

  • Company-funded medical, dental, and vision insurance â including medical plans at no cost to the employee

  • FSA (health and dependent care)

  • Unlimited PTO and a culture that expects you to actually use it

  • 401(k) plan

  • Flexible, remote-friendly work environment

  • A high-trust team, real ownership, and the chance to do the most meaningful work of your career

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

CivilGrid is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Employment decisions at CivilGrid are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact us â we're happy to help.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Growth
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s mission is to help everyone build beautiful tools for their life’s work. Notion's Growth Engineers make the everyone part of that happen with a combination of creativity and data to unlock business growth. This team accelerates the value Notion provides to an increasing audience of users. We are owners of the ins and outs of our business, using a blend of data, qualitative research, and product intuition to drive business growth.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build technical foundations that help the broader team and coding agents experiment, build and ship more.

 - Drive technical and product vision as an engineering leader within the org, building alignment with other eng teams and cross functionally, bringing clarity to the roadmap.

 - Deliver experiments end-to-end, from ideation to analysis, that balance the dimensions of product and the business appropriately.

 - Get to know the Notion customer to understand key points in the customer journey and uncover insights that will drive activation and engagement




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Finding the problems worth solving: You don't wait to be handed a roadmap. You dig into growth data, customer research, and the codebase to find the highest-leverage opportunities, then make the case for them and drive alignment on what to pursue.

 - Data and experimentation as a practice: You have Growth Engineering experience at another company, and you've built experimentation into how a team works: defining success criteria, running A/B tests, and turning results into decisions others follow.

 - Shipping polished user interfaces: You build fast, well-crafted web experiences with React and modern web technologies, and you know what it takes to keep them working as usage grows.

 - Building with AI: You build AI systems that keeps producing after you step away: coding agent workflows that can take on engineering work with the guardrails that let them run effectively. You know how to build systems for agents and treat the system as the deliverable, improving it continuously for accelerated impact.

 - Raising the bar for others: You mentor engineers of all tenures, guide them on and technical designs, and share your expertise so it scales past you. Multiple engineers have grown by working with you.

 - Pragmatism and impact-orientation: You care about business impact and prioritize projects accordingly. You're not just going after cool stuff, you understand the balance between craft, speed, and the bottom line.

 - Putting users first: You think critically about the implications of what you're building, and how it shapes real people's lives. You understand that reach comes with responsibility for our impact, good and bad.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - 10+ years of experience

 - A history of strong cross-functional collaboration with marketing, sales, and/or other non-technical teams

 - You've heard of computing pioneers like Ada Lovelace, Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, and others, and understand why we're big fans of their work.

The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work.
