jobs.title: Research Assistant in Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a fixed-term position as Research Assistant in Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design, is open for appointment from January 1, 2027, or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is 2 years.

Your work tasksYour work will include developing, training and evaluating machine-learning models based on circuit data, board geometries, simulation results and design images. You will develop surrogate models that approximate thermal and electromagnetic solvers, enabling faster evaluation of design alternatives. The position may also involve computer vision for recognizing circuit structures, component placements and printed circuit board geometries from photographs or other images. In addition, you will investigate graph-based methods for representing circuit relationships, evaluating design rules and generating or testing hypotheses for circuit designs. You will contribute to the development and verification of agentic workflows, where artificial intelligence systems combine models, tools and design rules to reason through and support electronics design tasks. You will prepare datasets, document computational workflows, validate model performance and share results with colleagues working in artificial intelligence, power electronics, semiconductors and software development.

The position is offered within the research field of Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design and contributes to AAU Energy’s focus areas of Digital Transformation and Artificial Intelligence, and Energy Efficiency in Components and Systems. The Research Assistant will be affiliated with the Section of Power Electronics System Integration and Materials.

Your competenciesYou have a relevant master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, electronics, artificial intelligence or a related field, and you are interested in working at the intersection of machine learning and power electronics design. You have a solid foundation in applied machine learning. Familiarity with electronic systems, including printed circuit boards, circuit topologies, components and the physical principles that influence electrical, thermal and electromagnetic performance, will help you engage with the engineering context of the role.

You have practical experience developing, training and evaluating machine-learning models, and you can translate complex engineering challenges into data-driven methods suited to a research environment. You are comfortable working with structured and unstructured engineering data, including circuit representations, board geometries, simulation data and images. Experience with computer vision, graph-based machine learning or graph neural networks will support your work with methods that interpret circuit layouts and geometries, reason about relationships between components, and generate or assess design hypotheses.

You are interested in developing surrogate models that approximate thermal and electromagnetic simulation tools while maintaining sufficient accuracy for use in electronics-design workflows. You work systematically with model validation, data quality and reproducible experiments, and you understand that artificial intelligence methods for engineering need to be technically robust as well as useful to domain specialists.

You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and dialogue, and you work well in a multidisciplinary environment where colleagues with expertise in artificial intelligence, power electronics and software development collaborate closely. You take responsibility for your tasks, ask constructive questions when assumptions need clarification, and contribute with curiosity and sound technical judgement to the development of new methods for intelligent electronic-system design.

Who we areAAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

jobs.title: Servicemedarbejder med ben i næsen og et smil på læben søges – fuldtid
jobs.description:
Har du ben i næsen og et smil på læben? Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Københavneren i Helsingør søger en ny kollega på fuldtid!

Er du udadvendt, ansvarsbevidst og god til mennesker? Kan du bevare overblikket, når der er travlt, og møde vores gæster med både humor, varme og et glimt i øjet?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

To verdener under samme tag

Københavneren er ikke helt som andre arbejdspladser.

Om dagen er vi en hyggelig restaurant, hvor vi serverer klassisk dansk smørrebrød og frokostretter til både danske og svenske gæster.

Om aftenen forvandles stedet til et traditionelt, livligt værtshus, hvor fællesskab, gode samtaler og en afslappet atmosfære er i centrum.

Det betyder, at du får en alsidig arbejdsdag med forskellige gæster, opgaver og tempo.

Vi søger derfor en person, der både kan levere god restaurantservice om dagen og trives med stemningen og gæsterne på et værtshus om aftenen.

Hvem er du?

Vi leder først og fremmest efter den rette personlighed!

Måske har du arbejdet i restaurant eller bar, men du kan lige så godt komme fra butik, salg, kundeservice eller en helt anden branche og have lyst til at prøve noget nyt.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har ben i næsen og tør tage ansvar

  • Er udadvendt, smilende og naturligt god til mennesker

  • Kan bevare roen og overblikket, også når der er travlt

  • Er mødestabil, pålidelig og ansvarsbevidst

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og træffe beslutninger

  • Kan sætte grænser på en venlig, men bestemt måde

  • Har humor og trives med mange forskellige typer mennesker

  • Er en god kollega, der bidrager til et positivt arbejdsmiljø

  • Er fleksibel og kan arbejde både dag, aften og weekend

Erfaring fra restaurationsbranchen er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Vi vægter personlighed, ansvarsfølelse og den rette indstilling højere end en bestemt uddannelse.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du bliver en del af både restaurant- og værtshusdriften, hvor dine opgaver blandt andet omfatter:

  • Tage godt imod gæsterne og sikre god service

  • Servering af mad og drikkevarer

  • Bararbejde og kassebetjening

  • Klargøring, åbning og lukning

  • Holde orden og sørge for, at stedet altid fremstår indbydende

  • Håndtere forskellige situationer professionelt og med godt humør

  • Bidrage til et godt samarbejde og en velfungerende hverdag

Du får naturligvis oplæring i vores arbejdsgange.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • En fuldtidsstilling med både dag-, aften- og weekendvagter

  • En alsidig arbejdsplads med både restaurant og værtshus

  • Et hyggeligt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø

  • Masser af forskellige mennesker og aldrig to helt ens dage

  • Mulighed for ansvar og indflydelse på hverdagen

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring

Har vi fanget din interesse?

Så send os en kort ansøgning og dit CV til:

Kobenhavneren@outlook.dk

Fortæl gerne lidt om dig selv, din tidligere erfaring, og hvorfor du har lyst til at arbejde hos os.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ønsker stillingen besat hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! ❤️

Københavneren ApSSct. Anna Gade 173000 Helsingør

jobs.title: RADNIK NA ODRŽAVANJU - ELEKTRIČAR(M/Ž)
jobs.description:
O NAMA

Bjelin Ogulin 2 d.o.o. dio je hrvatsko-švedske Bjelin grupacije, jednog od vodećih europskih proizvođača inovativnih drvenih podova. Usmjereni smo na visokotehnološku proizvodnju i razvoj održivih rješenja od drva, spajajući lokalnu stručnost s globalnim standardima kvalitete. Naš tim čine motivirani i stručni profesionalci različitih profila – od proizvodnih i tehničkih do inženjerskih i stručnih administrativnih funkcija – koje povezuje zajednička strast prema inovacijama, kvaliteti i kontinuiranom unapređenju procesa. Trenutno intenzivno ulažemo u izgradnju najsuvremenijeg pogona za proizvodnju podova u Ogulinu te širimo kapacitete kroz nove proizvodne linije za Woodura podne obloge. Paralelno s razvojem proizvodnje, sustavno jačamo organizaciju kroz razvoj tehničkih, logističkih, administrativnih i ostalih ključnih podržavajućih funkcija. U nadolazećem razdoblju fokusirani smo na zapošljavanje, edukaciju i osposobljavanje zaposlenika svih profila, s ciljem osiguravanja visoke razine kvalitete procesa, proizvoda i održivog rasta cijele organizacije.

TVOJI KLJUČNI ZADACI

  • Održavanje i popravak radnih linija, strojeva i pribora,

  • Remont postrojenja,

  • Vođenje brige o elektroopremi,

  • Obavljanje sitnih popravaka i čišćenja elektro dijelova uređaja,

  • Sudjelovanje u demontaži i montaži elektroopreme prilikom redovitih i interventnih servisa i pri otklanjanju kvarova,

  • Praćenje rada uređaja i strojeva, ukazivanje na trenutne probleme i sudjelovanje u otklanjanju istih,

  • Pregled elektroopreme prema uputama (svakodnevno, tjedno, mjesečno) te ažurira iste.

OČEKUJEMO

  • SSS tehničkog ili drugog odgovarajućeg usmjerenja

  • Interes za otkrivanjem i rješavanjem problema

  • Komunikativna ste i organizirana osoba

  • Orijentiran na detalje i pouzdan zaposlenik

  • Profesionalizam, želju za učenjem i uklapanjem u korporativni sustav

  • Spremnost na rad u smjenama

ŠTO NUDIMO

  • Poticajno radno okruženje

  • Redovita primanja

  • Mjesečni dodatak za prehranu

  • Djelomično pokriveni troškovi prijevoza

  • Mjesečna nagrada za radne rezultate

  • Ugovor o radu na neodređeno radno vrijeme uz probni rad od 6 mjeseci.

  • Početna plaća (tijekom probnog rada) 1.550€ BRUTO - mogućnost povećanja plaće ovisno o usvojenim znanjima, vještinama i samostalnosti u radu

  • Povećan broj dana godišnjeg odmora s obzirom na jubilarni staž i broj djece do 15 godina starosti

  • Božićnica, uskrsnica, regres, dar za djecu

  • Poklon bon za novorođenče

  • Jubilarne nagrade

  • Jasna mogućnost napredovanja kroz preuzimanje odgovornijih i kompleksnijih zadataka

  • Preuzimanje zanimljivih, izazovnih ali istovremeno zahtjevnih i odgovornih poslovnih zadataka

  • Mogućnost stjecanja novih znanja i osobnog razvoja

  • Sigurno i stabilno radno okruženja

  • Ravnotežu privatnog i poslovnog života

  • Mentorska podrška

  • Svježe voće za zaposlenike

  • Dva besplatna topla napitka dnevno po zaposleniku

  • Mogućnost punjenja električnih automobila (punionica na lokaciji)

  • Osigurana i profesionalno održavana radna odjeća (pranje i zamjena organizirani od strane poslodavca)

  • Bonus za preporuke (kada zaposlenik preporuči novog zaposlenika koji se zaposli)

POČETAK RADA I RADNO VRIJEME

  • Početak rada novih zaposlenika je 1. prosinca 2026.

  • Radi se u turnusima od 12 sati, od ponedjeljka do petka, uz rotaciju tri smjene.

MJESTO OBAVLJANJA POSLA

jobs.title: Product Support Specialist, Eastern/Central Time
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become an instrumental tool for many of the world’s best product teams. We believe customer support should always feel like an extension of that experience. As a Product Support Specialist at Linear, you’ll contribute to the future of our product by surfacing customer feedback and insights, contributing to our technical documentation, and engaging a technical customer community via social channels.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based within U.S. and Canada Eastern or Central Time. You can work from anywhere within those time zones. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Support customers in end-to-end engagement, including onboarding, account setup, debugging issues, feature and integration discovery

 - Investigate and resolve inbound customer issues reported through all communication channels, including email, Slack, Twitter, and Reddit

 - Partner with our engineering team to document and reproduce bugs

 - Surface trends and insights from customer feedback to the team at large to inform product choices

 - Lead select strategic projects to improve the support experience, internal knowledge sharing, and product operations

What we're looking for

 - Passion about technology, quality, and Linear’s mission

 - Excellent communication and customer service skills and experience working with a technical or engineering user base. Ability to adapt your communication approach to non-technical users.

 - Experience troubleshooting technical issues, including APIs and integration setups. Ability to reproduce bugs with Linear and our integrations in various environments (different browsers, Windows, Mac, Mobile).

 - Familiarity with SQL, Javascript, APIs, and GitHub is a plus. If you don’t have direct experience in these areas, curiosity to learn more is desirable as well. Please note that this is not a product engineering role.

 - Based in U.S. or Canada Eastern or Central Time only.

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Compensation

For US-based candidates, the expected cash compensation range for this role is $95,000—$135,000. For sales roles, this range represents on-target earnings (OTE), including base salary and variable compensation; for all other roles, it represents base salary. Final compensation is determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. For sales roles, actual earnings vary based on sales performance. Equity is a meaningful part of all offers at Linear.

Learn how we think and work

 - A story about our mission: Read Me https://linear.app/readme

 - Building our teams: Why and how we do work trials at Linear https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - How Linear uses Linear: How our Customer Experience team works in Linear https://linear.app/now/cx-in-linear

 - A video series: Conversations on Quality https://linear.app/quality

 - Our recent tender offer: Sharing Linear’s growth with the people building it https://linear.app/now/sharing-growth-with-the-people-building-linear

A note on recruitment fraud: all official Linear hiring communication comes from an @linear.app http://linear.app email address, and all open roles are listed at linear.app/careers http://linear.app/careers. We never ask candidates for payment or financial information. Suspicious messages can be reported to security@linear.app.

Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

jobs.title: Gestionnaire Middle-office référentiels données de marché (H/F)
jobs.description: Je recherche aujourd'hui pour un de mes clients, basé à Guyancourt, une ou un Gestionnaire Middle-office référentiels données de marché.Vous rejoignez l'équipe Middle Office Référentiel - Market Data Administration, qui a pour vocation de gérer l'ensemble des données de marché que ce soit pour les prix (données dynamiques) ou pour les descriptions des différents instruments financiers (données statiques) : actions, obligations, futures, options listées, warrants etc. Pour cela, le Middle Référentiel utilise les flux des différents providers : Reuters, Bloomberg.et procède à un certain nombre de contrôles afin de fiabiliser ces données avant de valider leur diffusion à l'ensemble des acteurs concernés dont notamment : les Front Offices, les Middle Offices opérationnels, la Direction des Risques ainsi que les Back Offices et la Comptabilité pour l'établissement des résultats comptables. Dans ce cadre, - vous gérez le référentiel de données de marché via son processus d'acquisition-contrôle-distribution ; - vous paramétrez et maintenez les instruments dans l'ensemble des systèmes d'information de la Banque ; - vous gérez les projets au travers d'une participation de Market Data Administration à tous les projets de la Banque ayant un impact sur les données de marché.De formation spécialisée en Banque/Finance/Gestion (à partir de Bac+5), vous possédez idéalement une première expérience (stage, intérim, apprentissage, CDD.) sur un poste similaire idéalement sur du Middle-office sur les instruments financiers, sur des données de marché ou plus globalement sur les activités de marché. Vous possédez une bonne connaissance des outils de bureautique usuels. Un bon niveau d'anglais est indispensable du fait de l'usage quotidien dans un contexte international. Vous êtes reconnu pour votre rigueur, votre capacité d'analyse, votre capacité à gérer des dead lines serrées du fait de l'interaction avec les Front-offices, votre force de travail et de proposition, votre indépendance, votre esprit d'équipe. Le poste est basé à Guyancourt (78) dans un campus verdoyant qui vous réserve bien des surprises. Cette mission d'intérim s'étale sur 6 mois potentiellement renouvelable. La rémunération brute annuelle fixe est comprise entre 40 et 45 K€ selon le profil. Un modèle de travail hybride est prévu, avec minimum 2 jours par semaine de télétravail après la validation du manager. Processus : Si votre profil correspond, nous échangerons par téléphone pour faire un point sur votre parcours et votre projet professionnel. Nous validerons ensemble si le poste correspond à vos critères de recherche et les attentes du client. Si tel est le cas, nous nous rencontrerons en entretien, puis un rendez-vous sera organisé avec votre futur responsable.

Dygtig og engageret sælger søges til Lilly Søndergade 70 Århus

 

Vi har fået rigtig travlt og søger, derfor en engageret sælger, der skal vejlede vores dejlige kunder i at vælge den rette kjole til deres store fest.

Så drives du af salg og god service, så se her.

 

 

Jobbet og opgaver:

Med reference til butikschefen vil din primære opgave være, at servicere og vejlede kunderne i det rette valg af brudekjole, konfirmationskjoler, festtøj og accessoires. Fokus vil være, at sikre den fortsatte vækst i butikken, uden at gå på kompromis med den gode og unikke kundeoplevelse.

 

 

Daglige arbejdsopgaver

©      Salg og rådgivning til alle kunder

©      Ansvar og indflydelse på butikkens daglige drift

©      Efterlevelse af salgs mål og fokus på mersalg

©      Optimal visuel præsentation af kollektioner

©      Planlægning og udførelse af aktiviteter/happenings i samarbejde med butikschefen

Du er en teamplayer med et positivt og smittende humør, og kan lide en uformel omgangstone med både kunder som kolleger.

Vi tilbyder en spændende og udfordrende stilling, hvor du med dit engagement og motivation er med til at skabe en sjov og god arbejdsdag.

Du tilbydes gode arbejdsforhold samt løn efter kvalifikationer.

jobs.title: Directeur ou Directrice d'hôtel-restaurant (H/F)
jobs.description: Notre hôtel-restaurant, qui propose également dix salles de séminaire, recherche son directeur ou sa directrice. En collaboration directe avec la propriétaire, vous participez au fonctionnement quotidien de l'établissement et à son développement commercial. Vous travaillez avec une équipe de 20 salariés répartis entre la cuisine, la salle, les étages, l'hébergement et la maintenance. Vos missions - Coordonner l'activité quotidienne : organiser les priorités et assurer la bonne circulation des informations entre les services pour garantir une prestation de qualité. - Accompagner les équipes : encadrer les collaborateurs en lien avec les responsables de service, organiser les plannings, adapter les moyens aux réservations et aux événements, contribuer au recrutement, à l'intégration, à la formation et à l'évaluation des collaborateurs. - Cultiver la relation clients : être régulièrement présent à leurs côtés, comprendre leurs attentes, traiter les demandes et les réclamations et participer aux actions de communication. - Orchestrer les séminaires et événements : coordonner leur préparation et leur déroulement, de la réservation à la prestation finale, en intégrant les salles, la restauration, l'hébergement et les besoins techniques. - Développer l'activité commerciale : répondre aux demandes, construire des propositions adaptées, relancer les devis et entretenir les relations avec les entreprises et les organisateurs. - Assister la propriétaire : suivre l'activité, faire remonter les difficultés et proposer des améliorations concrètes dans votre périmètre de responsabilité. - Mesurer la satisfaction et agir : produire chaque mois un bilan comprenant la note client mensuelle, son évolution, les principaux retours et les points à améliorer. Proposer des actions concrètes et suivre leur réalisation avec les équipes. - . Coordonner leur réalisation avec les services concernés, contrôler les stocks et le matériel, analyser les écarts et anticiper les besoins de réapprovisionnement. - Donner à la propriétaire une vision claire de l'activité : organiser et suivre les inventaires, contrôler les stocks et le matériel, analyser les écarts, présenter un reporting régulier sur l'activité commerciale, la satisfaction, les inventaires et les difficultés opérationnelles, accompagné de propositions et du suivi des actions engagées. Vous aimez les gens et les échanges directs. Le contact avec les clients occupe une place centrale dans ce poste : vous prenez plaisir à accueillir, conseiller, trouver une solution et entretenir une relation dans la durée. Très organisé, vous savez anticiper, planifier et gérer plusieurs demandes simultanément. Vous restez disponible et réactif lorsque le programme change ou qu'un imprévu survient. Vous avez un véritable sens du commerce : vous écoutez les besoins, repérez les opportunités et proposez les prestations adaptées, avec le souci de la satisfaction et de la fidélisation. Vous savez fédérer des équipes aux métiers différents, donner des consignes claires et suivre leur réalisation. Votre expérience vous permet de comprendre les contraintes de l'hébergement, de la restauration et de l'accueil de groupes. Un diplôme en hôtellerie-restauration est souhaité ou une expérience pertinente et confirmée, avec des responsabilités démontrées en organisation, management et relation client. Un niveau B1 en anglais est demandé pour les échanges courants avec notre clientèle internationale.

jobs.title: CHAUFFØR søges til jordnær virksomhed
jobs.description:
CHAUFFØR søges til jordnær virksomhed

Sydsjællands Entreprenør ApS beskæftiger sig med arbejdsopgaver inden for jordarbejde, kloakarbejde, betonarbejde og belægningsarbejde.

Vi er en blanding af strukturer, rørlæggere, maskinfører og håndfolk.

Her bliver du en del af et hold, hvor den gode tone og dårlige humor ikke til at tage fejl af, men vi opfører os altid ordentlig overfor hinanden og løfter arbejdsopgaverne i flok.

Opgaverne foregår primært på Sjælland, Lolland og Falster. Der er tale om en fastansættelse med opstart hurtigst muligt.

Vi søger en dygtig chauffør, med erhvervserfaring indenfor entreprenørbranchen til kørsel med vores 4-akslet MAN lastbil med kærre og blokvogn.

Opgaver:

Arbejdet som chauffør, består i blandet kørsel inden for entreprenør- og anlægsarbejde, med bl.a. kørsel af jord, sand, grus og materialer og transport af vores maskiner. Man skal selv kunne køre og betjene diverse entreprenørmaskiner så man selv kan på og aflæsse lastbil.

 

Faglige kvalifikationer:

  • Har CE kørekort samt EU-førerbevis

  • Har takografkort

  • Har krancertifikat,

  • Kan forstå og tale dansk

 

Personlige kvalifikationer

  • Er positiv, imødekommende og serviceminded

  • Er struktureret, omhyggelig og har overblik

  • Du er kvalitetsbevidst og tager ansvar

  • Du er mødestabil

  • Er indstillet på idé- og løsningsgenerering i tæt samarbejde med kollegaer, samarbejdspartnere, leverandører og kunder

 

Vi tilbyder

Som medarbejder hos Sydsjællands Entreprenør ApS får du:

  • Frihed under ansvar

  • Godt arbejdsmiljø

  • En lønpakke, som afspejler dine kvalifikationer – vi har naturligvis overenskomst, pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring.

 

Kan du genkende dig selv i profilen? Så er det måske dig vi står og søger! Vores forventninger er et godt og stabilt samarbejde, hvor du vil finde dig godt til rette.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler, da vi ønsker at byde dig velkommen på holdet hurtigst muligt. For spørgsmål kan du Ole Sørensen på tlf. eller mail +45 23 83 00 49/kontor@ssef.dk.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer, High Voltage (GIS); Location: DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Are you a seasoned HV engineer with extensive GIS expertise? Do you understand what it takes to specify the right GIS solution and navigate the trade-offs between performance, reliability, cost, footprint and delivery schedules? Can you translate customer requirements into practical, value-driven solutions? Then join our team and help shape the projects that are driving the global transition towards renewable energy!Your position In your new position, you will be a key contributor to our major tender projects, collaborating closely with a team of experienced engineers to translate customer requirements into robust and scalable offerings. Drawing on your expertise in high-voltage GIS solutions, you will help shape technical decisions, collaborate with strategic suppliers, and strengthen our value proposition.Beyond tender activities, you will contribute to the continuous development of our HV competencies, product portfolio, and ways of working, helping strengthen our technical foundation for future growth.You will join our Product Line Management (PLM) Solution Engineering team, a multidisciplinary group collaborating with customers, suppliers and colleagues across the organization.As part of PLM, you will contribute to our ambition of making offshore substations more modular, standardized, and repeatable.You will help define not only the solutions we deliver today, but also the solutions we bring to market tomorrow.Building on our strong offshore substation capabilities, we are also exploring opportunities within onshore substations. Experience with onshore transmission systems, including EHV GIS/AIS, grid transformers, reactive compensation, harmonic filtering or grid connection equipment, will therefore be considered an advantage and may provide opportunities to contribute beyond our offshore portfolio.Working in an international and collaborative environment, you will help transform proven engineering concepts into repeatable products that support the continued growth of renewable energy worldwide.The position is full-time and includes approximately 10-30 travel days per year. We place a high value on flexibility, and most travel can be planned to align with both business requirements and personal preferences."We have built a leading position within offshore substations, and PLM plays a key role in ensuring that we maintain and strengthen that position. By developing scalable solutions, standardizing our products, and challenging established ways of working, we make sure that we are ready to meet the demands of both today’s and tomorrow’s energy markets. We currently support projects across Europe, the UK, North America, and Asia, but our ambition is simple: to be ready wherever the next opportunity emerges."– Jannick Elmbæk Olsen, Director, Product Line ManagementYour tasks & responsibilitiesAs our new Senior High Voltage Engineer, you will play a key role in the development, positioning, and continuous improvement of the products and solutions offered within our offshore substation product line. Working closely with customers, suppliers, procurement, and our project execution teams, you will help shape solutions that remain competitive, scalable, and aligned with future market demands.Your tasks will include:
  • Support tender activities by defining and evaluating 66 kV and 230/275 kV GIS solutions.
  • Translate customer needs, market trends, and supplier capabilities into competitive product offerings.
  • Optimize solutions with respect to performance, reliability, footprint, cost, and lead time.
  • Develop and maintain the GIS product roadmap in line with future market requirements and emerging technologies.
  • Collaborate with Procurement and strategic suppliers to strengthen competitiveness and drive cost optimization.
  • Contribute to the standardization and modularization of our GIS product portfolio.
  • Ensure a seamless handover of as-sold solutions to our EPC engineering teams.
Your profile & qualifications To succeed in this role, you are an experienced High Voltage Engineer with extensive GIS expertise and a passion for developing competitive solutions for the renewable energy industry.We imagine that you:
  • Hold a degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Have extensive experience with medium- and high-voltage GIS systems, including 66 kV array systems and 230/275 kV transmission-level applications, from offshore wind, utilities, transmission, manufacturing, or EPC projects.
  • Experience with offshore GIS applications, technology qualification, or emerging SF6-free switchgear technologies is considered an advantage.
  • Understand the technical and commercial drivers behind GIS selection, including performance, cost, footprint, weight, and lead time.
  • Are comfortable working with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to balance technical and commercial requirements.
  • Have a strategic mindset and enjoy translating market needs into scalable product offerings.
  • Communicate clearly in English and can translate complex technical topics into sound business decisions.
  • Thrive in a collaborative and international environment and enjoy working across disciplines and cultures.
  • If you also bring experience or exposure to onshore substations, grid connections, or related high-voltage systems, we would be interested to hear about it.
Welcome to Semco Maritime At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   Care to join the movement? Change. With us. Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Pladsmedarbejder søges til Bileksport Danmark i Ringsted
jobs.description:
Pladsmedarbejder søges til Bileksport Danmark i Ringsted

Er du arbejdsom, praktisk anlagt og en holdspiller med godt humør? Og er du ikke bange for at få beskidte fingre? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Bileksport Danmark ApS søger en ny kollega til vores logistikteam på Huginsvej 6 i Ringsted.

Vi er en international virksomhed, der eksporterer omkring 100 biler om måneden. Der er fart på i hverdagen, og vi har brug for en kollega, der kan tage fat, holde overblikket og være med til at få den daglige drift til at fungere.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du bliver en vigtig del af den daglige drift på vores bilplads. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

•

Modtagelse og registrering af indkommende biler

•

Flytning og organisering af biler på pladsen

•

Håndtering af bilnøgler og registreringsattester

•

Klargøring af biler til afhentning og eksport

•

Støvsugning, lettere rengøring og praktisk klargøring af biler

•

Udfyldelse af CRM-dokumenter og lettere administrative opgaver

•

Andre praktiske opgaver, der får hverdagen til at glide

Det er en aktiv og alsidig stilling, hvor du både kommer til at bruge hænderne og hovedet. Du skal derfor trives med fysisk arbejde og være klar til at tage fat på både store og små opgaver.

Hvem er du?

Vi går mere op i din indstilling end i din uddannelse og erfaring.

Det vigtigste for os er, at du:

•

Har en stærk arbejdsmoral. Du møder til tiden, tager ansvar og gør dig umage.

•

Er en holdspiller. Du hjælper dine kollegaer og bidrager til, at vi lykkes sammen.

•

Har godt humør. Du bidrager med positiv energi, også når der er travlt.

•

Arbejder struktureret og fokuseret. Du kan holde styr på detaljerne og bevare overblikket.

•

Er praktisk anlagt. Du tager fat og er ikke for fin til at støvsuge en bil eller få beskidte fingre.

•

Har gode engelskkundskaber. Du kan kommunikere på engelsk og både tale og forstå sproget på et godt niveau.

•

Har almindelige IT-færdigheder. Du er vant til at arbejde på computer og har erfaring med eksempelvis Outlook og Excel.

•

Har almindeligt kørekort, kategori B.

Du behøver ikke have erfaring fra bilbranchen. Det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling og lyst til at lære.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Hos Bileksport Danmark får du en arbejdsplads med højt tempo, korte beslutningsveje og masser af personlighed.

Vi er et internationalt team med forskellige nationaliteter og baggrunde. Engelsk er en naturlig del af hverdagen og bliver blandt andet talt omkring frokostbordet.

Vi arbejder hårdt, men vi har det også sjovt.

Der er plads til humor, en uformel omgangstone og til at være den, man er. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes af mennesker, der tager deres arbejde seriøst, uden nødvendigvis at tage sig selv alt for højtideligt.

Hos os får du:

•

En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen

•

En aktiv og varieret arbejdsdag

•

Et internationalt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø

•

Gode kollegaer og et stærkt fællesskab

•

Frihed under ansvar

•

En arbejdsplads, hvor din indsats gør en reel forskel

Praktisk information

Stilling: Pladsmedarbejder, fuldtid Arbejdstid: 37 timer om ugen Arbejdssted: Huginsvej 6, 4100 Ringsted Virksomhed: Bileksport Danmark ApS Kørekort: Kategori B er et krav Sprog: Gode mundtlige engelskkundskaber er et krav. Dansk er ikke nødvendigt

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til Kasper@bileksportdanmark.dk.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Bileksport Danmark ApS

Arbetsdagarna är varierande och tempot kan tidvis vara högt, men det är också det som gör arbetet intressant.Vad innebär arbetet?Som personalkonsult är du en viktig kontaktperson för våra kundföretag, arbetssökande och uthyrda medarbetare. Du ansvarar för rekryteringsprocesser och ser till att våra medarbetare får det stöd de behöver under sin anställning.Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat:- Planering och genomförande av rekryteringar från början till slut.- Utformning och publicering av platsannonser samt hantering och bedömning av ansökningar.- Intervjuer och löpande kontakt med arbetssökande.- Aktiv kontakt med våra kundföretag, uppföljning av deras personalbehov och utveckling av kundrelationerna.- Löpande kontakt och stöd till våra uthyrda medarbetare via telefon, e-post och personliga möten.- Hantering av personalrelaterade ärenden under hela anställningens livscykel.- Identifiering av nya kundbehov och samarbetsmöjligheter.Arbetet innebär många kontakter och varierande situationer. Därför är det viktigt att du kan organisera din arbetsdag, prioritera mellan olika uppgifter och ta initiativ när det behövs.Du arbetar självständigt med dina ansvarsområden, men har alltid stöd av dina kollegor och Baronas övriga experter.Vem söker vi?Vi söker dig som trivs med att arbeta med människor och har ett genuint intresse för rekrytering, personalfrågor och kundrelationer.Du har lätt för att skapa kontakt med olika människor och förstår vikten av god service och tydlig kommunikation. Du är ansvarstagande, noggrann och har förmågan att hålla ordning på flera uppgifter samtidigt.Vi uppskattar att du är initiativrik, flexibel och har en praktisk inställning till problemlösning. Vi värdesätter också din vilja att lära dig nytt och utvecklas i rollen.För att lyckas i rollen önskar vi att du har:- Förmåga att kommunicera obehindrat på både svenska och finska, i tal och skrift.- God kommunikationsförmåga och lätt för att samarbeta med olika människor.- Ett strukturerat arbetssätt och förmåga att arbeta självständigt.- Goda digitala färdigheter och lätt för att lära dig nya system.- Förmåga att prioritera och hantera flera uppgifter samtidigt.- Ett intresse för rekrytering, HR och kundarbete.Tidigare erfarenhet av rekrytering, HR, personalservice eller kundarbete är meriterande. Även erfarenhet från industrin eller kännedom om det österbottniska näringslivet ser vi som en fördel.Eftersom vi arbetar med människor med olika språklig och kulturell bakgrund är kunskaper i engelska också värdefulla.För oss är din inställning, samarbetsförmåga och vilja att utvecklas minst lika viktiga som din tidigare erfarenhet.Vad erbjuder vi dig?Hos Barona får du ett varierande arbete med möjlighet att utvecklas och påverka hur arbetet görs. Du får arbeta nära både människor och företag och vara en del av ett team där vi värdesätter samarbete, ansvar och en god arbetsgemenskap.Vi erbjuder dig:- Ett mångsidigt och ansvarsfullt arbete med varierande arbetsuppgifter.- Ett engagerat och hjälpsamt team där vi stöttar varandra.- En introduktion till arbetet och stöd från erfarna kollegor.- Möjlighet att utveckla både din egen kompetens och våra arbetssätt.- Frihet och ansvar i det dagliga arbetet.- Flexibla arbetstider, med arbetet huvudsakligen förlagt till dagtid.- En månadslön på 2 500-3 000 euro, beroende på din erfarenhet och kompetens.Din huvudsakliga arbetsplats är Baronas kontor på Rostensgatan 1, 65100 Vasa.Barona som arbetsgivareBarona är ett finländskt arbetslivsföretag som hjälper människor och företag att hitta nya möjligheter i arbetslivet. Vi erbjuder tjänster inom bland annat rekrytering, personalservice och utveckling av arbetslivet.Hos oss får du möjligheten att arbeta i ett stort företag med bred kompetens och många olika verksamhetsområden, samtidigt som du blir en del av ett lokalt team med nära samarbete.Vår arbetskultur bygger på frihet, ansvar, mod och att göra saker tillsammans. Vi tror på att ge människor förtroende, uppmuntra till utveckling och hjälpa varandra att lyckas.Vill du bli vår nya kollega?Låter det här som ett arbete som skulle passa dig? Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!Skicka in din ansökan via vårt ansökningsformulär och berätta gärna lite om dig själv och varför du är intresserad av tjänsten.Vi behandlar ansökningar och träffar kandidater redan under ansökningstiden, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.Observera att vi av datasäkerhetsskäl endast behandlar ansökningar som skickas via ansökningsformuläret, inte per e-post.Mer information om tjänsten:Kristoffer WörlundOmrådeschef och ansvarig för rekryteringen0505200200

jobs.title: Kvalitetssikringsmedarbejder søges til Firesafe Danmark A/S
jobs.description:
Kvalitetssikringsmedarbejder søges til Firesafe Danmark A/S

Har du øje for kvalitet, teknisk forståelse og lyst til at arbejde tæt på byggeprocessen?

Hos Firesafe Danmark A/S søger vi to kvalitetssikringsmedarbejdere til at styrke vores kvalitetssikring inden for passiv brandsikring og isolering. Vi søger strukturerede og kvalitetsbevidste medarbejdere med teknisk forståelse.

Du får en varieret hverdag, hvor du kombinerer praktiske kvalitetstilsyn på byggepladsen med teknisk opfølgning og dokumentation. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med montører, projektledere og øvrige kolleger.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

·         Udføre løbende kvalitetstilsyn og kontrol af passiv brandsikring og isoleringsarbejde.

·         Kontrollere, at arbejdet udføres i overensstemmelse med tekniske tegninger, montagevejledninger og gældende krav.

·         Identificere kvalitetsafvigelser og følge op på nødvendige udbedringer.

·         Udarbejde og vedligeholde kvalitetsdokumentation samt registrere og følge op på opgaver i Dalux og BIM.

·         Vejlede montører i korrekte arbejdsmetoder og tekniske løsninger, herunder demonstrere korrekt udførelse.

·         Samarbejde med ledelsen om tekniske afklaringer, koordinering og kvalitetsopfølgning.

Vi forventer, at du:

•         Har teknisk forståelse og interesse for kvalitetssikring.

•         Kan læse og forstå bygningstegninger og teknisk dokumentation.

•         Arbejder selvstændigt, systematisk og følger dine opgaver til dørs.

•         Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk, både mundtligt og skriftligt.

•         Er fortrolig med digitale værktøjer og har lyst til at arbejde med kvalitetsdokumentation.

•         Kan vejlede montører og følge op på kvaliteten af det udførte arbejde.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har:

•         Erfaring med kvalitetssikring og kontrol i byggebranchen.

•         Kendskab til passiv brandsikring, isolering eller lignende teknisk arbejde.

•         Erfaring med Dalux og BIM.

•         Gode danskkundskaber og kendskab til flere sprog.

Der stilles ikke krav om en bestemt uddannelse, dog er det en fordele hvis man har en teknisk baggrund. 

Vi tilbyder

•         Fast fuldtidsstilling på minimum 37 timer om ugen.

•         Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

•         Løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring samt pension og øvrige vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

•         Firmatelefon, computer og andet relevant udstyr i forbindelse med arbejdet.

•         En varieret arbejdsdag med både praktiske og administrative opgaver.

•         Et arbejdsmiljø med gode kolleger og mulighed for faglig udvikling.

Om Firesafe Danmark A/S

Firesafe Danmark A/S arbejder med passiv brandsikring og relaterede tekniske ydelser på byggeprojekter. Vi bidrager til at beskytte mennesker, bygninger og værdier gennem korrekt udførelse og dokumentation af brandtekniske løsninger.

Hos os bliver du en del af en organisation, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og ansvarlighed er i fokus.

Ansøgning

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig?

Send dit CV og en kort beskrivelse af din motivation for at søge jobbet til info@firesafe.dk

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Søren Christiansen soeren.christiansen@firesafe.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 

  

Quality Assurance Employee Wanted at Firesafe Danmark A/S

Do you have an eye for detail, a strong technical understanding, and a passion for ensuring high quality workmanship on construction sites?

Firesafe Danmark A/S is looking to recruit two Quality Assurance Employees to strengthen our quality assurance team within passive fire protection and insulation works.

In this role, you will combine on-site quality inspections with technical follow-up and documentation. You will work closely with installers, project managers, and other members of the project team to ensure that installations meet the required quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

•         Conduct regular QA/QC inspections of passive fire protection and insulation works on-site.

•         Verify that installations comply with approved drawings, installation instructions, project specifications, and applicable requirements.

•         Identify non-conformities and follow up on corrective actions to ensure proper close-out.

•         Prepare and maintain quality documentation, inspection records, and reports, including the registration and follow-up of quality-related issues in Dalux and BIM models.

•         Provide technical guidance to installers on approved installation methods and demonstrate correct workmanship when required.

•         Coordinate with the project team regarding technical clarifications, site activities, and quality-related matters.

About You

We are looking for a responsible, structured, and solution-oriented individual with strong attention to detail. You are comfortable working both on construction sites and in a site office, and you can communicate effectively with different trades and project stakeholders.

We expect you to:

•         Have a good technical understanding and a strong interest in quality assurance and quality control.

•         Be able to read and interpret construction drawings and technical documentation.

•         Work independently, systematically, and take ownership of your tasks.

•         Communicate effectively in English or Danish, both verbally and in writing.

•         Be comfortable using digital tools for inspections and quality documentation.

•         Be confident in guiding installers and following up on the quality of completed work.

 

It would be an advantage if you have:

•         Previous experience in QA/QC, quality inspections, or construction site supervision.

•         Knowledge of passive fire protection, insulation, or similar construction activities.

•         Experience working with Dalux and BIM.

•         Hands-on construction site experience, including providing technical guidance to installers.

•         Good Danish language skills and knowledge of additional languages.

A specific educational background is not required. We value relevant practical experience, technical understanding, and the right attitude.

What We Offer

•         A permanent, full-time position with a minimum of 37 working hours per week.

•         Start date as soon as possible or by agreement.

•         Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience, including pension and other employment benefits in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and employment contract.

•         Company phone and the possibility of a company vehicle, depending on project requirements.

•         A varied workday combining on-site inspections with office-based QA/QC activities.

•         A supportive and informal working environment with opportunities for professional development.

About Firesafe Danmark A/S

Firesafe Danmark A/S specialises in passive fire protection and related technical services within the construction industry.

Our work contributes to protecting people, buildings, and assets by ensuring that fire protection systems are correctly installed, inspected, and documented in accordance with project specifications and applicable requirements.

You will become part of a team where quality, teamwork, and accountability are at the core of our daily operations.

How to Apply

Interested in joining our team?

Please submit your CV along with a short description of your motivation for applying to info@firesafe.dk

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Søren Christiansen soeren.christiansen@firesafe.dk for further information.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: QEHS Engineer
jobs.description: Are you a proactive quality, environmental, health and safety professional who enjoys improving processes and working closely with production?**We are looking for a forward-thinking QEHS ENGINEER to join our team in Mäntyharju, Finland!**At Exel Composites, quality, health & safety, environmental responsibility and continuous improvement are integral parts of our daily operations. As our new QEHS Engineer, you will play an important role in developing these areas at our Mäntyharju manufacturing site. You will work closely with production and collaborate with application engineering, supply chain, and other functions. You will also interact with customers, suppliers, auditors and authorities as part of your responsibilities.This is a permanent position located at Exel Composites manufacturing site in Mäntyharju, Finland. The position reports to the Site Leader, Mäntyharju.**YOUR ROLE**You will coordinate and develop daily quality, environmental, occupational health and safety activities, ensuring compliance with customer, legal and certification requirements. The role also includes supervising the Mäntyharju laboratory team.Your key responsibilities include:- Maintain QEHS systems and documentation, and coordinate audits and follow-up with the QEHS Manager Finland. - Coordinate risk assessments, incident investigations, safety walks and follow-up actions. - Manage customer complaints, nonconformities and CAPA, including root-cause analysis, reporting and follow-up. - Support production, supplier and new-product quality, improve processes and reduce scrap through continuous improvement. - Monitor environmental compliance and support waste, chemical, emissions and environmental incident management. - Support occupational health, ergonomics and wellbeing with occupational health services. - Organise safety and quality training and inductions, monitor and report QEHS performance. - Act as the site's QEHS contact for customers and authorities within your remit, supporting visits and inspections. **WHAT YOU BRING**You take a practical, solution-focused and organised approach, turning analysis into improvements and involving others in change. You work comfortably in a manufacturing environment.You have:- B.Sc. degree in engineering, mechanical engineering, chemistry or another relevant field. - Experience working in an industrial environment. - Knowledge of quality and production-improvement methods and relevant legal and certification requirements. - Knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems, together with auditing skills. - Strong analytical, root-cause problem-solving and reporting skills. - Good communication skills, with the ability to drive practical improvements. - Good Finnish and English language skills, both written and spoken. **WHAT WE VALUE**The following are considered advantages:- Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, statistical tools, or quality-management and ERP systems. - QEHS experience in manufacturing, particularly chemicals or composites. - Experience with environmental permits, authorities, supplier quality, customer audits or new-product development. - Previous supervisory or team-leadership experience. **WHAT WE OFFER**We offer a varied, hands-on role where you can make a tangible impact on quality, safety and environmental performance at our Mäntyharju site. Working with advanced composite technologies in an international environment, you will collaborate across functions and locations to improve production processes and everyday practices. Your responsibilities will span operational improvement, management systems, audits and stakeholder cooperation, with scope to shape the role around your skills and experience.**INTERESTED?** We look forward to receiving your application and CV, including your salary expectations, by November 22, 2026.

jobs.title: Kaupallinen ja tekninen päällikkö, Tammer Diesel
jobs.description: _Tammer Diesel on Tampereella vuonna 1954 perustettu perheyritys. Se palvelee kolmella paikkakunnalla keskittyen erityisosaamiseensa moottoreihin ja niiden liikuttamien ajoneuvojen huoltotarpeisiin. Tammer Diesel tarjoaa koko Suomen laajuiset moottoripalvelut yksittäisten moottorin osien kunnostuksesta, moottorien peruskorjaukseen ja vaihtomoottoreihin. Sen lisäksi kaikilta paikkakunnilta löytyy kovan luokan auto-osaamista paikallisesti kausihuolloista vaativiin korjauksiin asti. Tammer Diesel työllistää noin 70 henkilöä ja liikevaihto on noin 12 milj. €. Lue lisää www.tammerdiesel.fi_Etsimme nyt **KAUPALLISTA JA TEKNISTÄ PÄÄLLIKKÖÄ** eläköitymisen vuoksi Tampereelle.Tässä tehtävässä yhdistyvät strateginen vastuu ja käytännön tekeminen. Olet mukana rakentamassa liiketoiminnan suuntaa, mutta ennen kaikkea viet asioita eteenpäin: hankit uusia asiakkaita, kasvatat nykyisiä asiakkuuksia, kehität kaupallisia toimintamalleja ja varmistat, että tekninen osaaminen muuttuu asiakkaille lisäarvoa tuottaviksi ja liiketoiminnallisesti kannattaviksi ratkaisuiksi. Osallistut johtoryhmän jäsenenä yrityksen strategiatyöhön ja vastaat kasvuun liittyvien strategisten kokonaisuuksien edistämisestä.**Tehtävässä:**- johdat neljän hengen myyntitiimiä ja osallistut itse aktiivisesti myyntityöhön, asiakastapaamisiin ja kaupallisiin neuvotteluihin - vastaat aktiivisesta uusasiakashankinnasta ja uusien yritysasiakkuuksien rakentamisesta - vastaat myynnin tavoitteellisesta kehittämisestä, kannattavasta kasvusta ja asiakastyytyväisyydestä - viet palvelu- ja tuotekehitystä systemaattisempaan suuntaan ja kehität tapoja muuttaa teknistä osaamista selkeiksi, monistettaviksi ja kaupallisesti kannattaviksi ratkaisuiksi - kehität tarjouslaskentaa, konseptisuunnittelua ja tarjousten muodostamista yhdessä asiantuntijoiden kanssa - kehität myynnin, tarjouslaskennan, hinnoittelun ja tuotehallinnan prosesseja sujuvammiksi ja tehokkaammiksi - varmistat, että ERP-järjestelmä tukee käytännön myyntityötä, tuotehallintaa ja hinnastojen hallintaa mahdollisimman hyvin Tehtävässä menestyy parhaiten henkilö, jolla on vahva tekninen ymmärrys (polttomoottorit /koneenrakennus /huoltotoiminnot) sekä kaupallinen draivi. Tunnistat kasvumahdollisuuksia, rakennat luottamuksellisia asiakassuhteita ja osaat viedä myyntiprosessia tavoitteellisesti eteenpäin. Ymmärrät myös, miten tarjouslaskenta, hinnoittelu, tuotteistaminen ja toimivat prosessit vaikuttavat myynnin onnistumiseen ja liiketoiminnan kannattavuuteen.**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**- vahvaa teknistä osaamista ja kykyä hahmottaa teknisiä kokonaisuuksia - kokemusta B2B-myynnistä, suurasiakkuuksista tai teknisestä ratkaisumyynnistä. Kokemus B2C-myynnistä katsotaan eduksi. - kokemusta prosessien, palveluiden tai tuotteiden kehittämisestä ja kaupallistamisesta - osaamista nykyaikaisten markkinointikanavien hyödyntämisestä - hyviä johtamistaitoja ja kykyä saada tiimi onnistumaan yhteisten tavoitteiden saavuttamisessa - analyyttistä ja kehittävää työotetta sekä ymmärrystä liiketoiminnan tunnusluvuista - rohkeutta tarttua toimeen, tehdä päätöksiä ja viedä asioita eteenpäin myös silloin, kun valmista toimintamallia ei vielä ole - suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa **Miksi tämä tehtävä on kiinnostava?**Tammer Dieselillä saat vastuullisen työtehtävän johtoryhmän jäsenenä, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten myydään, mitä asiakkaille tarjotaan ja miten tulevaisuuden kasvua rakennetaan. Saat keskeisen roolin strategisessa työssä ja toimit tiiviisti myös hallituksen kanssa. Työsuhde-etuihin kuuluu kattava vakuutus, liikunta– ja lounasetu sekä huollot ja varaosat henkilökuntahintaan. Asiakkaat sijaitsevat pääosin Suomessa, joten tehtävässä pääset tapaamaan asiakkaita ja tekemään yhteistyötä heidän kanssaan ilman jatkuvaa matkustamista. Asiakastyö onnistuu pääosin päivämatkoilla.Jos liiketoiminnan vahvistaminen, myynti, tuote- ja palvelukehitys sekä sisäisäisten prosessien määrätietoinen kehittäminen kuulostavat sinun paikaltasi, niin jätäthän hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian mutta viimeistään 17.11.2026. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Helmihunter Kati Kulin, puh. +358 40 7160 379.

jobs.title: Client Accounting Division Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Burkland's core purpose is to Accelerate Dreams. So often, turning dreams into reality helps change the world. We thrive at the forefront of this transformation. Startups desire our professionals as they are the best in the business. Startups seek our content because we are an industry thought leader. Startups trust our expertise, so founders can focus on their companies, products, and value-add. Because of our demonstrated value, our clients have raised more than $17.8B!

At Burkland, we lead with our Core Purpose. We do this for both our clients and our employees. We believe that leaning on our Core Values (Fresh Perspectives, Exponential Value, Empathy, Trusted Partner) will lead to happy clients and happy employees.

We are a remote-first company with over 185 team members, more than 800 clients, and a culture built on doing meaningful work with people who genuinely care about helping our clients grow. Come build something with us!


Role Summary

The Client Accounting Division Manager runs their division as a self-contained business unit within Burkland. The role owns the division's P&L and staffing, and is accountable not only for its own scorecard but for the aggregate performance of every KPI held by roles within the division. Success is measured by both business and people outcomes: revenue, margin, utilization, service quality, and client retention, alongside the growth and engagement of the people doing the work. The division supports consumer and product-based startups, so the manager brings deep inventory and cost accounting expertise to guide the teamâs technical work and client advice.

This is a hands-on people leadership role. The manager is expected to understand strengths and development needs of each team member in their business unit, set clear expectations, give consistent feedback, address performance issues early, and build a team that can deliver both accounting and proactive advisory work at a high standard. The manager also owns key client relationships and serves as the first-line escalation point for client issues, with a defined handoff path for anything beyond their resolution.

This job description outlines the core of the role, but it isn't meant to cover everything you'll do. As Burkland grows, your responsibilities may shift and new projects, tasks, or priorities may be added along the way. We hope you'll see that as a chance to stretch, learn, and broaden your contributions.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Division Performance and KPI Accountability

  • Own the business unit's P&L, including revenue, margin, and utilization targets.

  • Drive aggregate performance across all KPIs assigned to Accounting Associates and Client Accounting Advisors, in addition to the manager's own scorecard.

  • Track division performance regularly, identify gaps early, and take corrective action at the individual and team level.

  • Report on division results to the Director of Accounting Advisory, including risks, trends, and planned actions.

  • Manage capacity and workload distribution across the division as well as assigning clients.

  • Contribute to pricing and fixed-fee scoping, and monitor engagement profitability.

  • Maintain awareness of AR and collections for division clients and address issues with the appropriate teams.

People Leadership and Staffing

  • Set clear role expectations and performance goals tied to the KPIs each team member owns.

  • Lead regular, structured 1:1s focused on goals, workload, development, and wellbeing, not only status updates. Use them to give direct, ongoing feedback that recognizes strong work and addresses gaps as they appear, rather than waiting for review cycles.

  • Create clear growth plans and provide ongoing coaching to develop each team member, in partnership with the Director and People Team

  • Conduct performance reviews, manage performance concerns directly, and contribute to compensation and promotion recommendations.

  • Monitor team capacity and engagement to support retention and prevent burnout.

  • Apply company policies consistently, manage time-off and leave requests, and bring performance concerns, employee relations matters, and escalations to the Director and People Team for guidance and resolution.

  • Plan staffing against current and forecasted client demand and build the business case for new headcount.

  • Lead hiring for the division through interviewing and selection, and onboard new team members so they reach full productivity within expected timelines.

Inventory Accounting and Technical Oversight

  • Oversee inventory valuation, reconciliation, and physical and cycle count processes across the divisionâs client portfolio, making sure variances are investigated and resolved quickly.

  • Set standards for costing methods (FIFO, LIFO, weighted average) and ensure the team applies them correctly by client and industry.

  • Ensure the team delivers accurate GAAP financial statements, inventory reporting, and COGS and gross margin analysis tailored to each clientâs business model.

  • Guide ERP and inventory software implementations, migrations, and improvements (partnering with ERP specialist where needed), and ensure client records stay audit-ready (as appropriate for the engagement size and scope).

  • Coach the team to help clients reduce shrinkage, obsolescence, overstocking, and stockouts, and to improve working capital through metrics like inventory turnover and days on hand.

  • Strong understanding of supply chain methods such as contract manufacturing and 3PL operations

Client Relationships and Service Quality

  • Act as an escalation point for client relationship issues.

  • Oversee quality control to ensure deliverables meet firm standards.

  • Shift the team's work from solely report delivery toward proactive advisory.

Growth and Operations

  • Own growth of the division's book of business through business development efforts to expand existing client relationships and identify service-expansion opportunities

  • Maintain accurate, current portfolio information in Knownwell

  • Drive full adoption of firm tools, systems, and processes, including AI-enabled workflows

Group and Company Success

A One Burkland mindset:

Our clients are best served when teams work together, not in silos. Partner closely with Tax, CFO, HR, and other service lines to create consistency, share knowledge, and deliver a seamless client experience across Burkland.

  • Comfort with an increasing pace of change:

Today's pace is the slowest we will experience going forward, not a finish line before things settle. As AI and related tools evolve, our processes evolve with them. This allows for more chances to learn, grow, and shape how the work gets done.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI-driven efficiency:

Proactively look for smarter ways of working as new tools come online. This is about changing how the work gets done, not reducing the need for skilled people to do it.

  • A constructive attitude:

Attitude is contagious in both directions, across the team and with clients. Approach change with curiosity and enthusiasm. Help to set that tone for others rather than defaulting to resistance.

  • Full adoption of firm tools and processes:

Systems are critical to growth and often fail to be effective when only part of the team uses them well.

  • Delivery and proactive advisory:

Build real understanding of where each client's business is headed and advise ahead of it. Clients need the why behind their numbers, not just the numbers.

Core Competencies & Skills

  • Financial Acumen â cost management, margin analysis, fixed-fee scope adjustments, and AR/collections awareness.

  • Client Relationshipsâ Client relationship management, escalation handling, and spotting cross-sell and service-expansion opportunities.

  • Advisory mindset â Moving teams from report delivery alone to proactive advisory.

  • Leading Change â Champions of change, including AI-driven efficiency, leading by example in the consistent adoption of firm tools, systems and processes and reinforcing them across the team.

  • AI Fluency â Hands-on comfort using AI tools in accounting and operational work, with sound judgment about where AI adds value, where human review is required, and how to protect client data.

  • Cross-functional collaboration â Build strong working relationships across Service Delivery, partnering with other teams on shared client work and aligning with Growth on new client onboarding and cross-sell opportunities

  • Inventory and Cost Accounting Expertise â Deep knowledge of inventory accounting, costing methods, COGS, and GAAP, with the ability to guide a team through complex inventory work and system implementations. Strong understanding of supply chain methods such as contract manufacturing and 3PL operations as well as eCommerce operations and cash flows through Shopify, Amazon, eBay, and other marketplace solutions.

Minimum Requirements / Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, accounting, finance, or a related field, and 5+ years of progressive professional experience

  • Direct people management experience, including conducting performance reviews, managing underperformance, and developing team members

  • Exceptional client relationship management skills and the ability to understand client needs

  • Strong project management skills, including the ability to prioritize, meet deadlines, and deliver high-quality results

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, team members, and leadership

  • Curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and an eagerness to take on new challenges involving emerging technology and industries

  • Strong command of GAAP and cost accounting, including inventory accounting (FIFO, LIFO, landed costs, shrinkage, and valuation adjustments)

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA or CMA credential

  • Experience owning or significantly contributing to a team budget, P&L, or book of business

  • Prior experience leading a team within a professional services or client accounting environment

  • Hands-on ERP and inventory system experience (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Cin7, Fishbowl, or similar)

  • Experience leading or overseeing ERP or inventory software implementations

Â 

Physical & Environmental Demands

This is a remote position. Work is primarily performed at a computer for extended periods, requiring the ability to use a keyboard, view a screen, and communicate via video and phone. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EEO Statement

Burkland Associates is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Burkland Associates is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or another legally protected status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please visit our careers page https://burklandassociates.com/careers/. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment-qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

The base pay range target for the role described in this job description is 120,000-140,000. Final offer amounts depend on multiple factors such as candidate experience and expertise, geographic location, total compensation, and market data. In addition, full-time regular positions are eligible for, 401(k), health benefits, and other benefits; some of these benefits may be available for part-time.

Â

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.description:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

jobs.title: Support Engineer I (FC, Weekend Shift)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Support Engineer you are at the forefront of helping those developers create. In a given day you’ll help folks with all sorts of things ranging from general Replit usage questions, identifying and debugging issues on the platform and helping to build and maintain the tools we use. We use tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and Replit itself to get the job done. We also value solving the problems we can ourselves. We have a number of tools we build and maintain ourselves.



You will work on a small, global team of support specialists and engineers united by Replit's mission to make the next billion software creators. Together, you'll ensure developers worldwide have the support they need to bring their ideas to life.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Work directly with Replit customers via support tickets to solve technical product issues, bugs, and provide technical guidance while meeting daily ticket volume and resolution time targets.

 - Collaborate with the rest of the Support team in telling the story of our users to the rest of Replit.

 - Directly contribute to and maintain the Support team's Knowledge Base.

 - Support customer-facing communications for outages and incidents and swiftly report ongoing bugs for Eng to triage and fix.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Prior experience in software development or relevant technical support experience

 - Proven ability to work efficiently in fast-paced, high-volume support environments with strict productivity metrics.

 - Strong time management and ticket triage skills with comfort in performance tracking and regular reporting.

 - Excellent communication skills with initiative to ask questions when encountered with the unknown.

 - Experience with support tools and ticketing systems (e.g. Zendesk)




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies

 - Focus on automation: Strong belief in automating repetitive tasks and building self-healing systems



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The schedule follows a Saturday through Wednesday work week, with an in-office requirement on Mondays and Wednesdays.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: HR Country Manager Denmark
jobs.description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.   As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.  About the job As HR Country Manager, you will be supporting Alfa Laval's Scaling for Future direction, with a focus on Denmark, with 2000 employees and five Danish legal entities. The role in this form is newly established, giving you a fantastic opportunity to influence the position and make it your own!  The position supports several types of organizations in Denmark and Scandinavia, such as sales companies, factories, shared services, business units, and product groups. You will contribute to harmonizing people policies and practices and as a trusted partner, you will support and inspire management by proactively driving organizational, leadership, and competence development.  You will act as:     HR Country Manager for Denmark, ensuring alignment, compliance, and consistent HR practices across all five legal entities across four sites - Søborg, Kolding, Aalborg and Nakskov.     HR Representative in the Danish Country Council, coordinating national HR topics and providing a consolidated HR view to business leaders in the country council     HR Business Partner for Søborg Site Services and the HR Shared Services Scandinavia organization.     Local HR responsibility for the Søborg site, including Site Management, the Works Council, the Work Environment Council, and the Crisis Management Team.     The one responsible for overall country-level approach to unions, including ensuring alignment in union relationships, works council cooperation and collective agreement governance and also provide guidance together with HR Shared Services on employee relations areas. Travel is part of the job, mainly to our various sites in Denmark, but you will also have a few travel days a year within Europe. You will be part of the Danish Country Council management team as well as part of the Søborg Site Management team. You report to Per Lund Hansen, a manager who will give you freedom and mandate to perform at your best. You will also have a dotted line to our VP Total Rewards and HR Shared Services, Gabriella Nagy Olofsson.
